classification.title_zh: 利用黑洞光子环检验范德瓦尔斯黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 范德瓦尔斯黑洞（BH）是反德西特（AdS）时空中的一种非Kerr模型，表现出特征热力学相变。黑洞分子体积 b 和压强 P 等参数的物理有效性是否可行，仍需观测检验。作为强引力场的灵敏探针，黑洞光子环直接携带时空几何信息，使其成为检验模型的理想对象。根据与该黑洞相关的时空度规，本研究得到光子的零测地线方程和守恒量，通过有效势分析确定光子球条件与半径，研究光子环分类与辐射性质，并利用事件视界望远镜（EHT）的测量对参数施加约束并模拟光学外观。结果表明，分子体积参数 b 显著调节光子球半径、光子环结构和光度。在特定区间内，该模型与 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的 EHT 测量高度一致。该区间不仅满足能量条件（弱、强和主能量条件），还对应稳定的范德瓦尔斯型相变区域。此外，光子环可以区分范德瓦尔斯黑洞和史瓦西黑洞：由于小黑洞-大黑洞（SBH-LBH）相变和微观结构不连续性，范德瓦尔斯黑洞的光子环对参数 b 特别敏感，而史瓦西黑洞缺乏这些特征。这项工作利用光子环探测黑洞分子模型，将其微观结构、时空几何和观测特征联系起来，并提供了一种从观测推导黑洞微观物理的新途径。
classification.one_liner: 用光子环和 EHT 观测检验 AdS 中范德瓦尔斯黑洞的参数与相变特征，并区分其与 Schwarzschild 黑洞。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文以经典引力中的光子环/零测地线为主要方法，并涉及 AdS 黑洞热力学相变，命中“经典引力/广义相对论”和“相变与气泡成核”重点标签；但摘要未涉及全息对偶，故不是全息理论主线。

2603.24722v2.title: Photon Ring Astrometry I: A Simple Spin Measurement Technique for High-Resolution Images of M87*
2603.24722v2.abstract: The supermassive black hole M87* is a target for future horizon-scale imaging that will resolve the first lensed (${n}~{=}~{1}$) sub-image of the photon ring. In this work, we identify a concrete observable---the displacement between the centers of the ${n}~{=}~{1}$ photon-ring sub-image and the direct image. Assuming that the observed large-scale jet of M87 is aligned with the black-hole spin axis, we separate the relative position of the photon ring into components parallel and transverse to the projected spin axis. We show that the parallel shift is primarily determined by inclination and emission radius, while the transverse shift is tightly correlated with inclination and spin. We demonstrate these effects both in a simple geometric model (to explain the underlying physics) and in {general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics} simulations with magnetically arrested disks (to provide realistic instantiations). We find that a relative astrometric resolution of ${\lesssim}~{0.1\;\mu\rm{as}}$, achievable by the proposed Black Hole Explorer mission, is sufficient to constrain the spin to better than 9\% if the accretion flow is prograde, 25\% if the flow is retrograde, or 24\% if the direction of the flow is undetermined. More generally, this identifies photon-ring astrometry as a promising method to constrain the underlying spacetime geometry without relying on geometric modeling of the observed emission.

classification.title_zh: 光子环天体测量 I：M87* 高分辨率图像的简单自旋测量技术
classification.abstract_zh: 超大质量黑洞 M87* 是未来视界尺度成像的目标，这些成像将分辨出第一个透镜化的（n=1）光子环子像。在这项工作中，我们确定了一个具体的可观测量——n=1 光子环子像中心与直接像中心之间的位移。假设 M87 观测到的大尺度喷流与黑洞自旋轴对齐，我们将光子环的相对位置分解为平行和垂直于投影自旋轴的分量。我们表明，平行位移主要由倾角和发射半径决定，而横向位移与倾角和自旋紧密相关。我们用一个简单几何模型（解释潜在物理）和磁囚禁盘的广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟（提供现实实例）展示了这些效应。我们发现，对于提出的黑洞探索者任务可达到的约 ≲0.1 μas 的相对天体测量分辨率，如果吸积流是顺行的，足以将自旋限制到优于 9%；如果吸积流是逆行的，优于 25%；如果流动方向未确定，优于 24%。更一般地，这表明光子环天体测量是一种有前景的方法，可以在不依赖于对观测辐射进行几何建模的情况下约束潜在时空几何。
classification.one_liner: 利用 n=1 光子环子像与直接像中心的位移，提出一种不依赖辐射几何建模的 M87* 黑洞自旋测量方法。
keywords: 广义相对论磁流体动力学
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典黑洞时空中的光子环与自旋测量，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及全息对偶、量子信息或量子引力。

2610.04282v1.title: Dark matter in neutron stars: two-fluid $f$-mode oscillations in full general relativity
2610.04282v1.abstract: A dark-matter core and a soft nuclear equation of state can produce similar mass--radius signatures, motivating a complementary probe through the $f$-mode spectrum. We compute quadrupolar $f$-mode frequencies and gravitational-wave damping times in full general relativity for cold, nonrotating neutron stars admixed with self-interacting bosonic dark matter (DM). Our two-fluid survey spans 21 nuclear equations of state covering nucleonic, hyperonic, $\Delta$-admixed, and combined hyperon--$\Delta$ compositions at $F_{\rm DM}=1$--$20\%$. The main sequences use $\lambda=\pi$ and boson masses of $500$ and $100\,\mathrm{MeV}$ for the core and halo studies, respectively. Independent normal-matter (NM) and DM displacements couple through the metric, yielding NM-led and DM-led $f$-mode branches whose radiative damping is determined by outgoing-wave boundary conditions. At $1.4\,M_\odot$, the core DM-led damping time decreases from order $10^3\,\mathrm{s}$ at $F_{\rm DM}=1\%$ to order $1\,\mathrm{s}$ at $20\%$, approximately following an empirical $F_{\rm DM}^{-2}$ dependence, while NM-led damping times remain within $0.12$--$0.33\,\mathrm{s}$. Halo DM-led damping instead increases with dark fraction: at the same stellar mass and $F_{\rm DM}=20\%$, dark radii approach $88\,\mathrm{km}$, frequencies fall to $0.14\,\mathrm{kHz}$, and damping times reach approximately $450\,\mathrm{s}$. Selected high-mass core sequences exhibit strong DM-led damping-time upturns not reproduced by the leading mass-quadrupole diagnostic. Representative core calculations show greater DM-led sensitivity to the bosonic self-coupling and retain both branches at $\ell=3$. Under the adopted nonrotating, circular-binary prescriptions, no evaluated configuration satisfies all geometric and perturbative conditions for a controlled linear tidal resonance.

classification.title_zh: 中子星中的暗物质：完整广义相对论下的双流体 f-模式振荡
classification.abstract_zh: 暗物质核心与偏软的核物质状态方程可以产生相似的质量—半径特征，这促使人们通过 f-模式谱进行互补探测。我们在完整广义相对论下计算了冷、非转动、且掺入自相互作用玻色暗物质（DM）中子星的四极 f-模式频率和引力波阻尼时间。我们的双流体扫描涵盖 21 个核物质状态方程，覆盖核子、超子、Δ 混杂以及超子—Δ 组合成分，暗物质分数 F_DM=1%–20%。主要序列对核心和晕研究分别采用 λ=π 以及 500 和 100 MeV 的玻色子质量。独立的正常物质（NM）和暗物质位移通过度规耦合，产生 NM 主导和 DM 主导的 f-模式分支，其辐射阻尼由出射波边界条件决定。在 1.4 M⊙ 处，核心 DM 主导的阻尼时间从 F_DM=1% 时的约 10^3 s 降至 20% 时的约 1 s，大致遵循经验性的 F_DM^{-2} 依赖；而 NM 主导的阻尼时间保持在 0.12–0.33 s 内。晕中 DM 主导的阻尼反而随暗物质分数增加：在相同恒星质量和 F_DM=20% 时，暗半径接近 88 km，频率降至 0.14 kHz，阻尼时间达到约 450 s。部分高质量核心序列表现出 DM 主导阻尼时间的强烈上折，而领先的质量四极诊断无法再现。代表性核心计算显示 DM 主导模式对玻色子自耦合更敏感，并且在 ℓ=3 时仍保留两个分支。在所采用的非转动、圆轨道双星近似下，没有评估的构型满足受控线性潮汐共振所需的全部几何和微扰条件。
classification.one_liner: 在完整广义相对论下研究含玻色暗物质中子星的双流体 f-模式，给出核物质主导与暗物质主导两支的频率及引力波阻尼时间。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接匹配用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线，并涉及 f-模式/准正规模与引力波阻尼；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2607.27185v2.title: Sharp Bounds on Ground State Energy of the SYK Model
2607.27185v2.abstract: We study the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) Hamiltonian $H_{\operatorname{SYK}}$ on $n$ Majorana modes with $k$-body interactions, and prove that $\mathbb{E}\|H_{\operatorname{SYK}}\|_{\operatorname{op}} = (1 - o(1))\cdot\sqrt{2n}/k$ for super-constant $k\leq o(\sqrt{n})$, where the expectation is over the disorder variables in the Hamiltonian. This confirms predictions due to Garcia-Garcia, Jia and Verbaarschot and answers a question posed by Feng, Tian, and Wei. Our results extend to the sparse SYK Hamiltonian. As a corollary, we obtain that a dissipative quantum algorithm due to Basso, Chen, and Dalzell provably computes the ground state energy of the SYK Hamiltonian up to an $O(1)$-multiplicative factor for all $k < \sqrt{n}/4$. Our key technical idea is identifying an explicit, deterministic linear operator $\mathsf{x}$ such that a fixed quadratic form of $\mathsf{x}^{2\ell}$ exactly equals the expected trace moments of the SYK Hamiltonian for every $n$ and $k$. This linear operator can be naturally viewed as a twisted model of bosons on the space of hyperedges of a hypergraph. The problem thus reduces to identifying the spectral edge of $\mathsf{x}$, which we show is dominated by the spectrum of a natural ${n \choose k}$-dimensional matrix from the Johnson scheme and is straightforward to compute using known results. To show that our bound is sharp, we construct a witness state with a large quadratic form on $\mathsf{x}$ and transform it into a certificate of a lower bound on the largest quadratic form on $H_{\operatorname{SYK}}$. Beyond the SYK Hamiltonian, our techniques also apply to the $k-$local quantum spin glass (QSG), yielding $\mathbb{E}\|H_{k-\operatorname{QSG}}\|_{\operatorname{op}}\leq O(\sqrt{n/k})$ for all $1\leq k\leq\sqrt{n}/2$, thus improving the standard $O(\sqrt{n})$ bound by a factor of $\sqrt{k}$.

classification.title_zh: SYK 模型基态能量的尖锐界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 n 个 Majorana 模上带 k-体相互作用的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 哈密顿量 H_SYK，并证明对于超常数 k≤o(√n)，有 E||H_SYK||_op = (1 - o(1))·√(2n)/k，其中期望对哈密顿量中的无序变量取。这证实了 Garcia-Garcia、Jia 和 Verbaarschot 的预测，并回答了 Feng、Tian 和 Wei 提出的问题。我们的结果可推广到稀疏 SYK 哈密顿量。作为推论，对于所有 k < √n/4，Basso、Chen 和 Dalzell 的耗散量子算法可证明以 O(1) 乘法因子计算 SYK 哈密顿量的基态能量。关键技术思想是找到一个显式的确定性线性算子 x，使得 x^{2ℓ} 的某个固定二次型对每个 n 和 k 都恰好等于 SYK 哈密顿量的期望迹矩。该线性算子可自然视为超图超边空间上玻色子的扭曲模型。于是问题归结为确定 x 的谱边缘；我们证明它由 Johnson 方案中一个自然的 {n choose k} 维矩阵的谱主导，并可用已知结果直接计算。为说明界是尖锐的，我们构造一个在 x 上具有大二次型的见证态，并将其转化为 H_SYK 上最大二次型下界的证书。除 SYK 哈密顿量外，我们的技术也适用于 k-局域量子自旋玻璃 (QSG)，得到对所有 1≤k≤√n/2，E||H_{k-QSG}||_op ≤ O(√(n/k))，从而将标准 O(√n) 界改进了因子 √k。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明 SYK 模型算符范数的尖锐渐近界，并推广到稀疏 SYK 与 k-局域量子自旋玻璃。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 SYK 模型算符范数严格界，虽属 JT/SYK/AdS2 方向，但与用户重点标签（全息超流、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、探针膜、经典引力）无直接重叠。

2610.07134v1.title: All-Orders Classical Soft Graviton Theorems in the Newtonian Limit and Beyond
2610.07134v1.abstract: The classical soft graviton theorem aims to determine certain terms in the early- and late-time tails of the gravitational waveform produced in a scattering process, using only the asymptotic momenta of the scattered objects. In this paper we find an infinite series of leading-logarithmic tail terms in the Newtonian limit, where the incoming and outgoing particles move slowly, but the scattering itself can be violent. The all-orders conjecture of Alessio, Di Vecchia and Heissenberg agrees with our results for two-particle scattering, but does not hold in general when the initial or final state contains three or more particles. We also propose an all-orders conjecture for these tails beyond the Newtonian limit, but do not prove it. Nevertheless, the conjecture passes several nontrivial consistency checks.

classification.title_zh: 牛顿极限及之外的全阶经典软引力子定理
classification.abstract_zh: 经典软引力子定理旨在仅利用散射物体的渐近动量，确定散射过程中产生的引力波波形在早期和晚期尾项中的某些项。本文在牛顿极限下找到了一系列无穷多的领头对数尾项，其中入射和出射粒子运动缓慢，但散射本身可以很剧烈。Alessio、Di Vecchia 和 Heissenberg 的全阶猜想在两粒子散射中与我们的结果一致，但当初始或末态包含三个或更多粒子时，该猜想一般不再成立。我们还为牛顿极限之外的这些尾项提出一个全阶猜想，但没有证明它。尽管如此，该猜想通过了若干非平凡的相容性检验。
classification.one_liner: 在牛顿极限下导出无穷多领头对数引力波尾项的全阶经典软引力子结果，并指出ADH全阶猜想在多粒子情形下失效，同时提出牛顿极限之外的全阶猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的软引力子定理与引力波尾项，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2610.07135v1.title: A New Entropy Puzzle in ABJM
2610.07135v1.abstract: We point out a puzzle about BPS black holes in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$: the entropy grows when $k$ increases although the number of gauge-invariant operators in the dual conformal field theory that can contribute to the entropy grows as $k$ decreases, due to the presence of monopole operators. Analyzing the superconformal index of ABJM, we show that the same puzzle exists for finite $N$ in the large charge limit. We propose a resolution based on an increasing number of trace relations as $k$ decreases, which dominates over the other effect. We argue that this mostly affects fortuitous operators and we provide an explicit example of a fortuitous operator that disappears at small $k$.

classification.title_zh: ABJM 中的一个新熵谜题
classification.abstract_zh: 我们指出 AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ 中 BPS 黑洞的一个谜题：当 $k$ 增大时熵增大，然而对偶共形场论中可对熵有贡献的规范不变算符数目却因单极子算符的存在而随 $k$ 减小而增大。通过分析 ABJM 的超共形指标，我们表明在大电荷极限下，对于有限 $N$ 也存在同样的谜题。我们提出一种基于迹关系随 $k$ 减小而增多的解决方式，该效应压过另一效应。我们论证这主要影响偶然算符，并给出一个在小 $k$ 下消失的偶然算符的显式例子。
classification.one_liner: 揭示 ABJM 中 BPS 黑洞熵随 $k$ 增大而增大与对偶 CFT 规范不变算符计数趋势相反的谜题，并提出迹关系增多的解决机制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 ABJM 对偶中 BPS 黑洞熵与超共形指标/单极子算符的匹配问题，属于全息黑洞微观态，但不涉及用户列出的重点支线（全息超流超导、相变、QNM、探针膜、经典引力等）。

2610.07141v1.title: Checking the Schwinger-Dyson equation in the purely open matrix-tensor model
2610.07141v1.abstract: We test the proposed matrix-tensor description of three-dimensional gravity using a Schwinger-Dyson relation in its purely open sector. We enumerate and classify the topological contributions to a cylinder amplitude. Under a proposed counting prescription motivated by Virasoro TQFT, we find agreement with the conjectured unit difference between the numbers of contributing manifolds associated to the two interaction terms in the potential. By contrast, counting all inequivalent surface embeddings separately would instead give a mismatch. This comparison highlights the importance of specifying the set of bulk topologies to be included in the gravitational path integral.

classification.title_zh: 检验纯开放矩阵-张量模型中的 Schwinger-Dyson 方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用纯开放扇区中的 Schwinger-Dyson 关系，检验先前提出的三维引力的矩阵-张量描述。我们枚举并分类柱面振幅的拓扑贡献。在一种由 Virasoro TQFT 启发的计数方案下，我们发现与以下猜想一致：势中两个相互作用项对应的贡献流形数目相差单位。相反，若分别计数所有不等价的曲面嵌入，则会给出不匹配。这一比较凸显了明确规定引力路径积分中所包含体拓扑集合的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 在纯开放矩阵-张量模型中用 Schwinger-Dyson 方程检验三维引力的矩阵-张量描述，并强调体拓扑计数方案对匹配的重要性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于矩阵-张量模型与三维量子引力路径积分的技术检验，与所列重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力等）没有直接重合。

2610.07145v1.title: The Back-to-Back Plateau of the Energy-Energy Correlator from Weak to Strong Coupling
2610.07145v1.abstract: The back-to-back limit of the energy-energy correlator (EEC) exhibits a finite plateau, capturing the evolution from perturbative soft-collinear radiation at weak coupling to string dynamics at strong coupling. At weak coupling, we resum its leading and next-to-leading-power logarithms through N$^3$LL in $\mathcal N=4$ SYM, including non-planar contributions. Combining this weak-coupling endpoint with bootstrap and strong-coupling data, we construct an interpolation for the plateau height from weak to strong coupling. The calculation uses a human-in-the-loop agentic workflow.

classification.title_zh: 能量-能量关联子的背靠背平台：从弱耦合到强耦合
classification.abstract_zh: 能量-能量关联子（EEC）的背靠背极限呈现一个有限平台，刻画了从弱耦合下微扰软-共线辐射到强耦合下弦动力学的演化。在弱耦合下，我们在 \mathcal N=4 SYM 中将领头和次领头幂次的对数重求和至 N^3LL，包括非平面贡献。结合该弱耦合端点与 bootstrap 及强耦合数据，我们构造了平台高度从弱耦合到强耦合的插值。该计算使用了人在回路中的智能体工作流。
classification.one_liner: 在 N=4 SYM 中重求和 EEC 背靠背平台的对数，并插值到强耦合，以刻画从微扰辐射到弦动力学的演化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 N=4 SYM/全息强耦合精密计算，但与用户列出的重点支线（全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力等）没有直接重合。

2610.07147v1.title: Deriving the $\text{AdS}_3\times\text{S}^3\times \text{T}^4$ Quantum Spectral Curve II: T-system and QSC
2610.07147v1.abstract: We complete the systematic derivation of the Quantum Spectral Curve (QSC) for strings on $\text{AdS}_3\times\text{S}^3\times \text{T}^4$ with pure Ramond--Ramond (RR) flux, building on the extended Y-system obtained in our preceding paper. We establish the precise relation between the two formalisms of the Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz and the QSC, derive the previously conjectured QSC, and, along the way, uncover additional relations satisfied by its solutions. Our analysis also clarifies how massless excitations, although not explicit among the basic QSC building blocks, are encoded in their analytic structure. The derivation culminates in the so-called $\mathbf{P}{\mu}$-system, a compact formulation of the QSC in terms of a small set of functions and their analytic continuations.

classification.title_zh: 推导 AdS3×S3×T4 量子谱曲线 II：T-系统与 QSC
classification.abstract_zh: 我们完成了纯 Ramond--Ramond (RR) 流下 AdS3×S3×T4 弦论量子谱曲线 (QSC) 的系统推导，这基于我们前一篇论文得到的扩展 Y-系统。我们建立了热力学 Bethe ansatz 与 QSC 两种形式之间的精确关系，推导了此前猜想的 QSC，并在此过程中发现了其解所满足的额外关系。我们的分析还阐明了无质量激发虽然未显式出现在 QSC 基本构件中，但如何编码在其解析结构中。该推导最终给出所谓的 Pμ-系统，即用少量函数及其解析延拓对 QSC 的紧凑表述。
classification.one_liner: 从扩展 Y-系统系统推导纯 RR 流下 AdS3×S3×T4 弦的量子谱曲线及其 Pμ-系统表述。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文属于 AdS3/CFT2 可积性与量子谱曲线推导，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、相变/气泡成核、QNM/非线性演化、探针膜/Floquet、经典引力等方向。

2610.07153v1.title: Localizing $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ $AdS_3$ solutions of M-theory
2610.07153v1.abstract: We apply equivariant localization to supersymmetric $AdS_3\times M_8$ solutions of eleven-dimensional supergravity, dual to two-dimensional $\mathcal N=(2,0)$ SCFTs. We construct equivariantly closed polyforms encoding the magnetic flux and its dual, calibrated M2-branes and the warped volume, reducing protected observables to fixed point data of the $U(1)$ R-symmetry action. We apply the framework to $S^4$ bundles over coassociative four-cycles and $S^2$ bundles over compact six-manifolds, obtaining topological formulae for leading central charges and gravitational anomalies in terms of quantized fluxes and topological data. We recover the known results for $T^2\times KE_4$ solutions and construct a compact numerical solution with quantized flux that lies outside the known polynomial branch.

classification.title_zh: M理论中 N=(2,0) AdS_3 解的局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将等变局域化应用于十一维超引力的超对称 AdS_3×M_8 解，这些解对偶于二维 N=(2,0) SCFT。我们构造了等变闭多形式，编码磁通及其对偶、校准的 M2-膜和翘曲体积，将受保护观测量约化为 U(1) R-对称作用的固定点数据。我们将该框架应用于余结合四循环上的 S^4 丛以及紧致六维流形上的 S^2 丛，得到以量子化通量和拓扑数据表示的领头中心荷与引力反常的拓扑公式。我们重现了 T^2×KE_4 解的已知结果，并构造了一个具有量子化通量、位于已知多项式分支之外的紧致数值解。
classification.one_liner: 用等变局域化把 M 理论中 AdS_3×M_8 超引力解的中心荷和引力反常化为通量与拓扑固定点数据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与 M 理论超引力解的基础/形式研究，不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等支线。

2610.07170v1.title: Multi-Point Affine Bialgebras for AdS/CFT Integrability
2610.07170v1.abstract: In this work, we revisit the analytical structure of the classical affine Lie bialgebra underlying the integrable structures of AdS/CFT worldsheet scattering and the one-dimensional Hubbard model. Earlier work showed that the algebraic relations implied two singularity locations in the evaluation parameter plane besides the common expansion points infinity and zero for Laurent polynomials forming the basis for loop and affine algebras. Our aim is to formulate these singularities rigorously using meromorphic functions rather than by expansion into geometric series. We thus carefully analyse the analytical structure of the affine bialgebra relations in the complex plane paying attention to potential restrictions and extensions due to the additional singularities. As a first attempt with some shortcomings, we reformulate the affine bialgebra relations with the extra singularities serving as the expansion points for Laurent polynomials. We finally overcome the remaining issues by proposing three-point and four-point affine algebras for the rational and trigonometric cases. With a suitable choice of basis for meromorphic functions on the Riemann sphere with several punctures based on Krichever-Novikov algebras, we show that the multi-point affine algebras form consistent quasi-triangular Lie bialgebras.

classification.title_zh: 用于 AdS/CFT 可积性的多点仿射双代数
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们重新审视作为 AdS/CFT 世界面散射和一维 Hubbard 模型可积结构基础的经典仿射李双代数的解析结构。先前工作表明，这些代数关系意味着在求值参数平面中，除了构成圈代数与仿射代数基的 Laurent 多项式的常用展开点无穷远和零点之外，还存在两个奇点位置。我们的目标是用亚纯函数严格表述这些奇点，而不是通过几何级数展开。因此，我们仔细分析复平面中仿射双代数关系的解析结构，关注由于额外奇点可能带来的限制与扩展。作为带有一些缺点的初步尝试，我们用额外奇点作为 Laurent 多项式的展开点来重新表述仿射双代数关系。最后，我们通过为有理情形和三角情形提出三点和四点仿射代数，克服了遗留问题。通过在基于 Krichever-Novikov 代数的带多个穿刺的 Riemann 球面上为亚纯函数选取合适基，我们证明多点仿射代数构成一致的准三角李双代数。
classification.one_liner: 作者用亚纯函数和 Krichever-Novikov 基重新表述 AdS/CFT 可积性中的经典仿射李双代数，并构造三点与四点准三角李双代数。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于 AdS/CFT 可积性的数学结构，与列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力等重点标签无直接重合。

2610.07176v1.title: Generalised entanglement wedges in three dimensions
2610.07176v1.abstract: Generalized entanglement wedges (GWs), proposed by Bousso and Penington for gravitating regions in general spacetimes, share many properties of ordinary entanglement wedges, including nesting, monotonicity and strong subadditivity of their generalized entropies. In AdS/CFT, the corresponding properties of entanglement wedges are consequences of the structure of the dual CFT. In this paper we ask whether the properties of GWs have a similar origin. We explore this question in vacuum AdS$_3$ at leading order in $G$. We first show that every GW on a static slice is a union of geodesically convex regions. Each such region is an intersection of ordinary entanglement wedges, so every GW is built from unions and intersections of entanglement wedges. We then use the Crofton formula of integral geometry to write the perimeter of a convex region as the measure of the set of geodesics that intersect it. In AdS$_3$ every geodesic is the Ryu--Takayanagi surface of a boundary interval, so this measure can be written in terms of the von Neumann entropies of CFT intervals. Strong subadditivity of the CFT entropy guarantees that the measure is positive. Monotonicity and strong subadditivity of GWs then follow from simple inequalities between sets of geodesics. The strong subadditivity of GWs is therefore a direct consequence of strong subadditivity on the boundary. Our results further suggest that GWs correspond to subsystems of the CFT that are more general than boundary subregions.

classification.title_zh: 三维中的广义纠缠楔
classification.abstract_zh: 由 Bousso 和 Penington 为一般时空中的引力区域提出的广义纠缠楔（GWs）具有普通纠缠楔的许多性质，包括嵌套性、单调性及其广义熵的强次可加性。在 AdS/CFT 中，纠缠楔的相应性质是对偶 CFT 结构的推论。本文追问 GWs 的性质是否也有类似起源。我们在真空 AdS3 中按 G 领头阶探讨这一问题。首先证明，静态切片上的每个 GW 都是测地凸区域的并集。每个这样的区域是普通纠缠楔的交集，因此每个 GW 都由纠缠楔的并与交构成。然后利用积分几何的 Crofton 公式，将凸区域的周长写成与其相交的测地线集合的测度。在 AdS3 中，每条测地线都是某个边界区间的 Ryu-Takayanagi 曲面，因此该测度可用 CFT 区间的冯·诺依曼熵表示。CFT 熵的强次可加性保证该测度为正。GWs 的单调性和强次可加性随后由测地线集合之间的简单不等式推出。因此，GWs 的强次可加性是边界上强次可加性的直接结果。我们的结果进一步表明，GWs 对应于比边界子区域更一般的 CFT 子系统。
classification.one_liner: 在真空 AdS3 中，广义纠缠楔可由普通纠缠楔的并与交构成，其强次可加性直接源于边界 CFT 熵的强次可加性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 AdS/CFT 中的广义纠缠楔与边界熵的强次可加性，属于全息纠缠/量子信息基础，不涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等具体重点支线。

2610.07234v1.title: Geometry of massive loops in gravitational scattering: Maximal cut, Riemann's bilinear relations and genus drop
2610.07234v1.abstract: We study a representative two-loop family of worldline quantum field theory integrals relevant for classical gravitational scattering with a massive mediator and investigate the geometric structure of its maximal cut. We find that, unlike the massless case, the massive loops already give rise to an elliptic maximal cut at two loops, which degenerates into a nodal curve in the massless limit and in the static limit. In the global Baikov representation, two successive integrations reduce the maximal cut to a period of an elliptic curve. We further establish five primary consequences of this study: (a) The integration-by-parts method generates five master integrals, which, under reflection, split into a three-dimensional elliptic block and a two-dimensional polylog block. We derive the differential equation in two ways, one by Laporta reduction and subsequently by intersection theory in two cocycle bases, and construct the rational map between them. (b) The period matrices in arbitrary dimension have been computed in terms of Appell and Beta functions. Furthermore, we derive twisted Riemann period relations that yield nine quadratic identities among them. (c) We study the global monodromy relation of the differential system that satisfies Riemann's bilinear relation. (d) We explicitly derive the function space of the iterated integrals in terms of elliptic multiple polylogs. (e) In impact-parameter space, the Fourier-transformed cut is a Bessel-twisted differential on the elliptic curve, which we show has extra involution symmetries. Thus, the parity of the differential further decides which quotient - rational or elliptic its periods live on. All results presented concern the maximal cut and, therefore, the homogeneous solutions, but they open an important pathway to tackling the full massive two-loop integral.

classification.title_zh: 引力散射中有质量圈的几何：最大切割、Riemann 双线性关系与亏格下降
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一类有代表性的两圈世界线量子场论积分，它们与带有大质量中介粒子的经典引力散射相关，并考察其最大切割的几何结构。我们发现，与无质量情形不同，有质量圈在两圈时已经给出椭圆最大切割；它在无质量极限和静态极限下退化为节点曲线。在全局 Baikov 表示中，两次相继积分把最大切割约化为一条椭圆曲线的周期。我们进一步确立本研究的五个主要结果：(a) 分部积分方法生成五个主积分；在反射下，它们分裂为一个三维椭圆块和一个二维多对数块。我们以两种方式推导微分方程：一种通过 Laporta 约化，随后在两组余圈基中通过相交理论推导，并构造它们之间的有理映射。(b) 任意维数下的周期矩阵已用 Appell 和 Beta 函数计算。此外，我们推导出扭曲 Riemann 周期关系，给出它们之间的九个二次恒等式。(c) 我们研究满足 Riemann 双线性关系的微分系统的全局单值关系。(d) 我们明确用椭圆多重多对数给出迭代积分的函数空间。(e) 在碰撞参数空间中，傅里叶变换后的切割是椭圆曲线上的 Bessel 扭曲微分；我们证明它具有额外的对合对称性。因此，该微分的宇称进一步决定其周期生活在哪个商上——有理商还是椭圆商。所有给出的结果都只涉及最大切割，因而涉及齐次解，但它们为处理完整的有质量两圈积分开辟了一条重要途径。
classification.one_liner: 分析经典引力散射中有质量中介的两圈世界线积分最大切割的几何，揭示椭圆周期、Riemann 双线性关系与亏格下降，为完整积分铺路。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要明确面向经典引力散射的圈积分与最大切割几何，属于经典引力/引力波散射振幅的数学物理分支；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2610.07353v1.title: The QCD phase diagram and critical end point at finite magnetic field from holography with neural networks
2610.07353v1.abstract: We study the magnetic-field-driven critical end point (CEP) of the QCD thermal transition at zero baryon chemical potential using a five-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton (EMD) model. We calibrate the model to lattice entropy at zero and finite magnetic fields using a neural-network formulation of holographic radial evolution. As the magnetic field increases, the thermal transition changes from a crossover to a first-order transition. The merger of temperature turning points, a divergent specific heat, and a vanishing squared sound speed identify $(eB_c,T_c)\simeq(7.22\,\mathrm{GeV}^{2},95.9\,\mathrm{MeV})$. The transition-region inflection of $s/T^3$ defines the crossover temperature, while an equal-pressure Maxwell construction determines the first-order coexistence line. The two lines meet at the CEP. The change of transition order agrees qualitatively with lattice results. The phase boundary is a prediction of the calibrated model.

classification.title_zh: 基于全息与神经网络的有限磁场 QCD 相图及临界端点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用五维 Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton（EMD）模型，研究零重子化学势下 QCD 热相变由磁场驱动的临界端点（CEP）。我们采用全息径向演化的神经网络表述，将模型在零磁场和有限磁场下校准到格点熵。随着磁场增大，热相变从交叉过渡变为一级相变。温度回折点的合并、比热的发散以及声速平方的消失，共同确定 (eB_c,T_c)≃(7.22 GeV^2, 95.9 MeV)。s/T^3 在相变区的拐点定义交叉温度，而等压 Maxwell 构造确定一级相变共存线。两条线在 CEP 相遇。相变序的变化与格点结果定性一致。相边界是该校准模型的预言。
classification.one_liner: 用五维 EMD 全息模型结合神经网络校准格点熵，预言有限磁场下 QCD 热相变的临界端点约为 (eB_c,T_c)≃(7.22 GeV^2, 95.9 MeV)。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD 与有限磁场相变研究，涉及临界端点和一级/交叉相变，与重点标签中的“相变与气泡成核”部分相关，但未直接涉及全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子等具体支线。

2610.07548v1.title: Spin-1 Bulk Local States in AdS/CFT and Carrollian Holography
2610.07548v1.abstract: We construct the bulk local states of a massive spin-1 field in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and three-dimensional Carrollian holography. In AdS, covariance under the isometries that leave a bulk point invariant determines the three components of the vector there and splits the solution into two branches of definite helicity, whose inner products reproduce the massive vector two-point function of AdS$_3$. By expanding the massive vector HKLL representation in boundary descendants, one can reproduce the three component states term by term. The two branches together describe the parity-invariant Proca field, and one alone the single propagating mode of Maxwell--Chern--Simons theory. The same conditions are solved in the induced representation of the Carrollian theory, where the solution again splits into two branches. Under the flat limit of the generators the highest weight module becomes the induced module, and the AdS states and Green's functions become their Carrollian counterparts, which supports the induced representation as the home of massive bulk excitations in Carrollian holography. This is the first bulk local state built with spin, complete from the state itself to its bulk-to-bulk propagator and to the limit relating the two descriptions.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 与 Carrollian 全息中的自旋-1 体局域态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了 AdS3/CFT2 以及三维 Carrollian 全息中一个大质量自旋-1 场的体局域态。在 AdS 中，保持一个体点不变的等距变换协变性决定了该点处矢量的三个分量，并将解分成两支具有确定螺旋度的分支，其内积重现 AdS3 的大质量矢量两点函数。通过将大质量矢量 HKLL 表示按边界后裔展开，可以逐项重现三个分量态。两支合起来描述宇称不变的 Proca 场，而单独一支描述 Maxwell-Chern-Simons 理论的单一传播模式。同样的条件在 Carrollian 理论的诱导表示中求解，解再次分成两支。在生成元的平直极限下，最高权模变为诱导模，AdS 态和格林函数变为其 Carrollian 对应物，这支持诱导表示作为 Carrollian 全息中大质量体激发的归属。这是首个带自旋的体局域态构造，从态本身到体-体传播子再到联系两种描述的极限均完整。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 与三维 Carrollian 全息中构造带自旋的体局域态，给出自旋-1 HKLL 态、传播子及平直极限对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础字典与 Carrollian 全息方向，但未涉及给定重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等具体研究支线。

2610.07746v1.title: Thermodynamics and mechanical laws of causal-diamond horizons
2610.07746v1.abstract: We develop a unified thermodynamic and mechanical framework for causal-diamond horizons in Minkowski spacetime. Euclidean regularity fixes the temperature $T_D=1/(\pi\alpha)$, where $2\alpha$ is the temporal extent of the diamond. The regulated Gibbons--Hawking--York contribution gives $I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)$, with $A_0$ the area of the horizon bifurcation surface, and the vanishing equilibrium geometric energy then yields the entropy--area relation $S_D=A_0/(4G)$. For weak matter perturbations crossing a localized portion of the future horizon, a Raychaudhuri analysis relates the associated Killing-energy flux to the area response, yielding a local physical-process first law at leading order near the bifurcation surface and, for classical matter satisfying the null energy condition, a local second law. Uniform conformal surface gravity establishes the zeroth law, while zero temperature is approached only in the limit $\alpha\to\infty$, in which the finite causal horizon disappears. These results show that a coherent horizon-law structure can arise within a causal diamond, a fundamental building block of the causal structure of Minkowski spacetime. The derivation is explicit in $(2+1)$ dimensions, while the physical results retain the same form for spherical causal diamonds in $d\geq3$.

classification.title_zh: 因果钻石视界的热力学与力学定律
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为闵可夫斯基时空中的因果钻石视界发展了统一的热力学与力学框架。欧几里得正则性确定温度 T_D=1/(πα)，其中 2α 是钻石的时间延展。正规化的 Gibbons-Hawking-York 贡献给出 I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)，其中 A_0 是视界分叉面的面积，而平衡几何能量消失则给出熵-面积关系 S_D=A_0/(4G)。对于穿过未来视界局域部分的弱物质扰动，Raychaudhuri 分析将相关的 Killing 能量通量与面积响应联系起来，在分叉面附近至领先阶给出局域物理过程第一定律，并且对于满足零能量条件的经典物质，给出局域第二定律。均匀共形表面引力确立了第零定律，而零温度仅在 α→∞ 极限下趋近，此时有限因果视界消失。这些结果表明，在因果钻石——闵可夫斯基时空因果结构的基本构件——内部可以出现一致的视界定律结构。推导在 (2+1) 维中显式给出，而物理结果对 d≥3 的球形因果钻石保持相同形式。
classification.one_liner: 在闵可夫斯基时空的因果钻石中，由欧几里得正则性导出温度与熵面积关系，并建立局域视界第一、第二和第零定律。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论经典时空中的因果钻石视界热力学与力学定律，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；未涉及 AdS/CFT 等全息对偶，因此不归为理论全息。

2610.08113v1.title: Conformal Anomalies and Generalised Energy Conservation in De Sitter Spacetime
2610.08113v1.abstract: We show that for bulk discrete series fields whose dual operators have integer conformal dimensions, the Generalised Energy Conservation (GEC) condition for de Sitter (dS) scattering amplitudes defined in even-dimensional extended Poincar\'e spacetime corresponds precisely to the absence of boundary conformal anomalies, including beta-function contributions, at the level of tree-level contact interactions. In contrast, holographic consistency in AdS/CFT enforces only the locality of the conformal anomaly. We find novel, unique four-point interactions involving three identical conformally coupled scalars and one discrete series scalar by performing both GEC and holographic bootstraps. This demonstrates that the solutions to GEC form a measure-zero subset of the holographically consistent solutions. Our holographic analysis agrees precisely with the expected renormalisation conditions for conformal field theory correlators. In addition, the constraint for a particular four-point configuration may be relevant for testing holographic consistency of scale-separated non-supersymmetric AdS$_4$ vacua.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 时空中的共形反常与广义能量守恒
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，对于体离散系列场，其对偶算符具有整数共形维数，在偶数维扩展庞加莱时空中定义的 de Sitter (dS) 散射振幅的广义能量守恒（GEC）条件，在树级接触相互作用层面，精确对应于边界共形反常（包括 beta 函数贡献）的缺失。相比之下，AdS/CFT 中的全息一致性只要求共形反常的局域性。通过执行 GEC 和全息 bootstrap，我们发现了新颖且唯一的四点相互作用，涉及三个相同的共形耦合标量和一个离散系列标量。这表明 GEC 的解构成全息一致解的一个零测度子集。我们的全息分析与共形场论关联函数所预期的重整化条件精确一致。此外，某个特定四点组态的约束可能有助于检验尺度分离的非超对称 AdS$_4$ 真空的全息一致性。
classification.one_liner: 在 dS 散射的 GEC 与 AdS/CFT 全息一致性之间建立联系，发现 GEC 解是全息一致解中的零测度子集，并给出新的四点相互作用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与 dS 全息一致性的理论研究，涉及共形反常、GEC 和全息 bootstrap；但与用户列出的具体重点标签（如全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、multi-trace、QNM与非线性演化等）没有直接对应。

2610.08397v1.title: Relative-Entropy Flow Across the Page Transition
2610.08397v1.abstract: We develop a computational framework for the quantum relative entropy based on the replica trick and apply it to analyze the evaporation process method of Jackiw-Teitelboim black holes. We show that the relative entropies between the exact radiation state and the Hawking saddle state and the replica wormholes saddle state quantify information-theoretic costs inherent to coarse-grained semiclassical descriptions. During evaporation, the relative entropy for the Hawking saddle increases monotonically, reflecting a progressively higher thermodynamic cost of sustaining the Hawking description. Conversely, the relative entropy associated with the replica wormholes saddle decreases, which indicates that the description of connected geometries becomes progressively more accurate. Moreover, the sign of the difference between the two quantities reverses precisely at the Page time, providing an information-theoretic diagnosis for the transition between competing gravitational saddles. Our results recast the Page transition as a flow of relative entropy costs between competing semi-classical descriptions, revealing an information-theoretic structure underlying the emergence of effective irreversibility in coarse-grained black hole evaporation.

classification.title_zh: 跨 Page 转变的相对熵流
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于复制技巧发展了一个量子相对熵的计算框架，并将其用于分析 Jackiw-Teitelboim 黑洞的蒸发过程。我们表明，精确辐射态与 Hawking 鞍点态以及复制虫洞鞍点态之间的相对熵，量化了粗粒化半经典描述所固有的信息论成本。在蒸发过程中，Hawking 鞍点的相对熵单调增加，反映出维持 Hawking 描述的热力学成本逐渐升高。相反，与复制虫洞鞍点相关的相对熵下降，表明连通几何的描述逐渐变得更准确。此外，这两个量之差在 Page 时间精确变号，为竞争引力鞍点之间的转变提供了信息论诊断。我们的结果将 Page 转变重新表述为竞争半经典描述之间相对熵成本的流动，揭示了粗粒化黑洞蒸发中有效不可逆性涌现背后的信息论结构。
classification.one_liner: 用相对熵流动刻画 JT 黑洞蒸发中 Hawking 鞍点与复制虫洞鞍点在 Page 时间前后的竞争与切换。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞信息、JT 引力与全息量子信息方向，涉及复制虫洞和 Page 转变；但未直接落在用户列出的全息凝聚态、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM 等具体重点标签上。

2610.08545v1.title: Glueball gravitational form factors in dynamical holography
2610.08545v1.abstract: We present the first holographic study of gravitational form factors (GFFs) of scalar, pseudoscalar and canonical-spin-averaged tensor glueball targets. These observables test gravitational cubic couplings whose physical validity is not established by spectra and static-force calibration. We construct a dynamical Einstein--scalar--axion representation inspired by the Babington--Crooks--Evans adjoint-mass deformation of $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory and its Type-IIB supergravity dual. Leading ultraviolet source data are retained, while a soft-wall-like infrared reconstruction incorporates asymptotically linear radial mass-squared trajectories. Spectra and Wilson observables fix the parameters at a common Sommer scale without GFF input. The full constrained cubic vertices fail to describe 27 correlated scalar lattice observations, giving $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=73.60/27=2.73$. We propose normalized heavy-target (HT) effective cubic couplings for pure-glue matching. HT adopts leading radial shapes suggested by infinitely heavy targets at fixed probe dynamics and normalizes their overlap weights on the physical ground states. With the background, modes and propagators unchanged, HT gives $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=16.98/27=0.63$, without numerical adjustment to GFF data. Tensor and scalar source overlaps determine $A$ and the physical normalized trace; the exact finite-mass energy--momentum-tensor relation determines $D$. We predict the pseudoscalar and tensor form factors and three-target Breit pressure and shear profiles. On the reference infrared-decaying axion branch, the HT Breit mass radii are $0.276$, $0.300$ and $0.311\,\mathrm{fm}$, respectively. The results identify gravitational cubic matching as a distinct step beyond background calibration and provide a prescription for further lattice tests.

classification.title_zh: 动力学全息中的胶球引力形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首次在全息框架下研究标量、赝标量以及正则自旋平均张量胶球靶的引力形状因子（GFFs）。这些观测量检验引力三次耦合，而其物理有效性并不能由谱和静态力校准确定。我们构造了一个动力学 Einstein--scalar--axion 表示，其灵感来自 N=4 super-Yang--Mills 理论的 Babington--Crooks--Evans 伴随质量形变及其 Type-IIB 超引力对偶。保留领头紫外源数据，同时类软墙红外重构纳入渐近线性的径向质量平方轨迹。谱和 Wilson 观测量在共同 Sommer 标度下固定参数，且不使用 GFF 输入。完整约束的三次顶点无法描述 27 个相关的标量格点观测，给出 χ²/dof=73.60/27=2.73。我们提出用于纯胶球匹配的归一化重靶（HT）有效三次耦合。HT 采用固定探针动力学下由无穷重靶提示的领头径向形状，并在物理基态上归一化其重叠权重。在背景、模式和传播子不变的情况下，HT 给出 χ²/dof=16.98/27=0.63，且未对 GFF 数据进行数值调整。张量和标量源重叠决定 A 和物理归一化迹；精确的有限质量能量--动量张量关系决定 D。我们预言赝标量和张量形状因子，以及三靶 Breit 压强和剪切剖面。在参考的红外衰减 axion 分支上，HT Breit 质量半径分别为 0.276、0.300 和 0.311 fm。结果将引力三次匹配识别为超越背景校准的一个独立步骤，并为进一步的格点检验提供了方案。
classification.one_liner: 在动力学全息 QCD 模型中首次计算标量、赝标量和张量胶球的引力形状因子，并提出重靶有效三次耦合使格点比较显著改善。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息QCD/胶球研究，但未命中用户列出的重点支线标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）。

2610.08632v1.title: Light bending at two-loop order from scattering amplitudes
2610.08632v1.abstract: We calculate the conservative deflection of a photon by a massive spinless source, such as a black hole, at third post-Minkowskian order using scattering amplitudes. We work in the heavy-source and long-range limits and adopt the geometric-optics approximation. The required five-point photon-graviton tree amplitude is constructed by on-shell recursion and sewn to three scalar-graviton vertices across a five-fold cut. Polynomial division organizes the cut information into sixteen contributions, including the residues with fewer propagators. We perform the source energy integrations and retain the near-on-shell photon regions in the remaining spatial integrals. Within the static region in which all exchanged momenta are soft, we relate a photon pole prescription to the subtraction of the cubic tree iteration from the conservative kernel. The sum of the sixteen contributions determines the classical logarithmic term at two loops. Its transverse Fourier transform gives the interaction radial action and yields the third-order deflection angle. The result agrees with the weak-deflection expansion of Schwarzschild null geodesics and demonstrates how nonlinear classical light bending is encoded in loop amplitudes around flat spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 从散射振幅计算双圈阶光偏折
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用散射振幅计算光子被大质量无自旋源（如黑洞）在第三后闵可夫斯基阶的保守偏折。我们在重源和长程极限下工作，并采用几何光学近似。所需的五点光子-引力子树振幅通过壳上递推构造，并通过五重割缝与三个标量-引力子顶点缝合。多项式除法将割缝信息组织为十六个贡献，包括具有较少传播子的留数。我们执行源能量积分，并在剩余空间积分中保留近壳光子区域。在所有交换动量均为软的静态区域中，我们将光子极点规定与从保守核中减去三次树迭代联系起来。十六个贡献之和确定了双圈阶的经典对数项。其横向傅里叶变换给出相互作用径向作用量并产生三阶偏折角。结果与 Schwarzschild 零测地线的弱偏折展开一致，并展示了非线性经典光偏折如何编码在平直时空周围的圈振幅中。
classification.one_liner: 用散射振幅方法计算光子被黑洞偏折的第三后闵可夫斯基阶经典结果，并与 Schwarzschild 弱偏折展开一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的后闵可夫斯基光偏折，属于用户重点关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2609.18790v2.title: Symmetry-Driven $k$-Essence Cosmological Dynamics
2609.18790v2.abstract: We investigate a family of $k$-essence cosmological models selected by the requirement that the field equations admit a nontrivial variational symmetry. Inside this general family of theories, we concentrate on the simplest modification to quintessence, induced by power-law terms of the kinetic energy. The symmetry generator introduces a conservation law which we use to obtain an exact vacuum solution. We generalize our analysis and investigate the structure of the phase-space of the cosmological field equations by performing a dynamical systems analysis, both in the absence and the presence of a pressureless matter source. We employ Hubble-normalized variables and the Poincar\'{e} compactification, so as to determine the asymptotic behavior of the model and identify all admissible cosmological epochs, from early-time to late-time behavior. We discuss in detail the existence and stability conditions of each fixed point as functions of the free parameters, and characterize the full asymptotic structure of the cosmological history as provided by this symmetry-driven $k$-essence model. We explore the conditions under which the model can describe cosmic acceleration. We find that this $k$-essence model successfully describes the inflationary epoch with a natural exit to the matter-dominated era, with the inflaton ultimately evolving to a dark matter source.

classification.title_zh: 对称性驱动的 k-essence 宇宙学动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一类 k-essence 宇宙学模型，其筛选条件是场方程允许非平凡变分对称性。在该一般理论族中，我们关注对精质模型的最简单修正，即由动能幂律项诱导的修正。对称生成元给出一个守恒律，我们用它获得精确真空解。我们推广分析，通过动力学系统分析研究宇宙学场方程相空间结构，分别考虑无压强物质源存在与不存在的情形。采用哈勃归一化变量和 Poincaré 紧致化，以确定模型的渐近行为并识别所有允许的宇宙学时期，从早期到晚期的行为。我们详细讨论每个不动点的存在性与稳定性条件对自由参数的依赖，并刻画该对称性驱动 k-essence 模型给出的宇宙历史完整渐近结构。我们探讨模型描述宇宙加速的条件。发现该 k-essence 模型成功描述暴胀时期，并自然退出到物质主导时期，最终暴胀子演化为暗物质源。
classification.one_liner: 通过动力学系统分析，研究具有变分对称性的 k-essence 宇宙学模型，发现其可实现暴胀并自然退出至物质主导，最终以暗物质形式演化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典宇宙学与修改引力模型，不涉及 AdS/CFT、量子引力或全息对偶，与用户全息重点标签无直接交叉。

2610.06954v1.title: The pseudospectrum for gravitational perturbations in Kerr spacetimes
2610.06954v1.abstract: We study the pseudospectrum of the Kerr black hole for gravitational perturbations with spin weight $s=2$, the case of greatest interest in gravitational-wave astronomy. In the hyperboloidal framework with two-dimensional Chebyshev collocation, we formulate the quasinormal mode problem as a non-self-adjoint eigenvalue problem. For $s\neq0$ the fields $\Psi^{(s)}$ and $\Psi^{(-s)}$ are independent, so the conserved current method yields no single-field energy norm. We overcome this with the Teukolsky--Starobinsky identities, which relate $\Psi^{(-2)}$ to a fourth-order operator on $\Psi^{(2)}$ and yield an $H^2$ energy norm after symmetrization. With the $H^1$ norm known for $s=0$, this suggests the pattern $H^{|s|}$, verified for $s=0$ and $s=2$. All results use an $\omega$-independent two-field hierarchy. We find that the pseudospectrum tightens by $1.1$ to $3.5$ decades at each step of $L^2\to H^1\to H^2$, yet stays large in every norm. The $s=+2$ and $s=-2$ operators are isospectral but not isopseudospectral: at twelve of fourteen probes the $\psi_0$ resolvent exceeds the $\psi_4$ one by $0.19$ to $0.82$ decades in the $H^2$ norm, while at the two probes furthest along the QNM line the ordering reverses by $0.18$ to $0.19$ decades. The gravitational pseudospectrum exceeds the scalar one by $0.5$ to $5.2$ decades in the window minimum and by $5.9$ decades in $L^2$ at $\omega M=0.47-0.17\,i$, while along the damping direction the $s=2$ resolvent is non-monotonic and the $s=0$ resolvent smooth. QNM spectral instability is therefore a universal feature of Kerr, and is stronger for gravitational perturbations.

classification.title_zh: Kerr时空中引力扰动的赝谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究Kerr黑洞自旋权重 s=2 的引力扰动赝谱，这是引力波天文学中最受关注的情形。在双曲型框架下，结合二维Chebyshev配点法，我们将准正规模问题表述为非自伴本征值问题。对于 s≠0，场 Ψ^(s) 与 Ψ^(-s) 相互独立，因此守恒流方法不能给出单场能量范数。我们借助Teukolsky--Starobinsky恒等式克服这一问题，该恒等式将 Ψ^(-2) 与作用在 Ψ^(2) 上的四阶算符联系起来，并在对称化后给出 H^2 能量范数。由于 s=0 的 H^1 范数已知，这提示 H^{|s|} 模式，并在 s=0 与 s=2 得到验证。所有结果使用与 ω 无关的两场层级。我们发现，在 L^2→H^1→H^2 的每一步，赝谱收紧 1.1 至 3.5 个数量级，但在每种范数下仍然很大。s=+2 与 s=-2 算符具有相同谱但并非等赝谱：在十四个探针中的十二个，ψ0 预解式在 H^2 范数下比 ψ4 大 0.19 至 0.82 个数量级；而在沿QNM线最远的两个探针处，顺序反转 0.18 至 0.19 个数量级。引力赝谱在窗口最小值处比标量赝谱大 0.5 至 5.2 个数量级，并在 ωM=0.47−0.17i 处在 L^2 中大约大 5.9 个数量级；而沿阻尼方向，s=2 预解式非单调，s=0 预解式平滑。因此，QNM谱不稳定性是Kerr的普遍特征，且对引力扰动更强。
classification.one_liner: 利用双曲型框架和Teukolsky--Starobinsky恒等式构造Kerr引力扰动的H^2能量范数，发现s=2赝谱比标量更大，QNM谱不稳定性对引力扰动更强。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究Kerr黑洞QNM、赝谱与谱稳定性，属于经典引力/黑洞扰动理论，并与QNM重点支线高度相关。

2610.07142v1.title: The quasinormal modes of Kerr-Newman black holes: a separated approach
2610.07142v1.abstract: We compute Kerr-Newman quasinormal modes using a recently found exact separation of the gravitoelectric perturbation equations. For each spin-label $\varsigma=\pm1$, a matrix angular ordinary differential equation and a scalar second-order radial ordinary differential equation define a joint spectral problem for the complex frequency $\omega$ and separation constant $\lambda$. We solve this problem by imposing regularity at the angular poles, ingoing behavior at the event horizon, and outgoing behavior at infinity. We benchmark the numerical code built to solve the separated equations, and the resulting frequencies, against recently published spectral calculations of the coupled system. Comparisons with those results yield absolute differences of order $10^{-10}$ to $10^{-5}$, depending on the BH parameters and overtone number. We also find numerical hints of spin-label isospectrality in both the electromagnetic-led and gravitational-led sectors of fundamental quasinormal modes, even at near-extremal Kerr-Newman configurations. These results provide numerical evidence that the separated equations reproduce Kerr-Newman quasinormal frequencies and offer a practical route to exploring the ringdown of rotating, charged black holes.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman 黑洞的准正规模式：一种分离方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用最近发现的 gravitoelectric 微扰方程精确分离，计算了 Kerr-Newman 准正规模式。对于每个自旋标签（取值 ±1），一个矩阵型角向常微分方程和一个标量二阶径向常微分方程定义了关于复频率 ω 和分离常数 λ 的联合谱问题。我们通过施加角向极点处的正则性、事件视界处的入射行为以及无穷远处的出射行为来求解该问题。我们将为求解分离方程所构建的数值代码及所得频率，与最近发表的耦合系统谱计算结果进行基准测试。与这些结果的比较给出绝对差异在 10^{-10} 到 10^{-5} 量级，具体取决于黑洞参数和泛音数。我们还在基本准正规模式的电磁主导和引力主导扇区中发现自旋标签等谱性的数值迹象，即使在近极端 Kerr-Newman 构型中也是如此。这些结果提供了分离方程能够重现 Kerr-Newman 准正规频率的数值证据，并为探索旋转带电黑洞的 ringdown 提供了一条实用途径。
classification.one_liner: 用精确分离的 gravitoelectric 微扰方程计算 Kerr-Newman 黑洞准正规模，并与耦合谱结果吻合。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 Kerr-Newman 黑洞准正规模式与经典黑洞微扰的分离求解，匹配用户重点标签中的 QNM 与经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

2610.07166v1.title: Propagation and horizon formation in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet scalar collapse. I. Characteristic conditions, bounds and formation
2610.07166v1.abstract: We study scalar collapse in five- and six-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with positive coupling, treated as an exact classical theory. On spherical scalar backgrounds, the characteristic conditions of the tensor, vector and scalar gravitational sectors reduce to inequalities in two local invariants: $K=1+\tilde\alpha F/R^2$, which compares the enclosed mass with the areal radius $R$, and a scalar-gradient invariant $j$. In five dimensions they imply $R_h^2>\tilde\alpha$ for the areal radius $R_h$ of a regular marginal sphere on the GR branch and the sharp bound $\tilde\alpha^2\mathcal R_{abcd}\mathcal R^{abcd}<28$ for nonnegative mass. For initially untrapped five-dimensional spherical data with a regular center, a bound on $K$ alone ensures smooth continuation on compact domains of dependence, so any first characteristic loss occurs on a smooth background, and a marginal sphere formed before any loss forces a later loss. Complete smooth data form marginal spheres at every allowed radius with mass arbitrarily close to its sharp lower bound; in six dimensions radius and mass can both be arbitrarily small. Without spherical symmetry, complete initial data with weak curvature contain, at sufficiently large scale, outermost strictly stable marginal surfaces with prescribed $S^3$ geometries satisfying a spectral condition; Berger surfaces among them have arbitrarily small area at fixed mass. Their formation from untrapped data is left open. Near a contracting homogeneous core, exact nonspherical developments of smooth constrained data converging with every derivative have bounded curvature but, after the core's characteristic loss, a fixed discrepancy in a geometric tidal record. Classical existence, local geometric uniqueness and continuity of this pointwise record cannot all be guaranteed on a common observation region. A companion paper treats narrow incoming pulses.

classification.title_zh: Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 标量坍缩中的传播与视界形成。I. 特征条件、界限与形成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了五维和六维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中正耦合下的标量坍缩，将其视为精确经典理论。在球对称标量背景上，张量、矢量和标量引力扇区的特征条件约化为两个局部不变量的不等式：$K=1+\tilde\alpha F/R^2$，它比较包围质量与面积半径 $R$；以及标量梯度不变量 $j$。在五维中，它们对 GR 分支上正则边缘球的面积半径 $R_h$ 意味着 $R_h^2>\tilde\alpha$，并对非负质量给出尖锐界限 $\tilde\alpha^2\mathcal R_{abcd}\mathcal R^{abcd}<28$。对于具有正则中心的初始未捕获的五维球对称数据，仅对 $K$ 的界就保证了在紧致依赖域上的光滑延拓，因此任何首次特征损失都发生在光滑背景上，而在任何损失之前形成的边缘球迫使之后的损失。完全光滑的数据在每个允许半径处形成边缘球，其质量任意接近其尖锐下界；在六维中半径和质量都可以任意小。没有球对称性时，具有弱曲率的完全初始数据在足够大的尺度上包含最外层的严格稳定边缘面，其具有规定的 $S^3$ 几何并满足一个谱条件；其中的 Berger 面在固定质量下具有任意小的面积。它们从未捕获数据的形成仍悬而未决。在收缩均匀核心附近，光滑约束数据的精确非球对称发展以每个导数收敛，具有有界曲率，但在核心的特征损失之后，几何潮汐记录中出现固定差异。经典存在性、局部几何唯一性和该逐点记录的连续性不能在一个共同观测区域上同时得到保证。一篇伴随论文处理窄入射脉冲。
classification.one_liner: 研究五维和六维 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中标量坍缩的特征条件、边缘面形成与视界形成，给出尖锐界限并讨论非球对称情形。

2610.07200v1.title: Where the Gauss--Bonnet coupling enters the Bondi--Sachs hierarchy
2610.07200v1.abstract: We integrate the Bondi--Sachs hierarchy of scalar--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with an arbitrary coupling function $f(\Phi)$ and a radiating massless scalar, and determine the first order in $1/r$ at which the coupling $\lambda$ becomes visible in each field equation. We obtain the asymptotic falloff of the effective Gauss--Bonnet stress tensor together with its leading coefficients in covariant form on the sphere: every component decays between one and three powers of $1/r$ faster than the slowest falloff compatible with a smooth null infinity. As a consequence, (i) the Bondi mass-loss formula and the evolution equation of the angular-momentum aspect are those of the minimally coupled Einstein--scalar system, a statement that is exact in $\lambda$ under the assumption of a smooth expansion; (ii) the coupling generates no logarithmic terms through the orders considered, even though the Horndeski representation of the theory involves logarithmic functionals; and (iii) the coupling first enters a dynamical equation in the evolution of the $O(r^{-3})$ coefficient of the angular metric, through the cross term $-2\lambda f'(\vp_0)\,\vp_1\,\partial_u N_{AB}$ between the asymptotic scalar charge aspect and the time derivative of the news. In Newman--Penrose form, the evolution equation of the leading coefficient of $\Psi_0$ acquires the source $-12\lambda f'(\vp_0)\,\vp_1\bar\Psi_4^0$, while those of $\Psi_1$ and $\Psi_2$ are unchanged. The Gauss--Bonnet invariant decays as $r^{-6}$ and affects the scalar hierarchy only from the evolution of the $r^{-5}$ coefficient onward. For vacuum black-hole spacetimes, where the scalar is sourced by the coupling itself, all these effects are of order $\lambda^2$; if $f'(\vp_0)=0$ they are pushed one further order in $1/r$.

classification.title_zh: Gauss--Bonnet 耦合在 Bondi--Sachs 层级中的进入位置
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将标量--Gauss--Bonnet 引力的 Bondi--Sachs 层级与任意耦合函数 f(Φ) 及一个辐射无质量标量场结合起来，并确定耦合 λ 在每个场方程中从 1/r 的哪一阶开始可见。我们得到有效 Gauss--Bonnet 应力张量的渐近衰减，以及其在球面上协变形式的首阶系数：与光滑零无穷远相容的最慢衰减相比，每个分量都额外衰减 1 到 3 个 1/r 幂次。因此，(i) 在光滑展开假设下，Bondi 质量损失公式和角动量 aspect 的演化方程与最小耦合 Einstein--标量系统相同，这一结论对 λ 精确成立；(ii) 在所考虑的阶数内，耦合不产生对数项，尽管该理论的 Horndeski 表述涉及对数泛函；(iii) 耦合首次进入动力学方程是在角向度规 O(r^{-3}) 系数的演化中，通过渐近标量荷 aspect 与 news 的时间导数之间的交叉项 -2λ f'(φ_0) φ_1 ∂_u N_{AB}。在 Newman--Penrose 形式中，Ψ_0 的首阶系数的演化方程获得源项 -12λ f'(φ_0) φ_1  arΨ_4^0，而 Ψ_1 和 Ψ_2 的演化方程不变。Gauss--Bonnet 不变量以 r^{-6} 衰减，并且只从 r^{-5} 系数的演化开始影响标量层级。对于真空黑洞时空，标量由耦合自身作为源，所有这些效应均为 λ^2 阶；若 f'(φ_0)=0，它们被推到 1/r 的再高一阶。
classification.one_liner: 在标量–Gauss–Bonnet 引力的 Bondi–Sachs 渐近层级中，耦合 λ 首次在角向度规 O(r^{-3}) 演化中动力学出现，但不改变 Bondi 质量损失与角动量演化。

2610.07748v1.title: Charged soliton--black hole phase transitions in three-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity
2610.07748v1.abstract: We construct a magnetic soliton by double Wick rotating the static electrically charged black hole in three-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity. We match the boundary metrics and Maxwell sources under the chosen boundary condition and compute the difference of the renormalized Euclidean actions. Because the Maxwell potential grows logarithmically at infinity, the chosen finite Maxwell boundary term changes both the fixed Maxwell source and the renormalized action. The charge contributions for both the soliton and the black hole appear with plus signs in $\Delta I^{(c_{\mathrm{fin}})}$. For the grand-canonical boundary condition $c_{\mathrm{fin}}=1$, the black-hole and soliton branches can cross with different slopes. For the example considered below, the black-hole branch satisfying the response conditions ends at a maximum temperature, and the coexistence curve has a $T\to0^+$ endpoint at two opposite values of the spatial Maxwell source. At a nonextremal crossing, the entropy difference is $S_b-S_s=S_b$. For these two static solutions, equality of both current components requires both charges to vanish.

classification.title_zh: 三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的带电孤子--黑洞相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过双 Wick 旋转三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的静态带电黑洞，构造了一个磁孤子。我们在所选边界条件下匹配边界度规与 Maxwell 源，并计算重整化欧几里得作用量之差。由于 Maxwell 势在无穷远处呈对数增长，所选的有限 Maxwell 边界项同时改变固定的 Maxwell 源和重整化作用量。孤子与黑洞的电荷贡献在 $\Delta I^{(c_{\mathrm{fin}})}$ 中均以正号出现。对于巨正则边界条件 $c_{\mathrm{fin}}=1$，黑洞支与孤子支可以以不同斜率相交。在下面考虑的示例中，满足响应条件的黑洞支终止于一个最高温度，共存曲线在两个相反的空间 Maxwell 源值处具有 $T\to0^+$ 端点。在非极端相交处，熵差为 $S_b-S_s=S_b$。对于这两个静态解，要求两个流分量相等将使两个电荷都为零。
classification.one_liner: 在三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中构造带电黑洞双 Wick 旋转得到的磁孤子，并研究巨正则系综下孤子--黑洞相变、作用量差与 Maxwell 边界项效应。

2610.08045v1.title: Third-order scalar induced gravitational waves during a matter-dominated era: secular growth and implications for primordial black hole domination
2610.08045v1.abstract: We investigate scalar induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) at third-order during a matter-dominated (MD) era. We classify the sources into four parts---built from three first-order scalars, and from a first-order scalar times the second-order tensor, vector, and scalar perturbations---and obtain all four kernel functions analytically in closed form. Unlike their radiation-dominated counterparts, the MD kernel functions grow secularly, translating into a rapid growth of the spectrum, $\Omega^{(3)}_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto x^{6}$ versus $\Omega^{(2)}_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto x^{2}$ at $x\equiv k\eta\gg1$. We derive the third-order power spectrum as a five-fold integral for a general primordial spectrum, and evaluate it numerically for a monochromatic one, where all contributions from the second-order vector source vanish identically. As an application, we consider the early MD era driven by primordial black holes (PBHs) before their evaporation. Requiring that the induced gravitational waves do not backreact on the cosmological perturbations, $\int\mathrm{d}\ln k\, \Omega^{\mathrm{tot}}_{\mathrm{GW}}<1$ then bounds the initial PBH abundance as $\Omega_{\mathrm{PBH},f}\lesssim4.6\times10^{-7}\, (m_{\mathrm{PBH}}/10^{7}\,\mathrm{g})^{-0.48}$, about three orders of magnitude stronger than the second-order-only bound. Our results indicate that higher-order SIGWs inevitably become nonperturbative during a sufficiently long MD era, with important implications for scenarios involving an early matter domination.

classification.title_zh: 物质主导时代的三阶标量诱导引力波：长期增长及对原初黑洞主导的启示
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究物质主导（MD）时代的三阶标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）。我们将源分为四部分——由三个一阶标量构成，以及由一阶标量乘以二阶张量、矢量和标量扰动构成——并以闭式解析形式获得全部四个核函数。与辐射主导情形不同，MD核函数会长期增长，从而导致谱的快速增长，当 x≡kη≫1 时，Ω^{(3)}_{GW}∝x^6，而 Ω^{(2)}_{GW}∝x^2。我们推导了一般原初谱下三阶功率谱的五重积分，并对单色谱进行了数值计算，其中来自二阶矢量源的所有贡献恒为零。作为一个应用，我们考虑原初黑洞（PBHs）在其蒸发前驱动的早期MD时代。要求诱导引力波不对宇宙学扰动产生反作用，即 ∫d ln k Ω^{tot}_{GW}<1，会给出初始PBH丰度的上限 Ω_{PBH,f}≲4.6×10^{-7}(m_{PBH}/10^7 g)^{-0.48}，比仅考虑二阶的界限强约三个数量级。我们的结果表明，在足够长的MD时代中，高阶SIGWs不可避免地会变为非微扰的，这对涉及早期物质主导的情形具有重要意义。
classification.one_liner: 物质主导时期三阶标量诱导引力波核函数呈长期增长，使PBH丰度上限比二阶结果强约三个数量级。

2610.08083v1.title: Probing beyond the Cosmic Horizon
2610.08083v1.abstract: There are reasons to believe that the region of uniform curvature that we observe within our horizon is perhaps a tiny patch, much smaller than the length scales of inhomogeneity and global connectivity of an extremely complicated manifold. However, the recent supernova (SN) results suggest that the horizon scale could be comparable to or even much larger than curvature radius. Non trivial global structure too tends to be of the order of the local curvature scale. Probing (slightly) beyond the cosmic horizon can potentially reveal nontrivial global structure lurking around or just beyond the horizon scale. The cosmic microwave background (CMB) anisotropy is a sensitive probe of the universe on length scales up to and somewhats beyond the horizon scale and is perhaps poised to detect or put interesting limits on nontrivial features the global structure. This point is exemplified by high CMB anisotropy signal of the Elliptical topology in a large fraction of the revised parameter space of the closed FRW universe (spherical geometry) currently preferred by SN observations.

classification.title_zh: 探测宇宙视界之外
classification.abstract_zh: 有理由相信，我们在视界内观测到的均匀曲率区域可能只是一个极小的斑块，远小于一个极其复杂流形的非均匀性和整体连通性的长度尺度。然而，最近的超新星（SN）结果表明，视界尺度可能与曲率半径相当，甚至远大于曲率半径。非平凡的全局结构也趋向于局域曲率尺度的量级。探测（略微）超出宇宙视界，可能揭示潜藏在视界尺度附近或刚刚超出视界尺度的非平凡全局结构。宇宙微波背景（CMB）各向异性是探测宇宙在直至并略微超过视界尺度上的敏感探针，或许有望探测到全局结构的非平凡特征，或对其给出有意义的限制。最近被超新星观测偏好的闭合 FRW 宇宙（球面几何）的修正参数空间中，椭圆拓扑对应的高 CMB 各向异性信号在一个大参数比例上体现了这一点。
classification.one_liner: 探测略超出宇宙视界可通过 CMB 各向异性约束闭合 FRW 宇宙中的非平凡全局拓扑结构。

2610.08099v1.title: Regular black holes do not violate the first law of thermodynamics
2610.08099v1.abstract: Regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics have been reported to exhibit an apparent mismatch in their thermodynamics: the temperature obtained by differentiating the mass along the family of regular metrics differs from the Hawking temperature by a factor $\Xi$, and the first law seems to need a modified entropy or a corrected internal energy. We examine this question for an electrically charged family of regular black holes in $D\geq4$ dimensions whose metrics reduce to the Bardeen and Hayward geometries in four dimensions. The source is written as a Hamiltonian density $H(P)$ with fixed couplings and no solution parameters. This theory has a two-parameter family of static solutions, of which the regular metrics form a one-parameter subfamily. We prove analytically that on the whole solution space the standard first law of thermodynamics holds with the Hawking temperature, the area entropy and the horizon potential, in agreement with the general first law for nonlinear electrodynamics. The factor $\Xi$ appears when the mass is differentiated along the regular metric family at fixed length parameter, a variation that moves through the space of theories and also changes the conserved charge. We show that $\Xi^{-1}$ is the Jacobian of this projection, equal to the fraction of the mass inside the horizon, give its general form for an arbitrary regular mass function, and show that $\Xi^{-1}dM_{ADM}$ is not a closed one-form on the two-parameter metric family, so this correction cannot be the differential of a local state function there. We also point out that the Legendre map between the $F$ and $P$ frames degenerates at a radius that lies outside the horizon of near-extremal solutions in $D\geq5$.

classification.title_zh: 规则黑洞不违反热力学第一定律
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论与非线性电动力学耦合的框架中，规则黑洞曾被报道在其热力学上存在表观不匹配：沿规则度规族对质量求导得到的温度与 Hawking 温度相差一个因子 Ξ，并且第一定律似乎需要修正熵或修正内能。我们针对 D≥4 维的一类带电梯规则黑洞研究这一问题，其度规在四维退化为 Bardeen 和 Hayward 几何。源被写为具有固定耦合且不含解参数的哈密顿密度 H(P)。该理论具有双参数静态解族，其中规则度规构成一个单参数子族。我们解析证明，在整个解空间上，标准热力学第一定律以 Hawking 温度、面积熵和视界势成立，这与非线性电动力学的一般第一定律一致。因子 Ξ 出现在固定长度参数下沿规则度规族对质量求导时，这种变分穿过理论空间并改变守恒荷。我们证明 Ξ^{-1} 是这一投影的 Jacobian，等于视界内质量占比，给出任意规则质量函数的一般形式，并表明 Ξ^{-1}dM_ADM 在双参数度规族上不是闭一形式，因此该修正不能是该处局部状态函数的微分。我们还指出，在 D≥5 的近极端解中，F 与 P 框架之间的 Legendre 映射在一个位于视界之外的半径处退化。
classification.one_liner: 该文解析证明规则黑洞在整个双参数解空间上满足标准热力学第一定律，并说明表观 Ξ 因子来自沿规则子族投影的雅可比，而非局部状态函数修正。

2610.08254v1.title: Gravitational Waves and Nambu-Goldstone Bosons from Infrared-Finite Cosmic Strings
2610.08254v1.abstract: Skyrmion lines and semi-local strings are examples of infrared-finite cosmic strings that arise in theories with spontaneously broken global symmetries. Unlike global $U(1)$ strings, they do not support the long-range Nambu-Goldstone boson (NGB) profile responsible for a logarithmically infrared-divergent string tension. We argue that NGB emission from their low-frequency oscillations is strongly suppressed. Consequently, their gravitational-wave signals may be comparable to those from local strings.

classification.title_zh: 来自红外有限宇宙弦的引力波与 Nambu-Goldstone 玻色子
classification.abstract_zh: Skyrmion 线和半局域弦是在具有自发破缺全局对称性的理论中出现的红外有限宇宙弦实例。与全局 U(1) 弦不同，它们不支持导致弦张力对数红外发散的长程 Nambu-Goldstone 玻色子（NGB）剖面。我们论证，其低频振荡的 NGB 发射受到强烈抑制。因此，它们的引力波信号可能与局域弦的引力波信号相当。

2610.08546v1.title: Universal Relations Meet Causality: Bounding the Dynamical Love Number of Neutron Stars
2610.08546v1.abstract: The frequency-dependent tidal response of a neutron star is constrained by causality, reality and passivity, which turn a suitably rescaled response into a holomorphic self-map of the upper complex frequency half-plane after some suitable conditions. The Schwarz--Pick theorem then bounds the leading dynamical correction to the tidal deformability from above. In this work we confront this bound with the most recent calculations of the dynamical tidal response in the literature which have also shown that the static tidal deformability and its correction at second order in frequency are tightly correlated. We find that the bound is saturated to within a few per cent, a quantitative confirmation of f-mode dominance in the relativistic regime. The combination of the static deformability with an independent determination of the f-mode frequency thus may provide an equation-of-state-independent upper limit on the dynamical tide.

classification.title_zh: 普遍关系与因果性相遇：限制中子星的动力学 Love 数
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星的频率依赖潮汐响应受到因果性、实性与被动性的约束；在适当条件下，经重标度的响应函数成为上半复频率平面上的全纯自映射。Schwarz--Pick 定理由此给出潮汐形变率领头动力学修正的上界。本文将这一上界与文献中最新动力学潮汐响应计算进行对照，这些计算也表明静态潮汐形变率及其在频率二阶的修正紧密相关。我们发现该上界在百分之几的精度内被饱和，定量确认了相对论区域中 f 模的主导地位。将静态形变率与独立确定的 f 模频率结合，可能给出一个不依赖状态方程的动力学潮汐上限。
classification.one_liner: 因果性与全纯性导出的 Schwarz--Pick 上界被中子星动力学潮汐响应的最新计算在百分之几内饱和，支持相对论区域中 f 模主导。

2511.05646v2.title: Generalised anomalies, QCD$_4$, and holography
2511.05646v2.abstract: During the last decade, the notion of an 't Hooft anomaly has been generalised to the case of discrete symmetries. An interesting instance, discussed by Tanizaki, is the mixed anomaly between the discrete axial symmetry and the flavour and baryonic symmetries in massless QCD$_4$. The goal of this note is to provide a derivation of this anomaly from a top-down holographic dual of QCD$_4$. It is found that the topological couplings in the bulk supergravity dual of the D4-D8 system encode Tanizaki's anomaly, once fluctuations around the bulk gauge fields are turned on. A technical challenge for this computation is the difficulty in maintaining gauge invariance of supergravity theories in the presence of D-branes. To overcome this issue, a compact formulation of the flux sector of (massive) type IIA supergravity in the presence of D8 branes is presented. A crucial ingredient in the analysis is the need for smearing the D8 branes, in order to impose $\tau$-shift invariance on the fluctuation ansatz.

classification.title_zh: 广义反常、QCD$_4$ 与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，'t Hooft 反常的概念已被推广到离散对称性的情形。Tanizaki 讨论的一个有趣例子是无质量 QCD$_4$ 中离散轴对称性与味对称性和重子对称性之间的混合反常。本文的目标是从 QCD$_4$ 的自上而下全息对偶出发给出该反常的推导。研究发现，一旦开启体规范场周围的涨落，D4-D8 系统的体超引力对偶中的拓扑耦合就编码了 Tanizaki 的反常。该计算的一个技术挑战是，在存在 D-膜时保持超引力理论规范不变性的困难。为克服这一问题，本文给出了存在 D8 膜时（有质量）IIA 型超引力通量扇区的一种紧致表述。分析中的一个关键要素是需要对 D8 膜进行涂抹，以便对涨落拟设施加 τ-shift 不变性。
classification.one_liner: 从 D4-D8 全息对偶的体超引力拓扑耦合推导无质量 QCD$_4$ 中的离散轴-味-重子混合反常。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于自上而下全息 QCD 与广义反常，核心是 D4-D8/Sakai-Sugimoto 体系的超引力推导；与列出的重点支线无直接交叉，故为中等相关。

2603.13475v3.title: State-dependent geometries from magic-enriched quantum codes
2603.13475v3.abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes provide a powerful framework for emergent spacetime, yet existing subsystem erasure-correcting holographic code models describe only quantum fields on a fixed background: in such codes, the entropic area term is state independent and cannot capture gravitational backreaction. We argue that this limitation is intrinsic to exact subsystem complementary recovery and that incorporating backreaction naturally leads to approximate quantum error correction. We introduce a Ryu-Takayanagi-like entropy decomposition for approximate subsystem erasure-correcting codes, defining bulk matter entropy via optimal recovery and a complementary proto-area entropy as the difference between boundary entropy and recoverable bulk entropy. For a broad class of skewed quantum codes obtained by small nonlocal perturbations of exact codes, the proto-area increases monotonically with bulk entropy, closely aligning with the changes in extremal surface areas in gravitational systems. We identify the origin of this response as a form of tripartite non-local magic in the Choi state of the encoding map, which vanishes in stabilizer codes and controls the leading matter-geometry coupling in approximate subsystem erasure-correcting codes.

classification.title_zh: 从魔法增强量子码得到态依赖几何
classification.abstract_zh: 量子纠错码为涌现时空提供了强大框架，然而现有的子系统擦除纠错全息码模型只描述固定背景上的量子场：在这类码中，熵的面积项与态无关，无法刻画引力反作用。我们认为这一局限是精确子系统互补恢复所固有的，并指出纳入反作用会自然导致近似量子纠错。我们为近似子系统擦除纠错码引入了一个类Ryu-Takayanagi熵分解，通过最优恢复定义体物质熵，并将互补的原面积熵定义为边界熵与可恢复体熵之差。对于通过对精确码施加小非局域微扰得到的一大类偏斜量子码，原面积随体熵单调增加，与引力系统中极值面面积的变化密切吻合。我们将这种响应的起源识别为编码映射的Choi态中一种三方非局域magic，它在稳定子码中消失，并控制近似子系统擦除纠错码中的主导物质-几何耦合。
classification.one_liner: 论文指出精确子系统全息码无法描述引力反作用，并在近似擦除纠错码中用Choi态的非局域magic刻画态依赖的原面积-体熵耦合。

2604.14011v3.title: Properties of black holes in non-linear electrodynamics
2604.14011v3.abstract: We investigate the properties of charged black hole geometries in nonlinear electrodynamics. We focus on the recently reported analytic charged black hole solutions to illustrate the consequences of a non-monotonic lapse function that exists for a wide range of black hole solutions. The spacetime admits stable light-rings, static near-horizon observers, and trapped near horizon photon orbits. We also show that although these modifications near the horizon are screened from afar, they nonetheless lead to additional branches of quasinormal modes for the black hole that are longer lived than the canonical Einstein branches.

classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学中黑洞的性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非线性电动力学中带电黑洞几何的性质。我们聚焦于近期报道的解析带电黑洞解，以说明在广泛黑洞解中存在的非单调 lapse 函数的后果。该时空允许稳定的光环、静态近视界观测者以及被困在近视界的光子轨道。我们还表明，尽管这些近视界修正从远处被屏蔽，但它们仍导致黑洞出现额外分支的准正规模，这些模式比标准的爱因斯坦分支寿命更长。
classification.one_liner: 非线性电动力学带电黑洞的非单调 lapse 函数导致稳定光环、近视界光子囚禁以及更长寿命的额外准正规模分支。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞物理，研究非线性电动力学黑洞时空与准正规模，与“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM”重点相关，但不涉及全息对偶。

2604.26755v2.title: Scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry
2604.26755v2.abstract: We propose the first examples of scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry. They arise as circle compactifications of four-dimensional vacua of massive type IIA supergravity with scale separation, upon introducing additional fluxes and sources. We provide both the ten-dimensional solutions and the three-dimensional effective descriptions in terms of K\"ahler potential and superpotential. The conformal dimensions of the putative dual two-dimensional field theory appear not to be integers. The superpotential for the additional fluxes of one of our models was guessed by ChatGPT and, to the best of our knowledge, it does not appear in existing literature. Should these vacua be solutions of string theory, they would allow to address the open problem of scale separation from the vantage point of extended supersymmetry.

classification.title_zh: 具有扩展超对称的尺度分离真空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首批具有扩展超对称的尺度分离真空的例子。它们来自四维大质量 IIA 型超引力中具有尺度分离的真空的圆紧致化，并引入额外的通量和源。我们给出了十维解以及以 Kähler 势和超势表示的三维有效描述。假定的对偶二维场论的共形维数似乎不是整数。我们其中一个模型额外通量的超势是由 ChatGPT 猜测的，据我们所知，它未出现在现有文献中。如果这些真空是弦论解，它们将允许从扩展超对称的视角处理尺度分离这一未决问题。
classification.one_liner: 提出首批具有扩展超对称的尺度分离真空：由大质量 IIA 超引力四维真空圆紧致化并加通量/源得到，给出十维解与三维有效超势，并讨论对偶二维场论。

2607.04065v3.title: The Normalised Wigner Negativity Rate as a Second-Moment Probe of Infall in AdS$_3$
2607.04065v3.abstract: In spread complexity, the growth rate of the average position of a time-evolved state along its Krylov chain recovers the proper radial momentum of an infalling particle in AdS. It is, however, a measure of the first moment only, irrespective of the spread of the wavepacket away from its classical trajectory. The rate of a normalized Krylov-Wigner negativity can be proposed as a diagnostic of the second moment of the boundary state that captures this spreading. Starting with the seed-normalized Krylov-Wigner distribution, that is, the Wigner transform of the descendant cloud with the decaying return amplitude divided out, we obtain an analytic Bessel form in the macroscopic limit and compute its total negativity explicitly. Retaining the Bessel variable all the way through, we find that the negativity goes as $\sinh^{4\Delta}(\pi t/\beta)$. But the raw normalized-state negativity saturates to an $O(1)$ constant, well below the $O(\sqrt{D})$ bound. Using the exact negative binomial statistics of the Krylov chain, the normalized negativity is at late times a fixed power of the second moment of the Krylov wavepacket, $\mathcal{N}(t)\propto[\mathrm{Var}(\hat{N}_{\mathrm{Krylov}})]^{\Delta}$, for every $\Delta>1/2$. The relation linearizes precisely at $\Delta=1$. In this regime via the momentum dictionary of Caputa et al. (arXiv:2410.23334), the rate becomes the product of the proper radial position and momentum, $\mathcal{R}\propto\mathcal{C}\,P_\rho$, which we interpret as the rate of the tidal stretch of nearby geodesics falling into the horizon. We also comment briefly on a speculative direction for future research, in particular the interpretation of the transverse string size operator in terms of the Krylov number operator through the common $\mathrm{SU}(1,1)$ discrete series.

classification.title_zh: 归一化维格纳负性率作为 AdS_3 中内落运动的二阶矩探针
classification.abstract_zh: 在 spread complexity 中，时间演化态沿 Krylov 链平均位置的增长率可以还原 AdS 中下落粒子的固有径向动量。然而，它只测量一阶矩，不包含波包偏离经典轨迹的展宽。归一化 Krylov-Wigner 负性率可被提出作为边界态二阶矩的诊断量，从而刻画这种展宽。从种子归一化 Krylov-Wigner 分布出发，即把衰减返回振幅除掉后的后继态云的 Wigner 变换，我们在宏观极限下得到解析的 Bessel 形式，并显式计算其总负性。全程保留 Bessel 变量后，我们发现负性按 sinh^{4Δ}(πt/β) 增长。但原始归一化态负性饱和到 O(1) 常数，远低于 O(√D) 上界。利用 Krylov 链的精确负二项统计，归一化负性在晚期是 Krylov 波包二阶矩的固定幂次，N(t) ∝ [Var(N_Krylov)]^Δ，对任意 Δ>1/2 成立；该关系在 Δ=1 处精确线性化。在此区间，借助 Caputa 等人 (arXiv:2410.23334) 的动量字典，该速率变为固有径向位置与动量的乘积，R ∝ C P_ρ，我们将其解释为落入视界的邻近测地线潮汐拉伸率。我们还简要评论了一个推测性未来方向，特别是通过共同的 SU(1,1) 离散系列，将横向弦尺度算符解释为 Krylov 数算符。
classification.one_liner: 用归一化 Krylov-Wigner 负性率刻画 AdS_3 中下落波包的二阶矩，并联系邻近测地线的潮汐拉伸率。

2609.05004v2.title: de Sitter and S-folds in type IIB from $\mathcal{N} = 4$ $D = 4$ gauged supergravity
2609.05004v2.abstract: In this paper, we classify the type IIB uplifts of the $\mathcal{N}=4$ $D=4$ pure $\text{SO}(4)$-gauged supergravity admitting a dS$_4$ solution. As for their AdS cousins, the internal geometries of these uplifts consist of two $S^2$ fibred over a Riemann surface $\Sigma$, and are classified by pairs of harmonic functions $h_{1,\,2}$ on $\Sigma$, providing a new family of de Sitter solutions in type IIB. Choosing specific functions $h_{1,\,2}$ on $\Sigma = \mathbb{R} \times I$, we perform an S-fold quotient of the internal space along its non-compact direction. This S-folding allows us to evade the assumptions of the Maldacena-Nunez no-go theorem and provides a classical de Sitter solution of type IIB supergravity with finite and non-vanishing four-dimensional effective Newton constant.

classification.title_zh: 来自 N=4 D=4 规范超引力的 type IIB 中的 de Sitter 与 S-folds
classification.abstract_zh: 本文分类了容许 dS4 解的 N=4 D=4 纯 SO(4) 规范超引力的 type IIB 提升。与它们的 AdS 对应类似，这些提升的内部几何由两个 S^2 纤维化在黎曼面 Σ 上构成，并由 Σ 上的一对调和函数 h_{1,2} 分类，提供了 type IIB 中新的 de Sitter 解族。选取 Σ = R × I 上的特定函数 h_{1,2}，我们沿内部空间的非紧致方向进行 S-fold 商。这种 S-folding 使我们能够避开 Maldacena-Nunez no-go 定理的假设，并给出 type IIB 超引力的经典 de Sitter 解，其四维有效牛顿常数为有限且非零。
classification.one_liner: 分类并构造了 N=4 D=4 规范超引力提升到 type IIB 的新 dS4 解，并通过 S-fold 商绕过 Maldacena-Nunez 禁阻定理得到经典 de Sitter 解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，构造 type IIB 超引力中的经典 de Sitter 解，与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论相关；未涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、QNM、探针膜等其他重点标签。

2609.07866v2.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction Beyond the Large N Limit via the Twirled Petz Map
2609.07866v2.abstract: Entanglement wedge reconstruction provides the sharpest formulation of bulk locality in AdS/CFT, identifying the entanglement wedge as the largest bulk region reconstructible from a boundary subregion. While this statement is well understood at leading order in the large N expansion through both modular flow and Petz map reconstruction, its extension beyond the semiclassical regime has remained unclear. In this work, we show that quantum error correction provides the natural framework for addressing this problem. At leading order, we reproduce the known leading-order reconstruction formulas, and by employing the twirled Petz map, we obtain a systematic and explicit method for incorporating subleading 1/N corrections. Beyond the leading approximation, we have obtained a bi-local correction controlled by a subleading Petz kernel. Our results establish a controlled approach to bulk reconstruction beyond large N and sharpening the role of quantum error correction in holography. This framework provides a controlled path toward understanding bulk reconstruction in fully quantum gravitational settings.

classification.title_zh: 通过扭转Petz映射超越大N极限的纠缠楔重构
classification.abstract_zh: 纠缠楔重构为AdS/CFT中的体局域性提供了最精确的表述，将纠缠楔认定为可从边界子区域重构的最大体区域。虽然这一陈述在大N展开的领头阶通过模流和Petz映射重构已得到很好理解，但其在半经典区域之外的推广仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们表明量子纠错为处理这一问题提供了自然框架。在领头阶，我们重现了已知的领头阶重构公式，并通过采用扭转Petz映射，获得了一种系统且明确的方法来纳入次领头1/N修正。超越领头近似，我们得到了一个由次领头Petz核控制的双局域修正。我们的结果建立了一种超越大N的可控体重构方法，并强化了量子纠错在全息中的角色。该框架为理解完全量子引力设定下的体重构提供了一条可控路径。
classification.one_liner: 利用扭转Petz映射在量子纠错框架下系统纳入1/N修正，实现超越大N极限的纠缠楔重构。
