2609.38336v2.title: Scaling similarity and generalised conformal symmetry in D2-brane holography
2609.38336v2.abstract: We study D2-brane holography within the purely dilatonic sector of four-dimensional maximal ISO(7)-gauged supergravity, obtained as a consistent truncation of type IIA supergravity on S$^6$. In the dual frame, the four-dimensional Lagrangian resulting from the reduction of the massless IIA theory exhibits scaling similarity, thus reflecting the generalised conformal symmetry of the dual three-dimensional maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory. Using an auxiliary spacetime construction, we show that the holographic CFT$_3$ fixed points and RG-flows known in the massive IIA theory have natural counterparts in the massless IIA theory: QFT$_3$s with generalised conformal symmetry connected by generalised RG-flows, which we construct numerically. We also revisit the Coulomb branch solutions and propose an extension of Gubser's singularity criterion to supergravity theories exhibiting scaling similarity.

classification.title_zh: D2-膜全息中的标度相似性与广义共形对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在四维最大 ISO(7)-规范超引力的纯膨胀子扇区中研究 D2-膜全息，该扇区由 IIA 型超引力在 S^6 上的相容截断得到。在对偶框架中，由无质量 IIA 理论约化得到的四维拉格朗日量表现出标度相似性，从而反映对偶三维最大超对称 Yang-Mills 理论的广义共形对称性。利用辅助时空构造，我们证明：在 massive IIA 理论中已知的全息 CFT3 不动点和 RG 流，在 massless IIA 理论中有自然对应物——具有广义共形对称性的 QFT3，并由广义 RG 流连接；我们数值构造了这些流。我们还重新审视 Coulomb 分支解，并提出将 Gubser 奇性判据推广到表现出标度相似性的超引力理论。
classification.one_liner: 在 D2-膜全息中研究无质量 IIA 理论表现出的标度相似性，并构造具有广义共形对称性的三维 QFT 之间的广义 RG 流。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 D2-膜全息与广义共形对称性，属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典范畴；不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜等支线。

2604.20661v2.title: Timelike Geodesics of Regular Black Holes with Scalar Hair
2604.20661v2.abstract: We investigate timelike geodesics in asymptotically flat regular black holes supported by a phantom scalar field characterized by a scalar charge $A$. This parameter removes the central singularity and continuously deforms the Schwarzschild geometry while preserving asymptotic flatness. We derive the equations of motion for massive test particles and classify bounded and unbounded trajectories in terms of the conserved energy and angular momentum. We determine circular and critical orbits, including the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), and analyze the transition between capture and scattering. We show that the scalar charge modifies the location of the unstable and stable circular orbits, the ISCO, and the threshold angular momentum for scattering, exhibiting a nontrivial dependence on the radial coordinate. Their physical scales are naturally described in terms of the invariant areal radius $R(r)=\sqrt{r^2+A^2}$. In the weak-field regime, we compute the perihelion precession and obtain corrections proportional to $A^2$, allowing us to constrain the scalar charge from Solar System observations. We also analyze the motion with vanishing angular momentum and show that, while the qualitative structure of the trajectories remains connected to the Schwarzschild limit $A\to 0$, the quantitative deviations encode the geometric effects of the scalar hair.

classification.title_zh: 带标量毛的规则黑洞的类时测地线
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由幻影标量场支撑的渐近平直规则黑洞中的类时测地线，该标量场由标量荷 A 表征。该参数消除了中心奇点，并在保持渐近平直性的同时连续形变 Schwarzschild 几何。我们推导了有质量检验粒子的运动方程，并依据守恒能量和角动量对束缚与无界轨道进行分类。我们确定了圆轨道和临界轨道，包括最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），并分析了捕获与散射之间的转变。我们表明，标量荷会改变不稳定圆轨道、稳定圆轨道、ISCO 以及散射阈值角动量的位置，并呈现出对径向坐标的非平凡依赖。其物理尺度自然由不变面积半径 R(r)=sqrt(r^2+A^2) 描述。在弱场情形下，我们计算了近日点进动，并得到正比于 A^2 的修正，从而可由太阳系观测约束标量荷。我们还分析了角动量为零的运动，并表明尽管轨道定性结构与 Schwarzschild 极限 A→0 保持联系，定量偏离编码了标量毛的几何效应。
classification.one_liner: 研究带标量毛规则黑洞中类时测地线、ISCO、散射阈值与弱场近日点进动修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线，研究规则黑洞时空中的测地线、ISCO 与太阳系观测约束。

2605.06410v2.title: Spin and Quadrupole Sectors in Nonrelativistic Gravity
2605.06410v2.abstract: We study the large-\(c\) expansion of general relativity in ADM variables. Using a unified even \(\omega\)-expansion, the ADM formulation gives a common starting point for Galilean and Carrollian limits. We focus on the Galilean branch and derive the ADM action and field equations up to NNLO. We then construct stationary vacuum solutions of the Galilean ADM equations up to NNLO in weak and strong branches. In the weak branch, we find NLO Kerr-type, Hartle--Thorne-type and mixed-type solutions. The NLO weak equations also allow a simple extension to higher mass multipoles. At NNLO, the weak Kerr-type and extended Hartle--Thorne-type sectors solve the equations separately, but their naive sum is not a solution. The nonlinear NNLO equations generate mixed \(J^2Q\) source terms, which require additional corrections to the NNLO lapse and NNLO spatial tensor field. This gives a mixed weak-branch Galilean solution of the truncated NNLO equations in the ADM gauge, whose full relativistic completion is not fixed by the truncated data alone. In the strong branch, Kerr-type data solve the equations through NNLO while the strong Hartle--Thorne-type data solve the NLO equations. We also explain how the ADM data can be reconstructed order by order into approximate spacetime metrics. These reconstructed metrics should not be interpreted by themselves as unique full relativistic completions. Since these metrics include spin, quadrupole and mixed spin--quadrupole effects, they may be useful for studying the spacetime around rotating compact objects such as black holes and neutron stars.

classification.title_zh: 非相对论引力中的自旋与四极矩扇区
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 ADM 变量下广义相对论的大 c 展开。采用统一的偶 ω 展开，ADM 表述为伽利略极限和卡罗尔极限提供共同起点。我们聚焦伽利略分支，推导 ADM 作用量和场方程至 NNLO。随后在弱分支和强分支构造伽利略 ADM 方程的定常真空解至 NNLO。在弱分支，我们找到 NLO Kerr 型、Hartle-Thorne 型和混合型解。NLO 弱场方程还允许简单推广到更高质量多极矩。在 NNLO，弱 Kerr 型和扩展 Hartle-Thorne 型扇区分别求解方程，但它们的朴素相加不是解。非线性 NNLO 方程产生混合的 J^2 Q 源项，需要对 NNLO lapse 和 NNLO 空间张量场做额外修正。这给出了 ADM 规范下截断 NNLO 方程的混合弱分支伽利略解，其完整相对论完成不由截断数据单独固定。在强分支，Kerr 型数据求解方程至 NNLO，而强 Hartle-Thorne 型数据求解 NLO 方程。我们还解释如何将 ADM 数据逐阶重构为近似时空度规。这些重构度规本身不应被解释为唯一的完整相对论完成。由于这些度规包含自旋、四极矩以及混合自旋-四极矩效应，它们可能有助于研究旋转致密天体（如黑洞和中子星）周围的时空。
classification.one_liner: 通过大 c ADM 展开研究非相对论引力，构造含自旋与四极矩的伽利略 NNLO 定常真空解及其近似度规。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究非相对论引力、ADM 展开及旋转致密天体时空；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力核心问题。

2606.22985v2.title: Detector orientation matters: Consequences for gravitational-wave background detectability
2606.22985v2.abstract: Cross-correlation searches for gravitational-wave backgrounds depend on the geometrical configuration (physical separation and relative orientation) of the detectors comprising the network. Applying standard techniques to a few simple examples, we illustrate how the relative orientation of a pair of Earth-based L-shaped laser interferometers can drastically impact the detectability of both isotropic and anisotropic gravitational-wave backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 探测器取向很重要：对引力波背景可探测性的后果
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波背景的互相关搜索依赖于组成探测网络的探测器的几何构型（物理间距和相对取向）。我们将标准技术应用于几个简单例子，说明一对地基L形激光干涉仪的相对取向如何能显著影响各向同性和各向异性引力波背景的可探测性。
classification.one_liner: 地基L形干涉仪的相对取向会显著改变各向同性和各向异性引力波背景的互相关可探测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与引力波探测方向，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；与全息对偶或量子引力无关。

2610.06893v1.title: Dynamical Stability and Quasinormal Modes of Casimir Wormholes in dRGT Massive Gravity
2610.06893v1.abstract: This paper investigates static, spherically symmetric traversable wormholes supported by Casimir energy within de Rham-Gabadadze-Tolley (dRGT) massive gravity. By deriving the exact shape function $b(r) = r_0 + \frac{\pi^3(-r + r_0)}{90 r r_0} - \frac{1}{2} C m_g^2 (r - r_0)[2C c_2 + c_1(r + r_0)]$, we verify that the geometry satisfies the local Morris--Thorne throat and traversability conditions, including $b(r_0)=r_0$ and $b'(r_0)<1$. For the nonzero massive-gravity parameters considered here, the resulting spacetime is not asymptotically flat, and its large-$r$ behavior is governed by the massive-gravity contributions to the shape function. The Casimir energy density $\rho = -\pi^2/(720 r^4)$ ensures the Null Energy Condition is violated throughout the throat region, as demonstrated by the negative behavior of $(\rho + p_r)$ and $(\rho - |p_r|)$ across all parameter values. Analysis of the volume integral quantifier reveals that the massive gravity parameter $m_g^2 c_2$ directly regulates the exotic matter requirement, with the integrated NEC violation becoming more negative as $m_g^2 c_2$ increases from $0.1$ to $0.5$. The mechanical equilibrium is rigorously established via the generalized Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equation, where the anisotropic force precisely balances the gravitational and hydrostatic forces. The quasinormal mode spectrum for scalar perturbations is extracted using both the analytical Mashhoon method and direct numerical integration. The effective potential forms a symmetric barrier at the throat, with the peak height increasing with the multipole number $\ell$. The damping rate $|\omega_I|$ grows systematically with increasing massive gravity parameter. These distinct spectral signatures provide robust theoretical markers for distinguishing Casimir wormholes from black holes in future gravitational wave observations.

classification.title_zh: dRGT 大质量引力中 Casimir 虫洞的动力学稳定性与准正模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在 de Rham-Gabadadze-Tolley (dRGT) 大质量引力中由 Casimir 能量支撑的静态球对称可穿越虫洞。通过导出形状函数 b(r) = r_0 + π^3(-r + r_0)/(90 r r_0) - 1/2 C m_g^2 (r - r_0)[2C c_2 + c_1(r + r_0)]，验证了该几何满足局域 Morris-Thorne 喉部与可穿越条件，包括 b(r_0)=r_0 和 b'(r_0)<1。对于所考虑的非零大质量引力参数，所得时空并非渐近平直，其大 r 行为由形状函数中的大质量引力贡献支配。Casimir 能量密度 ρ = -π^2/(720 r^4) 使零能量条件在喉部区域整体被违反，表现为所有参数取值下 (ρ+p_r) 和 (ρ-|p_r|) 均为负。对体积积分量词的分析表明，大质量引力参数 m_g^2 c_2 直接调控奇异物质需求；当 m_g^2 c_2 从 0.1 增至 0.5 时，积分 NEC 违反变得更负。通过广义 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程严格建立力学平衡，其中各向异性力精确平衡引力与流体静力。利用解析 Mashhoon 方法和直接数值积分提取标量扰动的准正模谱。有效势在喉部形成对称势垒，其峰高随多极数 ℓ 增大而增加。阻尼率 |ω_I| 随大质量引力参数增大而系统性增大。这些不同的谱特征为未来引力波观测中区分 Casimir 虫洞与黑洞提供了稳健的理论标记。
classification.one_liner: 在 dRGT 大质量引力中，Casimir 虫洞的喉部条件、NEC 违反、TOV 平衡与标量 QNM 被系统分析，显示大质量引力参数可调控奇异物质需求和阻尼率。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究 dRGT 大质量引力中的 Casimir 虫洞、NEC、TOV 平衡与 QNM，属于经典/修改引力支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息，因此对全息研究方向相关性有限，但与用户经典引力重点标签相关。

2610.07020v1.title: Periodic Orbits and Their Gravitational-Wave Signatures around a Rotating Black Hole Surrounded by Perfect Fluid Dark Matter
2610.07020v1.abstract: We investigate equatorial timelike motion of a massive test particle and the associated gravitational radiation around a Kerr black hole surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter. In the presence of a dark matter fluid, the radius of the innermost stable circular orbit decreases, while the specific angular momentum is modified and the specific energy increases as the dark matter (DM) parameter, $\alpha$, increases. We compute periodic timelike orbits using the rational frequency ratio $q$, with the $(z,w,v)$ classification, which is modified by the presence of DM while preserving the topological class. We analyze the gravitational waveforms corresponding to these periodic orbits and find that dark matter modifies the timing and distribution of the oscillatory features of the orbits. For a representative extreme-mass-ratio system, the corresponding characteristic strain is concentrated mainly in the millihertz (mHz) frequency band relevant to LISA. These results establish a direct connection between the dark-matter-induced modifications of strong-field orbital dynamics and the corresponding gravitational-wave signatures.

classification.title_zh: 完美流体暗物质包裹的旋转黑洞周围的周期轨道及其引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在完美流体暗物质包裹的 Kerr 黑洞周围，大质量测试粒子的赤道面类时运动及相关的引力辐射。在暗物质流体存在时，最内稳定圆轨道半径减小，而随着暗物质参数 α 增大，比角动量被修正且比能量增加。我们使用有理频率比 q 以及 (z,w,v) 分类计算周期类时轨道；暗物质的存在会修正这些轨道，但保持拓扑分类不变。我们分析了这些周期轨道对应的引力波形，发现暗物质改变了轨道振荡特征的时间分布和分布形态。对于一个代表性的极端质量比系统，相应的特征应变主要集中在与 LISA 相关的毫赫兹（mHz）频段。这些结果建立了暗物质导致的强场轨道动力学修正与相应引力波信号之间的直接联系。
classification.one_liner: 在完美流体暗物质包裹的 Kerr 黑洞时空中，暗物质参数改变周期轨道并影响其毫赫兹引力波信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究 Kerr 黑洞时空中暗物质对周期轨道和引力波信号的影响；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2610.07095v1.title: Noninertial Reference Frames in Special Relativity
2610.07095v1.abstract: Although the special theory of relativity was conceived to relate inertial reference frames, it is not generally known by beginning students, or even by academics not specializing in general relativity, that it can be applied to noninertial reference frames. The general perception among non-specialists seems to be that noninertial reference frames can only be described through general relativity. This situation has led to some controversy regarding the necessity of general relativity to address problems involving accelerated systems, such as the twin paradox and the description of rotating reference frames. We discuss the controversy and propose that, to avoid the present confusion, the local validity of special relativity in the absence of gravitation, despite the use of noninertial frames, should be explicitly and clearly stated at an early stage of the learning process.

classification.title_zh: 狭义相对论中的非惯性参考系
classification.abstract_zh: 尽管狭义相对论是为了关联惯性参考系而提出的，但初学者乃至非广义相对论专业的学者通常并不普遍知道它也可以应用于非惯性参考系。非专业人士的普遍看法似乎是，非惯性参考系只能通过广义相对论来描述。这种情况导致了一些关于处理加速系统问题（如双生子佯谬和旋转参考系的描述）是否需要广义相对论的争议。我们讨论这一争议，并建议为了避免目前的混乱，在缺乏引力时狭义相对论的局部有效性——即使使用非惯性系——应在学习过程的早期就明确而清楚地说明。
classification.one_liner: 本文讨论非惯性系中狭义相对论的适用性争议，主张在教学中明确无引力时狭义相对论的局部有效性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于狭义相对论基础与非惯性参考系的教学/概念讨论，未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息，因此与全息研究重点无关；仅因讨论经典时空与相对论框架而与经典引力/广义相对论支线有边缘关联。

2610.07263v1.title: Chromatic Gravitational-Wave Tests of Dirac-Induced Torsion in Quadratic Einstein--Cartan Gravity: Nanohertz PTA Null Signatures
2610.07263v1.abstract: We derive a conditional result for leading tensor propagation in Einstein--Cartan--Dirac gravity with the parity-even invariant $\zeta T_{\lambda\mu\nu} T^{\lambda\mu\nu}$ and algebraic torsion sourced by a coarse-grained fermionic axial current. On a spatially flat, homogeneous, and isotropic background, eliminating the nondynamical Lorentz connection yields the Einstein--Hilbert transverse-traceless (TT) action at leading two-derivative order if the matter state obeys an explicit factorized mean-field closure: the connected contribution to $\langle J_{5\mu}J_5^{\mu}\rangle$ is set to zero, the factorized scalar $\bar J_{5\mu}\bar J_5^\mu$ has vanishing first- and second-order TT response, and intrinsic TT anisotropic stress vanishes. Under these conditions, $Q_T= M_{\rm Pl}^{2}$, the tensor speed is luminal, and the local dispersion relation is $\omega^2=k_{\rm phys}^2$, with no leading propagation-induced polarization splitting. The contribution is a model-specific constrained TT-Hessian calculation for this invariant that retains the auxiliary-connection response and states the closure needed for the $\zeta$-dependent terms to cancel. The connected-current TT response of a general fermionic state is not evaluated; this is therefore a conditional result, not a general Einstein--Cartan no-go theorem. The coupling $\zeta$ remains in the axial--axial fermion contact interaction. We define null-test observables and a covariance-weighted statistic for future pulsar-timing-array (PTA) likelihood analyses. Published NANOGrav 15-year harmonic posteriors and the public 2026 collaboration preprint serve only as consistency checks: we perform no new time-of-arrival (TOA)-level likelihood or evidence calculation, and these data do not directly constrain $\zeta$.

classification.title_zh: 二次爱因斯坦–嘉当引力中狄拉克诱导挠率的色散引力波检验：纳赫兹脉冲星计时阵列零信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在含宇称偶不变量 ζ T_{λμν}T^{λμν}、且由粗粒化费米子轴矢流代数地源生挠率的 Einstein–Cartan–Dirac 引力中，推导领先张量传播的条件性结果。在空间平坦、均匀、各向同性背景上，若物质态满足显式的因子化平均场闭合条件：⟨J_{5μ}J_5^μ⟩ 的关联贡献被设为零，因子化标量 \bar J_{5μ}\bar J_5^μ 的一阶和二阶 TT 响应为零，且内禀 TT 各向异性应力消失，则消去非动力学洛伦兹联络会在领先二阶导数阶给出 Einstein–Hilbert 横向无迹作用。在这些条件下，Q_T=M_Pl^2，张量速度类光，局域色散关系为 ω^2=k_phys^2，没有领先传播诱导的偏振分裂。该贡献是针对此不变量的模型特定受约束 TT-Hessian 计算，保留了辅助联络响应，并说明 ζ 相关项相消所需的闭合条件。一般费米子态的关联流 TT 响应未被计算；因此这是条件性结果，而非普遍的 Einstein–Cartan no-go 定理。耦合 ζ 仍留在轴矢–轴矢费米子接触相互作用中。我们定义零检验观测量和协方差加权统计量，供未来脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）似然分析使用。已发表的 NANOGrav 15 年谐波后验和公开的 2026 年合作组预印本仅作为一致性检验：我们未进行新的到达时间（TOA）层级似然或证据计算，这些数据不直接约束 ζ。
classification.one_liner: 在二次 Einstein–Cartan–Dirac 引力中，满足特定平均场闭合条件时领先张量传播退化为类光 Einstein–Hilbert TT 模式，并给出供纳赫兹 PTA 零检验使用的条件性观测量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，但属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究修正引力中的张量传播、引力波色散与 PTA 检验，因此与经典引力重点标签相关。

2610.07536v1.title: A discontinuous Galerkin method with artificial viscosity geared toward numerical relativity applications
2610.07536v1.abstract: Artificial viscosity can be used to deal with shocks and other discontinuities such as star surfaces, that can arise in matter. We explain in detail how a local discontinuous Galerkin method can be used to add artificial viscosity terms to hyperbolic evolution equations. These artificial terms are multiplied by a viscosity that is non-zero only in elements that are flagged as non-smooth by a newly developed smoothness indicator. Our artificial viscosity method works well in several simple shock test cases such as with Burgers' equation and blast wave tests. For the first time, we are also able to evolve single neutron star in full general relativistic hydrodynamics. To achieve this, we use different viscosities for the momentum density than for the rest of the matter variables.

classification.title_zh: 一种面向数值相对论应用的人工粘性间断伽辽金方法
classification.abstract_zh: 人工粘性可用于处理激波以及物质中可能出现的星体表面等其他间断。我们详细解释了如何使用局部间断伽辽金方法为双曲演化方程添加人工粘性项。这些人工项乘以一个粘性系数，该系数仅在新开发的平滑度指示器标记为非光滑的单元中非零。我们的人工粘性方法在若干简单激波测试案例（如 Burgers 方程和爆炸波测试）中表现良好。我们首次能够在完整广义相对论流体力学中演化单个中子星。为实现这一点，我们对动量密度与其余物质变量使用不同的粘性系数。
classification.one_liner: 提出面向数值相对论的局部间断伽辽金人工粘性方法，可处理激波并首次演化完整广义相对论流体力学中的单中子星。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/数值相对论，涉及广义相对论流体力学和中子星模拟，与用户“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关，但不涉及全息对偶。

2610.07839v1.title: Natural Quenching of Inner Viscous Torques in Accretion Disks Around Mini-Boson Stars
2610.07839v1.abstract: The standard Novikov-Thorne model for geometrically thin accretion disks assumes a zero-torque inner boundary condition at the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). Relaxing this assumption to allow a finite viscous torque---driven by magnetic stresses bridging the plunging region---can significantly enhance the radiative efficiency and high-frequency spectral emission of black hole accretion flows. While this mechanism is well-established for Kerr spacetimes, its thermodynamic viability around exotic, horizonless compact objects remains largely unexplored. In this article, we investigate the application of the inner viscous torque boundary condition to a thin disk embedded in a regular mini-boson star spacetime. By numerically integrating the coupled Einstein-Klein-Gordon field equations and employing the Lense-Thirring slow-rotation approximation, we generate an exact, horizonless background that strictly satisfies the weak energy condition. We demonstrate that the topological absence of a coordinate ISCO fundamentally alters the accretion dynamics. Without a sudden geodesic plunge, stable circular orbits penetrate deep into the dense scalar core, causing the physical inner boundary of the disk to be determined dynamically by the peak of the Keplerian angular velocity. Because the specific angular momentum of the fluid approaches zero at this deep microscopic boundary, the standard viscous torque is mathematically quenched. Consequently, the enhanced radiative flux divergence typically associated with boundary torques in black holes is naturally suppressed around regular boson stars. This torque quenching offers a robust phenomenological discriminator between standard black holes and horizonless ultralight scalar structures.

classification.title_zh: 迷你玻色子星周围吸积盘中内粘性力矩的自然淬灭
classification.abstract_zh: 几何薄吸积盘的标准 Novikov-Thorne 模型假设在最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）处为零力矩内边界条件。放松这一假设、允许由桥接俯冲区的磁应力驱动的有限粘性力矩，会显著提高黑洞吸积流的辐射效率和高频谱发射。尽管该机制在 Kerr 时空中已被充分确立，但其在奇异、无视界致密天体周围的热力学可行性仍基本未被探索。本文中，我们研究将内部粘性力矩边界条件应用于嵌入在规则迷你玻色子星时空中的薄盘。通过数值积分耦合 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 场方程，并采用 Lense-Thirring 慢转近似，我们生成一个严格满足弱能量条件的精确无视界背景。我们证明，坐标 ISCO 的拓扑缺失从根本上改变了吸积动力学。由于不存在突然的测地线俯冲，稳定圆轨道会深入致密标量核，使得盘的物理内边界由 Keplerian 角速度峰值动力学地决定。由于流体在该深微观边界处的比角动量趋于零，标准粘性力矩在数学上被淬灭。因此，通常在黑洞中与边界力矩相关的增强辐射通量散度在规则玻色子星周围被自然抑制。这种力矩淬灭为区分标准黑洞与无视界超轻标量结构提供了稳健的现象学判据。
classification.one_liner: 在规则迷你玻色子星时空的薄吸积盘中，ISCO 缺失导致内边界处比角动量趋于零，从而自然淬灭内粘性力矩，可作为区分黑洞与无视界标量结构的判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与致密天体吸积现象学研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力信息。

2610.07850v1.title: Gravitational-wave signatures of spinning particles around rotating hairy black holes
2610.07850v1.abstract: We study how the spin of a compact secondary and a gravitational-decoupling deformation of the Kerr geometry are imprinted on gravitational waves from strong-field eccentric motion around a rotating black hole. The orbit is evolved with the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon equations under the Tulczyjew spin supplementary condition, and the radiation is computed with the numerical-kludge method. The deformation describes a black hole only below a critical curve in the plane of the two hair parameters. The spin of the secondary pulls the pericenter inward and, above a critical value, carries the particle into the black hole. The hair raises this capture threshold, from $S\simeq0.66$ in Kerr to $0.9$ and above close to the horizon boundary, because it reduces the effective mass near the black hole. The emitted signal remains a discrete comb of orbital harmonics: the spin strengthens the pericenter bursts and shifts power toward higher harmonics, while both the spin and the hair leave their main imprint through an accumulated dephasing. The imprint of the hair is controlled by the parameter that sets the radial reach of the deformation, disappears in the Kerr-like limit of the family, and is amplified by the spin of the secondary. For a source at $2$ Gpc with $M=10^6M_\odot$ and $\mu=10M_\odot$, a $6.8$ h segment of the signal carries a signal-to-noise ratio of about $1.4$ in LISA, $2.7$ in Taiji and $0.9$ in TianQin. Within the same segment the more extended deformations become distinguishable from Kerr, first in Taiji; since this holds for a nonspinning secondary, it applies directly to astrophysical EMRIs. The spin-induced frequency shifts are linear in the spin, so the large spins used here are a magnified illustration of a dephasing that, for realistic secondaries, accumulates to a phase of order a radian over an inspiral.

classification.title_zh: 旋转毛发黑洞周围自旋粒子的引力波特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究紧凑次级天体的自旋以及 Kerr 几何的引力退耦形变如何印刻在旋转黑洞周围强场偏心运动的引力波中。轨道用 Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon 方程在 Tulczyjew 自旋补充条件下演化，辐射用 numerical-kludge 方法计算。该形变描述的黑洞只存在于两个毛发参数平面中的临界曲线以下。次级自旋将近星点向内拉，并在超过临界值时把粒子带入黑洞。毛发提高了这一捕获阈值：从 Kerr 的 S≃0.66 提高到靠近视界边界时的 0.9 及以上，因为毛发降低了黑洞附近的有效质量。辐射信号仍是一组离散的轨道谐波：自旋增强近星点暴并功率推向更高谐波，而自旋和毛发都主要通过累积退相位留下印记。毛发的印记由决定形变径向范围的参数控制，在该族的 Kerr 类极限中消失，并被次级自旋放大。对于位于 2 Gpc、M=10^6 M⊙、μ=10 M⊙ 的源，6.8 小时信号段在 LISA 中信噪比约为 1.4，在 Taiji 中约为 2.7，在 TianQin 中约为 0.9。在同一段内，更延展的形变可先从 Kerr 中区分出来，首先是在 Taiji；由于这对无自旋次级也成立，因此直接适用于天体物理 EMRI。自旋引起的频移对自旋是线性的，所以这里使用的大自旋是对退相位的放大示例；对于实际次级，这种退相位在一次旋近中累积到约一弧度的相位。
classification.one_liner: 研究自旋次级天体与旋转毛发黑洞形变在强场偏心轨道引力波中的印记，并评估 LISA/Taiji/TianQin 可探测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线，研究毛发黑洞、自旋粒子轨道与引力波信号，并涉及 LISA/Taiji/TianQin 可探测性。

2610.07879v1.title: Scale-Invariant Non-Collapse from Raychaudhuri Comparison
2610.07879v1.abstract: We establish a scale-invariant spatial non-collapse estimate for hypersurface-orthogonal timelike geodesic congruences. The result extends a previous Raychaudhuri-based construction in which a comparison estimate for the expansion was used to control the volume of domains transported along the congruence. The additional ingredient here is a quantitative estimate of the spatial distance distortion induced by the expansion and shear. Assuming that the initial spatial geometry is non-collapsed up to a scale $r_0$, and that the expansion, shear, and timelike Ricci curvature satisfy suitable uniform bounds, we obtain, before the first blow-up time of the Raychaudhuri comparison solution, \begin{equation*} \operatorname{Vol}_{h_\tau}\bigl(B_{h_\tau}(p_\tau,r)\bigr) \geq \kappa_{\mathrm{L}}(\tau)\, r^3, \end{equation*} where \begin{equation*} \kappa_{\mathrm{L}}(\tau) = \kappa_0 e^{-3K\tau} \exp\!\left(\int_0^\tau \Theta(s)\,ds\right), \qquad K = \frac{\Theta_0}{3} + \Sigma_0 . \end{equation*} Here $\Theta$ denotes the solution of the scalar Raychaudhuri comparison equation and $K$ controls the spatial metric distortion. For every finite time strictly before the comparison barrier, $\kappa_{\mathrm{L}}(\tau)$ is positive. When the comparison solution has a finite blow-up time, the explicit comparison coefficient approaches zero as that time is approached from below. The comparison barrier is a boundary of the estimate and is not, by itself, a statement that the physical congruence develops a focal point or spacetime singularity. The result is structurally analogous to scale-invariant non-collapse estimates in geometric flow, but is mathematically distinct from Perelman's $\kappa$-noncollapsing theorem for Ricci flow.

classification.title_zh: 基于 Raychaudhuri 比较的尺度不变非坍缩
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为超曲面正交的类时测地线汇建立了一个尺度不变的空间非坍缩估计。该结果扩展了先前基于 Raychaudhuri 的构造；在先前构造中，一个关于膨胀的比较估计被用来控制沿该汇输运的区域的体积。这里新增的要素是对由膨胀和剪切所诱导的空间距离畸变的定量估计。假设初始空间几何在尺度 r0 之前是非坍缩的，并且膨胀、剪切和类时 Ricci 曲率满足合适的均匀界，则在 Raychaudhuri 比较解的首次爆破时间之前，我们得到 Vol_{h_τ}(B_{h_τ}(p_τ,r)) ≥ κ_L(τ) r^3，其中 κ_L(τ) = κ_0 e^{-3Kτ} exp(∫_0^τ Θ(s) ds)，K = Θ_0/3 + Σ_0。这里 Θ 表示标量 Raychaudhuri 比较方程的解，K 控制空间度规畸变。对于比较屏障之前的每个有限时间，κ_L(τ) 为正。当比较解具有有限爆破时间时，显式比较系数在从下方趋近该时间时趋于零。比较屏障是该估计的边界，其本身并不表示物理汇发展出焦点或时空奇点。该结果在结构上类似于几何流中的尺度不变非坍缩估计，但在数学上不同于 Perelman 关于 Ricci 流的 κ-非坍缩定理。
classification.one_liner: 在经典广义相对论几何中，用 Raychaudhuri 比较给出类时测地线汇的尺度不变空间非坍缩估计，并明确其与 Perelman κ-非坍缩定理的区别。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论的数学结构，围绕 Raychaudhuri 方程和测地线汇的非坍缩估计，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息字典；对经典引力支线有直接相关性，对全息主线相关性较低。

2610.07934v1.title: Horizon-Scale Corrections to Black Hole Geometry from a Conserved Quantum Atmosphere
2610.07934v1.abstract: Black holes are usually described either as classical geometries on which quantum fields propagate or as objects whose complete quantum description lies beyond semiclassical gravity. Hawking radiation already shows, however, that a black hole is not an exactly isolated system: the horizon carries a thermal scale and, after coarse graining, may be associated with fluctuations, dissipation and environmental correlations. Whether this horizon-scale openness can be encoded directly in the gravitational background, before any stochastic treatment of the metric, remains an open question. Here we answer it by introducing, for the first time, a conserved Hawking-scale anisotropic source representing the coarse-grained near-horizon atmosphere and solving the Einstein equations for a static black hole at fixed ADM mass. The dressed geometry has a renormalized mass function, a self-consistently shifted horizon and a modified surface gravity. Because the same lapse governs the horizon and timelike geodesics, the thermal response is accompanied by a correlated orbital restructuring: the effective potential is renormalized, the ISCO moves inward and the near-horizon residence time increases. The construction adds no Langevin force to a fixed Schwarzschild background; rather, it defines a deterministic dressed mean geometry, providing a controlled background on which stochastic metric fluctuations may subsequently be treated in the Einstein-Langevin framework. This establishes the deterministic mean-field sector as the necessary first step for future stochastic gravity programs addressing horizon-scale openness.

classification.title_zh: 来自守恒量子大气的黑洞几何视界尺度修正
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞通常要么被描述为量子场在其上传播的经典几何，要么被描述为其完整量子描述超出半经典引力的对象。然而霍金辐射已表明黑洞并非严格孤立系统：视界携带热尺度，粗粒化后可能与涨落、耗散和环境关联相关。视界尺度的开放性是否能在对度规作任何随机处理之前直接编码进引力背景，仍是未决问题。我们通过首次引入一个守恒的霍金尺度各向异性源来代表粗粒化的近视界大气，并在固定 ADM 质量下为静态黑洞求解 Einstein 方程，从而回答该问题。修饰后的几何具有重整化质量函数、自洽移动的视界和修改的表面引力。由于同一 lapse 同时支配视界和类时测地线，热响应伴随着相关的轨道重构：有效势被重整化，ISCO 向内移动，近视界停留时间增加。该构造并未在固定 Schwarzschild 背景上加入 Langevin 力；相反，它定义了一个确定性的修饰平均几何，为之后在 Einstein-Langevin 框架中处理随机度规涨落提供受控背景。这确立了确定性平均场部分作为未来处理视界尺度开放性的随机引力计划的必要第一步。
classification.one_liner: 通过引入守恒的霍金尺度各向异性源并求解 Einstein 方程，得到带有移动视界、修正表面引力与向内移动 ISCO 的确定性修饰黑洞几何，为随机引力提供平均场背景。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞时空几何、视界修正、表面引力与 ISCO/测地线效应；但并非 AdS/CFT 全息研究，也未使用全息字典。

2610.07977v1.title: Time-Frequency Analysis for LISA: Galactic Foreground Modulation
2610.07977v1.abstract: Observations by the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will contain time-varying, cyclostationary confusion noise from the Galaxy, which is naturally handled using time-frequency analysis methods. We present a fast, forward model that maps the parameterized Galactic gravitational-wave luminosity density onto the annually modulated, unresolved confusion foreground in the complete set of time-delay interferometry channels. The line-of-sight luminosity integral is evaluated on a HEALPix grid and decomposed into spherical harmonics, while the detector response is decomposed analytically, independent of the Galaxy model, such that a new Galactic model costs a single map evaluation, transformation, and contraction. We compute the modulated covariance beyond the standard low-frequency limit, expanding the LISA response to second order in finite armlength corrections, and to first order in the unequal-arm corrections. These effects change the normalized modulation curves by up to $\sim\!0.23\%$ and $0.64\%$ for finite armlength corrections at $3$ and $5$ mHz respectively, and by $\sim\!0.074\%$ and $0.71\%$ for unequal-arm corrections in the self and cross channels respectively. Using the fast, forward model and a notional disk-and-bulge Galaxy model, we construct a Fisher matrix from the time-dependent channel covariance and forecast that one year of observation constrains the disk scale width and scale height relative to the distance to the Galactic center at the $8\%$ and $12\%$ levels respectively, and leaves the strongly correlated bulge fraction and bulge radius individually unconstrained.

classification.title_zh: 面向 LISA 的时频分析：银河系前景调制
classification.abstract_zh: 激光干涉空间天线（LISA）的观测将包含来自银河系的时变、循环平稳混淆噪声；这类噪声自然适合用时频分析方法处理。我们提出一个快速正向模型，将参数化的银河系引力波光度密度映射到完整时间延迟干涉测量（TDI）通道中经年度调制的未分辨混淆前景。视线光度积分在 HEALPix 网格上计算并分解为球谐函数，而探测器响应被解析分解，且与银河系模型无关，因此一个新的银河系模型只需一次地图计算、变换和收缩。我们计算了超出标准低频极限的调制协方差，并将 LISA 响应展开到有限臂长修正的二阶以及不等臂修正的一阶。对于有限臂长修正，这些效应在 3 mHz 和 5 mHz 处分别使归一化调制曲线改变约 0.23% 和 0.64%；对于不等臂修正，在自通道和交叉通道中分别改变约 0.074% 和 0.71%。利用该快速正向模型和一个假想的盘-核球银河系模型，我们从随时间变化的通道协方差构造 Fisher 矩阵，并预测一年观测对盘标度宽度和标度高度相对于银心距离的约束分别达到 8% 和 12% 水平，而强相关的核球比例和核球半径各自仍不受约束。
classification.one_liner: 提出快速正向时频模型，计算 LISA 中银河系引力波前景的年度调制并预测盘/核球参数约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 与全息对偶、量子引力、纠缠/复杂度等无直接关系；主题是 LISA 引力波数据分析与银河系前景建模。

2610.08140v1.title: Impact of Correlated Test-Mass Noise on Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background Searches with Space-Based Interferometers
2610.08140v1.abstract: The stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) is a major science target of future space-based interferometers because it encodes information about unresolved astrophysical populations and physical processes in the early Universe. Its stochastic nature, however, means that its detection and parameter inference rely on distinguishing its statistical contribution to the data from that of instrumental noise. In particular, both the SGWB and instrumental noise contribute to the data covariance, so an incomplete noise model can be misinterpreted as part of the SGWB and thereby bias the inferred spectrum and its parameters. Here we investigate this effect in the presence of correlations between the acceleration (ACC) noises of adjacent test masses (TMs) in each spacecraft. We simulate the correlated noise at the single-link level, propagate it through the moving-orbit response into the time-delay interferometry (TDI) observables, and analyze the resulting TDI auto spectra with two Bayesian frequency-domain templates: the Corr. Template includes the correlated-noise covariance, whereas the Non-Corr. Template neglects it. We find that, when correlated ACC noise is present in the mock data, the Non-Corr. Template exhibits systematic parameter offsets that generally become more pronounced with increasing correlation amplitude. In contrast, the Corr. Template recovers the injected SGWB and instrumental-noise parameters substantially more accurately. These results demonstrate that correlations in test-mass ACC noise can constitute a relevant systematic for space-based SGWB searches and motivate their explicit inclusion in mission-realistic noise models and inference pipelines.

classification.title_zh: 相关测试质量噪声对基于空间干涉仪的随机引力波背景搜寻的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 随机引力波背景（SGWB）是未来空间干涉仪的主要科学目标之一，因为它编码了未分辨的天体物理种群和早期宇宙物理过程的信息。然而，其随机性质意味着探测和参数推断依赖于将其对数据的统计贡献与仪器噪声区分开。特别地，SGWB 和仪器噪声都对数据协方差有贡献，因此不完整的噪声模型可能被误认为 SGWB 的一部分，从而偏置推断的谱及其参数。本文研究每个航天器中相邻测试质量（TM）的加速度（ACC）噪声之间存在相关性时的这一效应。我们在单链路层面模拟相关噪声，将其通过运动轨道响应传播到时间延迟干涉（TDI）观测量，并用两个贝叶斯频域模板分析得到的 TDI 自谱：Corr. 模板包含相关噪声协方差，而非 Corr. 模板忽略它。我们发现，当模拟数据中存在相关 ACC 噪声时，非 Corr. 模板表现出系统性参数偏移，且通常随相关幅度增加而更显著。相反，Corr. 模板能更准确地恢复注入的 SGWB 和仪器噪声参数。这些结果表明，测试质量 ACC 噪声中的相关性可能构成空间 SGWB 搜寻的相关系统误差，并促使在任务真实的噪声模型和推断流程中明确包含它们。
classification.one_liner: 研究表明相邻测试质量加速度噪声相关性会系统性偏置空间干涉仪随机引力波背景参数估计，而包含相关噪声协方差的模板可显著改善参数恢复。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波观测与数据分析方向，可作为经典引力支线文献；但与全息对偶及所列全息重点标签无直接关系。

2610.08399v1.title: Self-lensing of gravitational waves from binary extreme-mass-ratio inspirals: Extended caustics and paired flashes
2610.08399v1.abstract: We investigate strong gravitational lensing of gravitational waves from a compact source orbiting a Kerr black hole, motivated by self-lensing in binary extreme-mass-ratio inspirals. In the geometric-optics limit, we construct a point-to-point lens map from null-geodesic integrals and use the Jacobi map to compute the strain magnification of individual images. While lensed signals are generally demagnified, we show that they can be strongly amplified near the extended caustics of the Kerr lens map. For suitable source--observer geometries, the orbit crosses a caustic twice per revolution, producing two amplification peaks. Their arrival-time separation depends on the black-hole spin, observer inclination, and orbital radius through both the source motion and propagation delays. These signatures might offer a means of constraining the source--observer geometry and probing the spacetime of the central black hole.

classification.title_zh: 双星极端质量比旋近中引力波的自透镜效应：扩展焦散与成对闪光
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究紧凑源绕Kerr黑洞运动时引力波的强引力透镜效应，其动机是双星极端质量比旋近中的自透镜。在几何光学极限下，我们从零测地线积分构造点对点透镜映射，并使用Jacobi映射计算单个像的应变放大率。虽然透镜化信号通常会被缩小，但我们表明在Kerr透镜映射的扩展焦散附近它们可以被强烈放大。对于合适的源-观测者几何，轨道每转一圈会两次穿过焦散，产生两个放大峰。其到达时间间隔依赖于黑洞自旋、观测者倾角和轨道半径，通过源运动和传播延迟共同决定。这些特征可能提供一种约束源-观测者几何并探测中心黑洞时空的手段。
classification.one_liner: 研究EMRI中绕Kerr黑洞运动的源产生的引力波自透镜，发现扩展焦散可造成每圈两次放大峰。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于用户重点的经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究Kerr时空中的引力透镜与引力波，不涉及全息。

2610.08428v1.title: Analytic solutions for the gravitational spin Hall equations and black hole shadows
2610.08428v1.abstract: In general relativity, the geometric optics approximation describes the propagation of high-frequency electromagnetic waves along null geodesics. Beyond this approximation, localized wave packets acquire frequency- and polarization-dependent corrections to null geodesic motion, described by the gravitational spin Hall equations. In this paper, these equations are integrated analytically, to first order in wavelength, in a large class of type D black hole spacetimes, whenever the corresponding null geodesics admit analytic solutions. The same framework yields analytic expressions for the shape of black hole shadows with polarization-dependent corrections.

classification.title_zh: 引力自旋霍尔方程与黑洞阴影的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，几何光学近似将高频电磁波的传播描述为沿零测地线的运动。超出该近似后，局域波包会获得频率和偏振相关的修正，其偏离零测地线运动的行为由引力自旋霍尔方程描述。本文在波长一阶近似下，对一大类 type D 黑洞时空中这些方程进行解析积分，只要相应的零测地线存在解析解即可。同一框架还给出了带偏振相关修正的黑洞阴影形状的解析表达式。
classification.one_liner: 在 type D 黑洞时空中解析求解波长一阶的引力自旋霍尔方程，并给出偏振修正下的黑洞阴影解析形状。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接研究黑洞时空中的经典波传播修正与黑洞阴影，与用户标注的经典引力重点标签高度相关。

2610.08459v1.title: Line-of-sight Acceleration Driven Effects in Eccentric Compact Binary Coalescences
2610.08459v1.abstract: The line-of-sight acceleration (LOSA) effect, imprinted in the gravitational wave (GW) signal of an inspiralling compact binary by an external gravitational potential, is one of the most promising means of probing the environment of compact binaries on a single-event basis. However, this effect is potentially degenerate with other low-frequency effects, particularly the binary's orbital eccentricity. LOSA effects and orbital eccentricity can mimic each other if only one or the other (but not both) are accounted for in the waveform template. In this work, we present the (2, 2) mode, leading eccentric harmonic, frequency-domain phase correction incurred by an accelerating eccentric compact binary, and discuss inconsistencies pertaining to this phase correction in the literature. We show that the degeneracy between LOSA and orbital eccentricity can be resolved if both effects are modeled in the template. To demonstrate this, we inject a GW170817-like signal, with eccentricity and LOSA added to it, and recover the parameters of the injected signal assuming an A+ like noise power spectral density (PSD) of the LVK detector network. We find that the true LOSA and eccentricity parameters, along with other binary parameters, are recovered within the $90\%$ credible interval (CI). This study highlights the importance of incorporating LOSA in eccentric waveform models to robustly and reliably estimate LOSA and eccentricity.

classification.title_zh: 偏心致密双星并合中视线加速度驱动效应
classification.abstract_zh: 视线加速度（LOSA）效应由外部引力势印刻在旋近致密双星的引力波信号中，是在单事件基础上探测致密双星环境最有前景的手段之一。然而，该效应可能与其他低频效应简并，特别是双星的轨道偏心率。若波形模板中只考虑二者之一而未同时考虑两者，LOSA效应与轨道偏心率可以相互模仿。在本工作中，我们给出了加速偏心致密双星所导致的(2,2)模式、主导偏心谐波的频域相位修正，并讨论了文献中与该相位修正有关的不一致之处。我们表明，如果在模板中同时对两种效应建模，LOSA与轨道偏心率之间的简并可以被打破。为证明这一点，我们注入一个类似GW170817的信号，并在其中加入偏心率和LOSA，假设LVK探测器网络具有类似A+的噪声功率谱密度（PSD），恢复注入信号的参数。我们发现，真实的LOSA和偏心率参数以及其他双星参数均在90%可信区间（CI）内被恢复。本研究强调了将LOSA纳入偏心波形模型以稳健可靠地估计LOSA和偏心率的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 论文研究偏心致密双星引力波中视线加速度与轨道偏心率的简并，并表明同时建模二者可在A+灵敏度下准确恢复参数。

2610.08492v1.title: Line-of-Sight Acceleration-driven waveform corrections for unequal-mass compact binary coalescences
2610.08492v1.abstract: A constant line-of-sight acceleration (LOSA) of the centre-of-mass of a quasi-circular compact binary coalescence (CBC) leads to modulations in the gravitational-wave (GW) waveform at $-4$ post-Newtonian (PN) order. In our previous work, we calculated the phase and amplitude corrections only for the $(\ell,m) = (2,2)$ mode. The gravitational wave event GW190814 has recently attracted considerable attention because it has been suggested to provide evidence for a nonzero LOSA. However, several LOSA analyses of GW190814 employ higher-order-mode waveform models, such as \texttt{IMRPhenomXPHM}, while incorporating LOSA corrections only for the dominant (2,2) mode. This approximation assumes that their omission has a negligible impact on parameter estimation. In this paper, we present a self-consistent implementation of LOSA in a higher-mode waveform model by deriving the corresponding phase and amplitude corrections. We show that these corrections are essential for asymmetric binaries such as GW190814 and that neglecting them biases parameter inference. We also discuss inconsistencies in the derivation and implementation of LOSA corrections in waveform models in the literature that include higher-order modes.

classification.title_zh: 视线加速度驱动的非等质量致密双星并合波形修正
classification.abstract_zh: 准圆轨道致密双星并合质心的恒定视线加速度（LOSA）会在-4后牛顿（PN）阶导致引力波波形调制。在此前工作中，我们仅计算了(ℓ,m)=(2,2)模式的相位和振幅修正。引力波事件GW190814近期受到广泛关注，因为有研究提出它提供了非零LOSA的证据。然而，若干针对GW190814的LOSA分析采用了包含高阶模式的波形模型，例如IMRPhenomXPHM，却只对主导的(2,2)模式加入LOSA修正。这种近似假定忽略高阶模式修正对参数估计影响可忽略。本文通过推导相应的相位和振幅修正，给出了在高阶模式波形模型中自洽实现LOSA的方法。我们表明，这些修正对于像GW190814这样的非对称双星至关重要，忽略它们会使参数推断产生偏差。我们还讨论了文献中在包含高阶模式的波形模型里对LOSA修正的推导和实现中存在的不一致之处。
classification.one_liner: 将视线加速度修正自洽地推广到包含高阶模式的引力波波形，并指出忽略这些修正会偏置非对称双星如GW190814的参数推断。

2610.08588v1.title: Constraining the gravitational-wave breathing mode with LVK antenna patterns and GWTC data
2610.08588v1.abstract: Metric theories of gravity admit a massless breathing scalar $b$ besides the tensor modes $+$ and $\times$. Many scalar--tensor models predict a much smaller breathing amplitude; gravitational quantum field theory (GQFT) instead allows $h_b$ comparable to the tensor amplitudes. We evaluate the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA (LVK) antenna patterns with PyCBC, including Michelson suppression of $b$. Here $F_b$ is the breathing antenna pattern and $\mathcal{S}_b=\sum_d F_b^{d2}$ is the network breathing power. At the H1 zenith at the GW150914 epoch, $F_b\sim 5\times 10^{-6}$; for $72$ Gravitational-wave Transient Catalog (GWTC) events with packaged strain the median inclination gain in $\mathcal{S}_b$ is $\sim 34\times$. Ranking multi-detector GWTC events (network $\mathrm{SNR}\ge 8$, $\ge 2$ sites) by $\mathrm{SNR}\sqrt{\mathcal{S}_b^{*}}$ identifies loud O4 triggers and GW170817 as geometric targets. Parameter-estimation (PE) weighted $\mathcal{S}_b$ on twelve events shows that the true sky can suppress this ranking (GW170817) and that GW200129_065458, GW150914, and GW190814 have the highest PE-weighted $\mathcal{S}_b$ for $\xi$ in $h_b=\xi h_+$ (GR: $\xi\equiv 0$). An HLV design-noise injection grid gives $\ln B(\mathrm{GR}+b/\mathrm{GR})\approx 13$ ($4$) for $\xi=1$ ($0.5$) on an inclined sky ($\mathcal{S}_b\sim 0.18$); near zenith ($\mathcal{S}_b\sim 0.016$) the $\xi$ posterior remains unconstrained. The GWTC limits are semi-joint: masses and spins fixed at PE medians, while $d_L$, $\theta_{JN}$, sky, and $\xi$ vary within PE-informed priors. Eleven of twelve events are analyzed (GW170817 omitted: PE sky on the breathing null). None favors $\mathrm{GR}+b$; $|\xi|_{90\%}\approx 0.15$, $0.18$, and $0.23$ for GW150914, GW200129_065458, and GW200311_115853 disfavor $|\xi|\sim\mathcal{O}(1)$, while weaker bounds (including GW190814) still allow that scale.

classification.title_zh: 利用 LVK 天线方向图和 GWTC 数据限制引力波呼吸模式
classification.abstract_zh: 度规引力理论允许无质量呼吸标量 b 与张量模式 +、× 并存。许多标量-张量模型预言的呼吸振幅小得多；而引力量子场论（GQFT）则允许 h_b 与张量振幅相当。我们用 PyCBC 计算 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA（LVK）天线方向图，包括 Michelson 对 b 的抑制。F_b 为呼吸天线方向图，S_b=sum_d F_b^{d2} 为网络呼吸功率。在 GW150914 时期的 H1 天顶，F_b~5×10^-6；对 72 个带有 packaged strain 的 GWTC 事件，S_b 的中位倾角增益约 34 倍。按 SNR·sqrt(S_b*) 对多探测器 GWTC 事件（网络 SNR≥8，≥2 站点）排序，识别出响亮的 O4 触发和 GW170817 作为几何目标。对 12 个事件进行参数估计（PE）加权 S_b 表明，真实天空可抑制该排序（GW170817），而在 h_b=ξh_+ 中（GR: ξ≡0），GW200129_065458、GW150914 和 GW190814 具有最高的 PE 加权 S_b。HLV 设计噪声注入网格给出，对于 ξ=1（0.5），在倾斜天空（S_b~0.18）下 ln B(GR+b/GR)≈13（4）；近天顶（S_b~0.016）下 ξ 后验仍无约束。GWTC 限制是半联合的：质量和自旋固定在 PE 中位数，而 d_L、θ_JN、天空和 ξ 在 PE 信息先验内变化。十二个事件中分析了十一个（GW170817 省略：PE 天空位于呼吸零处）。没有一个偏向 GR+b；GW150914、GW200129_065458 和 GW200311_115853 的 |ξ|_90%≈0.15、0.18、0.23，排除了 |ξ|~O(1)，而较弱的限制（包括 GW190814）仍允许该尺度。
classification.one_liner: 利用 LVK 天线方向图和 GWTC 事件对引力波呼吸标量模式给出约束，未发现支持 GR+b 的证据。

2610.08752v1.title: Learning When Black Hole Hair Is Observable: Physical Identifiability, Generalization, and Observable Complementarity
2610.08752v1.abstract: High interpolation accuracy does not establish that physical parameters are identifiable. We study this distinction in a controlled Kiselev black hole benchmark with a validated timelike-emitter and three-dimensional null-geodesic shooting calculation. The exact $k=0$ boundary provides an analytically known null control because the spacetime becomes Schwarzschild and independent of $w_q$. Ringdown is informative for the deformation amplitude $k$, while photon geometry supplies an independent response direction that resolves much of the $w_q$ degeneracy. Relative to ringdown alone, ringdown plus photon geometry gives a median pointwise $4.54\times$ gain in minimum singular value and a $2.28\times$ improvement in Jacobian condition number. In grouped physical interpolation, identifiable-$w_q$ normalized mean absolute error decreases from 0.309 to 0.087. Random splitting is more optimistic, while directional extrapolation is substantially harder and split-conformal coverage degrades under distribution shift. A non-learned nearest-model inverse shows that the gain is not confined to the tested learned architectures. A uniform 161-phase audit gives a typical normalized prediction shift of $9.48\times10^{-4}$, while a targeted 321-phase audit resolves the remaining forward-feature comparisons. However, frozen HGB and random-forest tail shifts exceed prespecified robustness thresholds. Thus, physical observable complementarity is supported, but inverse-estimator robustness remains conditional. This is a theoretical identifiability benchmark, not an observational constraint.

classification.title_zh: 学习黑洞毛发何时可观测：物理可识别性、泛化与可观测互补性
classification.abstract_zh: 高插值精度并不证明物理参数可识别。我们在一个受控的Kiselev黑洞基准中研究这一区别，使用经过验证的类时发射体和三维零测地线射击计算。精确的 k=0 边界提供了一个解析已知的零对照，因为时空变为Schwarzschild且独立于 w_q。Ringdown对形变振幅 k 有信息，而光子几何提供一个独立的响应方向，解决了 w_q 简并的大部分。相对于单独ringdown，ringdown加光子几何给出最小奇异值中位数逐点 4.54 倍增益，并使Jacobian条件数改善 2.28 倍。在分组物理插值中，可识别 w_q 的归一化平均绝对误差从 0.309 降至 0.087。随机划分更乐观，而方向外推明显更难，分裂共形覆盖在分布移位下退化。非学习最近模型逆表明，该增益不限于所测试的学习架构。均匀 161 相位审计给出典型归一化预测位移 9.48×10^{-4}，而定向 321 相位审计解决了剩余前向特征比较。然而，冻结 HGB 和随机森林尾部偏移超过预设稳健性阈值。因此，物理可观测互补性得到支持，但逆估计器稳健性仍是有条件的。这是理论可识别性基准，不是观测约束。
classification.one_liner: 在Kiselev黑洞基准中，ringdown与光子几何联合可提升毛发参数可识别性，但逆估计器稳健性仍有限，这是理论基准而非观测约束。

2610.07123v1.title: Probing departures from Schwarzschild geometry with the S301 star and kilometre-baseline interferometry
2610.07123v1.abstract: The S301 star reaches a pericentre one tenth that of S2, opening a new regime for probing black-hole spin and departures from Schwarzschild. We develop a post-Newtonian secular Hamiltonian framework for bound geodesics in stationary, axisymmetric spacetimes and compute the maximum projected astrometric deviation over one orbit. At the expected GRAVITY+ precision, S301 can probe several nonrotating geometries and sizeable spin-induced deviations, while kilometre-baseline interferometry can probe much smaller departures, establishing S301 as a powerful test of the spacetime geometry of Sgr A*.

classification.title_zh: 用S301恒星和公里基线干涉测量探测对史瓦西几何的偏离
classification.abstract_zh: S301恒星到达近星点仅为S2的十分之一，为探测黑洞自旋和偏离史瓦西几何开辟了新区域。我们为稳态轴对称时空中的束缚测地线发展了后牛顿长期哈密顿框架，并计算了一个轨道周期内的最大投影天体测量偏差。在预期的GRAVITY+精度下，S301能够探测若干非旋转几何和相当大自旋诱导的偏离，而公里基线干涉测量能够探测小得多的偏离，从而将S301确立为对Sgr A*时空几何的有力检验。
classification.one_liner: 利用S301恒星轨道与公里基线干涉测量，检验Sgr A*是否偏离史瓦西几何并限制黑洞自旋。

2610.07975v1.title: Scalable and sequential inference of the neutron star equation of state with the Einstein Telescope
2610.07975v1.abstract: Future gravitational-wave observatories such as the Einstein Telescope will detect tens of thousands of binary neutron star mergers per year, making gravitational waves a dominant probe of the neutron-star equation of state in the coming decades. However, extracting this information requires hierarchical inference across a rapidly growing catalog of events, and existing methods must restart from scratch whenever a new event arrives, making them impractical at this scale. In this Letter, we introduce a hybrid sequential Monte Carlo algorithm that combines data and likelihood tempering to adaptively update the equation-of-state posterior in batches, reusing previous inference results instead of restarting from a wide prior. Accelerated by GPU hardware, our method infers the equation of state from a simulated month of around 1500 binary neutron star mergers in a few hours on a single GPU, and we project that a full year of detections could be processed in a few days on current hardware. This establishes sequential Monte Carlo as a practical route for real-time hierarchical inference with future gravitational-wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 利用爱因斯坦望远镜对中子星物态方程进行可扩展的序贯推断
classification.abstract_zh: 未来的引力波天文台，如爱因斯坦望远镜，每年将探测到数万次双中子星并合，使引力波在未来几十年成为中子星物态方程的主导探针。然而，提取这些信息需要对快速增长的事件目录进行分层推断，而现有方法在每次新事件到来时都必须从头重启，使其在此规模下不切实际。在这封信中，我们引入一种混合序贯蒙特卡洛算法，它结合数据和似然回火，以批处理方式自适应更新物态方程后验，复用先前的推断结果，而不是从宽先验重新开始。在GPU硬件加速下，我们的方法可在单个GPU上于数小时内从模拟的一个月约1500次双中子星并合中推断物态方程，并预计在当前硬件上可在几天内处理一整年的探测事件。这确立了序贯蒙特卡洛作为未来引力波探测器实时分层推断的一条实用途径。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种GPU加速的混合序贯蒙特卡洛方法，可增量、可扩展地从未来引力波事件目录推断中子星物态方程。

2605.05537v3.title: Implications of the LISA stochastic signal from eccentric stellar mass black hole binaries in vacuum
2605.05537v3.abstract: Astrophysical formation channels of stellar-mass binary black holes (sBBHs) can induce significant orbital eccentricities in their early inspiral. We analyze the implications on the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) from unresolved sBBHs, which can be detected with the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). We develop an improved SGWB model for the case of an idealized Dirac-delta eccentricity distribution, and extend it to the more astrophysical case of a thermal distribution. Using a fully Bayesian framework, we find that, if all binaries have a high initial eccentricity $e_0 \gtrsim 0.9$ at an orbital frequency of $f_{\rm orb} = 10^{-4}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, the resulting SGWB can be robustly distinguished from a background of quasi-circular sBBHs. For a thermal eccentricity distribution, the SGWB is consistent with a circular model when binaries form at $f_{\rm orb} = 10^{-5}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, but leads to significant systematic biases if formation occurs at $f_{\rm orb} = 10^{-4}\,\mathrm{Hz}$. We also show that, when eccentricity is properly accounted for, environmental effects such as dynamical friction can be distinguished from vacuum evolution, but only for sufficiently dense environments with gas densities $\rho \gtrsim 10^{-7}\,\mathrm{g\,cm^{-3}}$. Finally, we show that a LISA detection of the sBBH SGWB would place an upper bound on the maximum eccentricity of the sBBH population in the band of ground-based detectors, with direct implications for template modeling and data analysis. Our results highlight the importance of incorporating eccentricity in SGWB modeling to enable accurate astrophysical interpretation of LISA observations.

classification.title_zh: 真空中偏心恒星级质量黑洞双星所产生 LISA 随机信号的启示
classification.abstract_zh: 恒星级质量双黑洞（sBBHs）的天体物理形成通道可以在其早期旋进阶段诱导显著轨道偏心率。我们分析了未分辨 sBBHs 所产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB）的启示，该背景可被激光干涉空间天线（LISA）探测。我们针对理想化 Dirac-delta 偏心率分布发展了改进的 SGWB 模型，并将其推广到更符合天体物理的热分布情形。利用完全贝叶斯框架，我们发现，若所有双星在轨道频率 f_orb=10^{-4} Hz 处具有高初始偏心率 e_0 ≳ 0.9，则产生的 SGWB 可以被稳健地与准圆 sBBHs 背景区分开。对于热偏心率分布，当双星在 f_orb=10^{-5} Hz 形成时，SGWB 与圆形模型一致；但若形成发生在 f_orb=10^{-4} Hz，则会导致显著的系统偏差。我们还表明，当正确考虑偏心率时，诸如动力学摩擦等环境效应可以与真空演化区分开，但仅在气体密度 ρ ≳ 10^{-7} g cm^{-3} 的足够稠密环境中才能做到。最后，我们表明 LISA 对 sBBH SGWB 的探测将对地基探测器频带内 sBBH 群体的最大偏心率给出上限，这对模板建模和数据分析有直接影响。我们的结果凸显了在 SGWB 建模中纳入偏心率以实现对 LISA 观测进行准确天体物理解释的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 该工作建立了含偏心率的恒星级双黑洞随机引力波背景模型，并评估 LISA 对其与准圆背景及环境效应的区分能力。

2605.15271v2.title: Polarization Analysis of Ringdown Signals
2605.15271v2.abstract: Merging binary black holes exhibit a ringdown phase in which they primarily emit gravitational waves in the shape of damped sinusoids corresponding to quasi-normal modes of the Kerr remnant. In general, each mode carries four degrees of freedom encoding amplitude and phase information. When the modes are excited with equatorial reflection symmetry, as is the case for black hole mergers with spins (anti)aligned to the orbital angular momentum, the symmetry constrains two degrees of freedom. As a result, the relationship between polarization amplitudes and phases in each mode is fixed by the viewing (inclination) angle to the equatorial plane. We use such a constrained model to fit the ringdown signals of both non-precessing and precessing systems such as GW150914 and GW190521, respectively. We show that we can measure the degree of circular polarization and handedness of ringdown signals like those of GW150914, even if only the two LIGO detectors are available; such a polarization measurement can be translated into an inferred source inclination assuming the reflection symmetry above, again using the ringdown signal alone. On the other hand, the constrained polarization model is insufficient to capture the polarization structure of signals from precessing systems, leading to biases in the inferred mode frequencies and amplitudes. We explore the magnitude of this effect by fitting GW190521-like injections with the restricted model, finding weaker predictive accuracy relative to the arbitrary-polarization model and potentially significant systematic biases. As our detectors continue to improve, using the correct polarization model is increasingly important to avoid biased ringdown measurements.

classification.title_zh: 铃宕信号的偏振分析
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合存在铃宕阶段，主要发射对应 Kerr 残余黑洞准正模式的阻尼正弦波形式的引力波。一般来说，每个模式带有四个自由度，编码振幅和相位信息。当模式以赤道反射对称性被激发时——例如自旋与轨道角动量（反）对齐的黑洞并合——这种对称性约束两个自由度。因此，每个模式中的偏振振幅与相位之间的关系由相对赤道面的观测倾角固定。我们使用这种受约束模型拟合非进动和进动系统的铃宕信号，例如 GW150914 和 GW190521。我们表明，即使只有两个 LIGO 探测器可用，也能测量类似 GW150914 铃宕信号的圆偏振度和手性；若假定上述反射对称性，这种偏振测量可仅用铃宕信号反推源倾角。另一方面，受约束偏振模型不足以刻画进动系统信号的偏振结构，导致推断的模式频率和振幅出现偏差。我们通过用受限模型拟合类 GW190521 注入来探讨该效应的幅度，发现相对于任意偏振模型预测精度更弱，并可能存在显著系统偏差。随着探测器不断改进，使用正确的偏振模型对于避免有偏的铃宕测量日益重要。
classification.one_liner: 利用赤道反射对称性约束的偏振模型拟合黑洞并合铃宕，可测量圆偏振与倾角，但进动系统会导致模式频率和振幅偏差。

2607.18633v2.title: Stochastic template banks for GW searches using low-discrepancy sequences
2607.18633v2.abstract: Matched filtering remains the most sensitive method for detecting gravitational waves from compact binary coalescences. The efficiency of such searches depends on how well a discrete template bank covers the underlying parameter space. Conventional geometric, stochastic, and hybrid placement methods can lead to uneven coverage and redundant templates in higher dimensions. Hybrid methods are generally the most efficient among these, while stochastic methods are simpler to implement, particularly when the parameter-space metric is difficult to compute. In practice, both approaches rely on uniform random sampling, which often requires a large number of proposal points to achieve adequate coverage. We find that stochastic template banks constructed using low-discrepancy sequences achieve comparable recovery fractions while requiring 27.5\% fewer proposal points in two dimensions, about 12\% fewer in three dimensions and 17\% fewer in a four-dimensional eccentric equal-spin toy bank. The final template count is much less sensitive to the proposal sampling, consistent with the metric-volume constraints of the covering problem. We introduce a slab-wise coarse prefilter to accelerate candidate rejection for strongly anisotropic metrics. Applied to the 4D toy bank, it gives a total bank-construction speed-up of about $1.28\times$. The primary benefit of low-discrepancy sampling is therefore a reduction in the size of the initial proposal set, leading to lower memory usage and reduced bookkeeping during bank generation. These results show that low-discrepancy sampling provides a simple improvement to stochastic template-bank generation for current and future gravitational-wave searches.

classification.title_zh: 使用低差异序列为引力波搜索构建随机模板库
classification.abstract_zh: 匹配滤波仍然是探测致密双星并合引力波最灵敏的方法。搜索效率取决于离散模板库对底层参数空间的覆盖程度。传统几何、随机和混合放置方法在更高维度中可能导致覆盖不均和冗余模板。混合方法通常最有效，随机方法更易实现，特别是在参数空间度规难以计算时。两种方法通常依赖均匀随机采样，需要大量提议点才能实现充分覆盖。本研究发现，使用低差异序列构建的随机模板库在达到相当恢复分数时，二维所需提议点减少27.5%，三维减少约12%，四维偏心等自旋玩具模板库减少17%。最终模板数对提议采样方式远不敏感，符合覆盖问题的度规体积约束。作者引入分片粗预过滤以加速强各向异性度规下的候选拒绝；应用于四维玩具模板库时总构建速度提升约1.28倍。低差异采样的主要好处是减少初始提议集大小，从而降低模板库生成时的内存使用和簿记开销。这些结果表明低差异采样为当前和未来引力波搜索的随机模板库生成提供了一种简单改进。
classification.one_liner: 提出用低差异序列替代均匀随机采样来生成引力波搜索模板库，可在同等覆盖下减少提议点数量并降低内存开销。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波搜索的模板库生成与数据处理方法，与经典引力/广义相对论支线仅有边缘关联，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力物理。

2510.17511v2.title: Impact of Magnetic Field Topology on Electromagnetic and Gravitational Waves from Binary Neutron Star Merger Remnants
2510.17511v2.abstract: We perform general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations of binary neutron star (BNS) mergers with four distinct magnetic field topologies: (i) a dipole pulsar-like configuration, (ii) a mixed linear superposition of poloidal and toroidal components inside the star, and (iii-iv) two topologies featuring a smooth transition from a confined mixed core to a pulsar-like structure at radii $0.95\,R_{\rm NS}$ and $0.5\,R_{\rm NS}$, with $R_{\rm NS}$ the radius of the star. The latter topologies are explored in BNS merger studies for the first time. We evolve systems with two equations of state (EoS), SLy and WFF1, with ADM masses 2.7 and 2.6, respectively, and include an additional lower-mass SLy binary to probe the behavior of long-lived remnants. We perform an extensive analysis of the emission properties of the systems, both electromagnetic and gravitational waves, and of the properties of the remnants, namely their frequency modes, density eigenfunctions, rotation, temperature, and convective stability. We report three key results: (1) for the first time, we assess the convective stability of magnetized remnants, extending previous unmagnetized analyses; (2) we identify a clear secondary peak in the gravitational-wave spectrum of pulsar-like configurations, consistent with the nonlinear coupling of the $m=0$ and $m=2$ modes, which is absent in other topologies; and (3) the magnetic field topology strongly influences the gravitational wave emission properties to the extent that nearby ($<50\,{\rm Mpc}$) events could allow one to observationally distinguish between different field structures with future gravitational-wave detectors. Across all models, we obtain luminosities compatible with short gamma-ray bursts (sGRBs), with purely poloidal configurations being the most efficient in driving possible relativistic jets.

classification.title_zh: 磁场拓扑对双中子星并合遗迹的电磁波与引力波的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对双中子星（BNS）并合进行了广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟，采用四种不同的磁场拓扑：(i) 类似脉冲星的偶极构型；(ii) 星体内部极向与环向分量的混合线性叠加；(iii-iv) 两种在半径 0.95 R_NS 和 0.5 R_NS 处从受限混合核心平滑过渡到类脉冲星结构的拓扑，其中 R_NS 为星体半径。后两种拓扑首次在 BNS 并合研究中被探索。我们演化了两组状态方程（EoS）系统 SLy 和 WFF1，ADM 质量分别为 2.7 和 2.6，并额外加入一个较低质量的 SLy 双星以探究长寿命遗迹的行为。我们对系统的电磁波与引力波辐射性质以及遗迹性质（即频率模式、密度本征函数、转动、温度和对流稳定性）进行了广泛分析。我们报告三项关键结果：(1) 首次评估磁化遗迹的对流稳定性，扩展了此前未磁化的分析；(2) 在类脉冲星构型的引力波谱中识别出一个清晰的次级峰，与 m=0 和 m=2 模式的非线性耦合一致，而其他拓扑中不存在；(3) 磁场拓扑强烈影响引力波辐射性质，以至于邻近（<50 Mpc）事件可能允许未来引力波探测器在观测上区分不同的场结构。在所有模型中，我们获得与短伽马射线暴（sGRB）相容的光度，其中纯极向构型最有效地驱动可能的相对论性喷流。
classification.one_liner: GRMHD 模拟表明磁场拓扑显著影响双中子星并合遗迹的引力波谱、对流稳定性及电磁喷流效率。
keywords: 广义相对论磁流体力学模拟

2609.23872v2.title: On rigidity of stationary black holes under a nontrapping assumption
2609.23872v2.abstract: We prove that a smooth, regular, asymptotically flat stationary vacuum black hole has a nonextremal Kerr exterior if no null geodesic orthogonal to its stationary Killing field is trapped, establishing the rigidity conjecture of Alexakis, Ionescu, and Klainerman. In the rotating case, we start with the rotational Killing field constructed near the bifurcation sphere and study a maximal domain carrying its complete circle action. The main difficulty is to recover boundary regularity and the curvature condition needed for local Killing extension. We derive uniform estimates along complete rotational orbits from nontrapping and combine them with convexity along short null geodesics. These estimates show that a nonempty remaining boundary in the ergoregion is a timelike photon surface for the stationary quotient metric. Its null geodesics lift to spacetime null geodesics orthogonal to the stationary field. The vacuum circularity identities give their continuation through contact with the ergosurface, keeping their stationary projections in a compact set. This contradicts nontrapping and yields the global rotational symmetry required by black hole uniqueness.

classification.title_zh: 非俘获假设下稳态黑洞的刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，一个光滑、正则、渐近平直的稳态真空黑洞，若不存在与其稳态Killing场正交的被俘获零测地线，则其外部必为非极端Kerr外部，从而建立了Alexakis、Ionescu和Klainerman的刚性猜想。在旋转情形下，我们从分叉球面附近构造的旋转Killing场出发，研究承载其完整圆周作用的最大区域。主要困难在于恢复局部Killing延拓所需的边界正则性与曲率条件。我们从非俘获假设导出沿完整旋转轨道的均匀估计，并将其与短零测地线上的凸性结合。这些估计表明，能层中非空的剩余边界是稳态商度量的类时光子面。其零测地线提升为与稳态场正交的时空零测地线。真空圆性恒等式给出它们穿过与能层表面接触的延拓，并使其稳态投影保持在紧集中。这与非俘获假设矛盾，并给出黑洞唯一性所需的整体旋转对称性。
classification.one_liner: 在非俘获条件下证明渐近平直稳态真空黑洞外部必为非极端Kerr，从而解决Alexakis–Ionescu–Klainerman刚性猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞刚性与唯一性，与用户重点标签匹配；未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2605.04670v2.title: Gravitational Waves from Higgs Preheating after Inflaton $Z_2$-Symmetry Breaking
2605.04670v2.abstract: In this paper, nonperturbative lattice simulations are used to study Higgs preheating and the associated gravitational wave (GW) background after the inflaton $Z_2$ symmetry is broken during inflation. This symmetry breaking generates both trilinear and quartic inflaton-Higgs interactions during preheating. The quartic inflaton-Higgs coupling is characterized by $q_{\phi h}\equiv \lambda_{\phi h}/\lambda_\phi$, while the trilinear interaction enters jointly through $q_{\phi h}$ and $q_\epsilon\equiv m_\phi/(\sqrt{\lambda_\phi}\phi_0)$. The Higgs self-coupling parameter $q_h\equiv \lambda_h/\lambda_\phi$ determines the onset of backreaction through the effective mass induced by Higgs self-interactions. Our simulations show that efficient preheating requires both a sufficiently broad resonance band and delayed backreaction. For $\lambda_\phi=10^{-13}$, the viable parameter region is approximately $q_{\phi h}>10$, $q_h<10^3$, and $q_\epsilon<10^{-5}$. Smaller $q_\epsilon$ keeps the system in a quartic-dominated regime and suppresses the rapid drift of resonance bands, while smaller $q_h$ delays the end of preheating by weakening self-interaction-induced backreaction. The amplified Higgs inhomogeneities source GW through the transverse-traceless part of the anisotropic stress tensor. The lattice results show that the GW spectrum grows rapidly during parametric resonance, broadens through rescattering, and saturates in the nonlinear stage. At late times, the spectrum develops a broad peak with amplitude $\Omega_{\rm gw}\sim10^{-6}$ at production. After redshifting to the present day, the peak frequency is $f\sim10^9\,{\rm Hz}$ with present-day amplitude $\Omega_{\rm gw,0} h^2 \sim 10^{-10}$. These results suggest that high-frequency GW from Higgs preheating may be detectable by future resonant-cavity detectors.
authors: Ruo-Peng Zhang (Chongqing Vocational Institute of Engineering)

classification.title_zh: 暴胀子 Z2 对称性破缺后希格斯预加热产生的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 本文使用非微扰格点模拟研究暴胀期间暴胀子 Z2 对称性破缺后的希格斯预加热及伴随的引力波（GW）背景。该对称性破缺在预加热期间同时产生三线性与四线性暴胀子-希格斯相互作用。四线性暴胀子-希格斯耦合由 q_{\phi h}\equiv \lambda_{\phi h}/\lambda_\phi 表征，而三线性相互作用通过 q_{\phi h} 与 q_\epsilon\equiv m_\phi/(\sqrt{\lambda_\phi}\phi_0) 共同进入。希格斯自耦合参数 q_h\equiv \lambda_h/\lambda_\phi 通过希格斯自相互作用诱导的有效质量决定反作用开始。我们的模拟表明，高效预加热既需要足够宽的共振带，也需要延迟的反作用。对于 \lambda_\phi=10^{-13}，可行参数区域大致为 q_{\phi h}>10、q_h<10^3 和 q_\epsilon<10^{-5}。较小的 q_\epsilon 使系统保持在四线性主导区域并抑制共振带的快速漂移，而较小的 q_h 通过削弱自相互作用诱导的反作用延迟预加热结束。被放大的希格斯非均匀性通过各向异性应力张量的横向无迹部分产生 GW。格点结果显示，GW 谱在参量共振期间快速增长，通过再散射变宽，并在非线性阶段饱和。晚期，谱形成一个宽峰，产生时振幅 \Omega_{\rm gw}\sim10^{-6}。红移到今天后，峰值频率为 f\sim10^9\,{\rm Hz}，今日振幅 \Omega_{\rm gw,0} h^2 \sim 10^{-10}。这些结果表明，来自希格斯预加热的高频 GW 可能被未来谐振腔探测器探测到。
classification.one_liner: 格点模拟表明，暴胀子 Z2 对称性破缺后的希格斯预加热可产生峰值约 10^9 Hz、今日振幅 Ω_gw,0 h^2~10^-10 的高频引力波背景。

2610.06934v1.title: Radii and Scaling Relations of Dark-Matter-Admixed Neutron Stars
2610.06934v1.abstract: The radius of a neutron star is closely related to the equation of state (EOS) of asymmetric nuclear matter, particularly to the nuclear symmetry energy. At fixed stellar mass, the neutron-star radius and the nuclear-matter pressure near saturation density approximately satisfy a pressure--radius (R-P) scaling relation, linking stellar geometry to strong-interaction matter. In the presence of dark matter (DM), changes in the stellar geometry can modify this relation. We investigate how GeV- and sub-GeV-scale DM affects the R-P relation in DM-admixed neutron stars (DANSs) within a gravity-only two-fluid framework. We extend the Buchdahl analytic solution to a two-fluid configuration to demonstrate this scaling and then use 21 nuclear EOSs to fit the relation $R_{\rm NM}=\bar C P_{\rm NM}^{\eta}$ for $1M_\odot$ and $1.4M_\odot$ DANSs. The exponent $\eta$ and coefficient $\bar C$ jointly quantify the DM-induced modification and depend on the DM particle mass, stellar DM content, and self-interaction strength. For bosonic DM, changes in $\eta$ and $\bar C$ occur mainly in the sub-GeV range, whereas significant fermionic-DM effects persist up to about 1.5 GeV. Increasing the DM content or strengthening a repulsive self-interaction generally increases $\eta$ and decreases $\bar C$. The modified R-P relation therefore encodes information about the DM particle mass, abundance, and self-interaction, and affect the extraction of the nuclear EOS from celestial observations. At DM masses of several hundred MeV, both fermionic and bosonic DM can also produce DM-dominated low-mass ($1M_\odot$) DANSs with large radial extensions, for which the conventional scaling relation ceases to apply.

classification.title_zh: 暗物质混合中子星的半径与标度关系
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星半径与不对称核物质的状态方程（EOS）密切相关，尤其与核对称能有关。在固定恒星质量下，中子星半径与饱和密度附近核物质压强近似满足压强—半径（R-P）标度关系，将恒星几何与强相互作用物质联系起来。在存在暗物质（DM）时，恒星几何的变化会修改这一关系。我们在仅引力相互作用的两流体框架中研究GeV和亚GeV尺度暗物质如何影响暗物质混合中子星（DANSs）中的R-P关系。我们将Buchdahl解析解推广到两流体组态以展示该标度关系，然后使用21个核EOS拟合1M⊙和1.4M⊙ DANSs的关系 R_NM = C̄ P_NM^η。指数η和系数C̄共同量化暗物质引起的修正，并依赖于暗物质粒子质量、恒星暗物质含量和自相互作用强度。对于玻色暗物质，η和C̄的变化主要发生在亚GeV范围，而费米暗物质的显著效应持续到约1.5 GeV。增加暗物质含量或增强排斥自相互作用通常会增大η并减小C̄。因此，修改后的R-P关系编码了暗物质粒子质量、丰度和自相互作用的信息，并影响从天体观测中提取核EOS。在几百MeV的暗物质质量下，费米和玻色暗物质均可产生具有大径向延展的暗物质主导的低质量（1M⊙）DANSs，此时传统标度关系不再适用。
classification.one_liner: 暗物质会改变暗物质混合中子星的压强—半径标度关系，其修正取决于暗物质质量、丰度与自相互作用。

2610.07241v1.title: Radial Modes of Hot Neutrino-Trapped Hybrid Stars
2610.07241v1.abstract: We study the fundamental radial oscillation mode of hot hadronic and hybrid stars under conditions relevant to proto-neutron stars and neutron-star merger remnants. The stellar backgrounds are constructed from finite-temperature equations of state with a covariant density functional for hadronic matter and three-flavor 2SC quark matter at high density. We consider two isentropic configurations in both neutrino-transparent matter and with trapped electron neutrinos at fixed electron-lepton fraction. For trapped matter we compare a Gibbs-type construction with global electron-lepton-number conservation to a locally constrained Maxwell-type prescription; in both cases the fixed-entropy stellar equation of state contains an extended coexistence region and no sharp interface requiring conversion rate-dependent junction conditions. We find that the fundamental radial frequency follows the corresponding purely hadronic sequence up to the onset of deconfinement and then decreases relative to it. Neutrino trapping shifts this dynamical signature to larger stellar masses and central pressures, reflecting the delayed appearance of quark matter. The Maxwell-type prescription moves the onset of deconfinement to still higher central pressure and produces a more rapid decrease of the mode frequency near the stability limit. We quantify the deconfinement effect through the fractional frequency shift between hybrid and hadronic stars at equal gravitational mass. These results show that the fundamental radial mode provides a sensitive dynamical probe of the interplay among entropy, lepton trapping, phase-transition construction, and quark deconfinement in hot compact stars.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 热中微子囚禁混合星的径向模式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与原型中子星和中子星并合残骸相关条件下，热强子星和混合星的基本径向振荡模式。星体背景由有限温度状态方程构建：强子物质采用协变密度泛函，高密度区采用三味 2SC 夸克物质。我们考虑两种等熵构型，分别处于中微子透明物质中以及固定电子轻子分数下存在囚禁电子中微子的情形。对于中微子囚禁物质，我们将具有全局电子轻子数守恒的 Gibbs 型构造与局部约束的 Maxwell 型方案进行比较；在这两种情形中，固定熵的星体状态方程都包含一个扩展的共存区，而不存在需要依赖于转化速率的界面连接条件的尖锐界面。我们发现，基本径向频率在退禁闭开始之前遵循相应的纯强子星序列，随后相对于该序列下降。中微子囚禁把这一动力学特征移到更大的星体质量和中心压强，反映了夸克物质出现被延迟。Maxwell 型方案将退禁闭开始移到更高的中心压强，并在稳定性极限附近产生更快的模式频率下降。我们通过在相同引力质量下混合星与强子星的分数频率移动来量化退禁闭效应。这些结果表明，基本径向模式为热致密星中熵、轻子囚禁、相变构造和夸克退禁闭之间的相互作用提供了一个灵敏的动力学探针。
classification.one_liner: 热中微子囚禁混合星的基本径向振荡频率可作为夸克退禁闭及相变构造的灵敏动力学探针。

2604.21039v2.title: Conformal prediction for uncertainties in the neutron star equation of state
2604.21039v2.abstract: We study uncertainties in the equation of state of neutron stars using conformal prediction as a distribution-free and model-agnostic method that provides coverage guarantees. In particular, we apply the Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) method to posterior samples calculated from Bayesian inference, creating reliable uncertainty bands without assuming a specific form of the underlying distribution. We first construct CQR bands using a polytropic equation of state and the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations. We then apply CQR as a postprocessing step to the posterior distribution of neutron star mass-radius relations provided by the NMMA collaboration and to quantum Monte Carlo calculations of pure neutron matter. In all cases, empirical coverage studies confirm the robustness of the method.

classification.title_zh: 中子星状态方程不确定性的共形预测
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用共形预测作为一种无分布、模型无关且具有覆盖保证的方法，研究中子星状态方程中的不确定性。特别地，我们将共形化分位数回归（CQR）方法应用于贝叶斯推断得到的后验样本，在不对底层分布形式作假设的情况下构建可靠的置信带。我们首先使用多方状态方程和 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程构建 CQR 带。随后，我们将 CQR 作为后处理步骤应用于 NMMA 合作组提供的中子星质量-半径关系后验分布，以及纯中子物质的量子蒙特卡洛计算。在所有情形中，经验覆盖研究都证实了该方法的稳健性。
classification.one_liner: 将共形化分位数回归用于中子星状态方程后验，提供无分布假设的不确定性带并验证覆盖性。

2610.08860v1.title: Gravitational scattering amplitudes in collinear and high-energy limits
2610.08860v1.abstract: In this thesis we study the high-energy and collinear behaviour of gravitational scattering amplitudes and their relation to classical scattering and radiation observables. Multi-Regge kinematics, characterised by a strong rapidity ordering, provides the factorised building blocks governing the leading logarithmic structure. Relaxing this ordering to next-to-multi-Regge kinematics allows two neighbouring particles to have comparable rapidities and provides the real emission building blocks entering at next-to-leading logarithmic accuracy. We extract the next-to-multi-Regge impact factor from tree-level MHV amplitudes for pure gravitons and derive its gravitational splitting functions. We then use BCFW recursion relations to reconstruct the five-point tree amplitude for two massive scalars scattering with the emission of one graviton. Its high-energy limit yields the massive scalar--graviton impact factor and, through the KMOC formalism, a representation of the leading high-energy collinear waveform. Finally, by sewing the relevant vertices across unitarity cuts, we construct the elastic \(H\) kernel, its radiative extension and a classical next-to-multi-Regge kernel. The latter reproduces the standard \(H\) kernel in the multi-Regge limit and the universal Weinberg current in the soft limit.

classification.title_zh: 共线与高能极限下的引力散射振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 在本论文中，我们研究引力散射振幅的高能与共线行为，以及它们与经典散射和辐射可观测量之间的关系。多重Regge运动学以强快度排序为特征，提供了支配领头对数结构的因子化构件。将这种排序放宽到次重Regge运动学，允许两个相邻粒子具有可比的快度，并给出进入次领头对数精度的实发射构件。我们从纯引力子的树级MHV振幅中提取次重Regge冲击因子，并推导其引力劈裂函数。随后，我们使用BCFW递推关系重建两个大质量标量散射并发射一个引力子的五点树振幅。其高能极限给出大质量标量-引力子冲击因子，并通过KMOC形式得到领头高能共线波形的一种表示。最后，通过在对幺正割上缝合相关顶点，我们构造弹性H核、其辐射扩展以及一个经典次重Regge核。后者在多重Regge极限下再现标准H核，并在软极限下再现普适Weinberg流。
classification.one_liner: 本论文用多重/次重Regge运动学、冲击因子与BCFW/KMOC方法研究引力散射振幅的高能和共线极限，并构造经典H核与辐射波形。

2610.09938v1.title: Fast holographic inversion of superconducting domes
2610.09938v1.abstract: A holographic superconductor whose scalar mass depends on the gauge field strength, $M(\Fsq)$, reproduces a superconducting dome for a suitable $M$, and recovering that $M$ from a given dome has so far taken days for a single training run. We propose a new way of training this model, with which an inversion takes from about ten minutes to an hour. Training needs the gradient of the condition that fixes the critical temperature, which the earlier method obtains by finite differences, repeating the bulk integrations for every training parameter. Here that condition is obtained, without any fit, from two integrations started at the horizon and at the boundary, and its derivative with respect to $M$ is an integral over the same two solutions, so the gradient needs no integration of its own. We use the speed to study the part of $M$ that a dome cannot determine, on the interval between the value $\Fsq$ takes at the horizon for the lowest doping and $\Fsq=0$, at which $M$ is the scalar mass $M(0)$ that fixes the dimension of the dual operator. We hold the scalar mass at several values, which we call pinned masses, retrain everything else at each, and find that the reconstructions agree wherever the horizons of the dome reach, including the minima of $M$, and differ only on that interval. A rule that keeps the reconstruction with the simplest closed form recovers both the scalar mass and the mass function of a test dome. On Gaussian and double-Gaussian domes and on the measured phase diagrams of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ and 2M-WS$_{2}$, however, the pinned mass it keeps rests on ties or on narrow margins, so for these targets the scalar mass is left open. The dome thus constrains $M$ where its horizons reach, and fixing the dimension of the dual operator needs a second observable.

classification.title_zh: 超导穹顶的快速全息反演
classification.abstract_zh: 一个标量质量依赖规范场强度 M(F^2) 的全息超导体，在合适的 M 下重现超导穹顶，而此前从给定穹顶反演该 M 单次训练需数天。我们提出一种新的训练方法，使反演耗时约十分钟到一小时。训练需要固定临界温度条件的梯度；先前方法用有限差分获得该梯度，对每个训练参数重复体时空积分。这里该条件无需拟合，由分别从视界和边界出发的两个积分得到，而其对 M 的导数是对同样两个解的积分，因此梯度本身无需额外积分。我们利用这一速度研究穹顶无法确定的 M 部分，即最低掺杂下视界处 F^2 取值与 F^2=0 之间的区间；在 F^2=0 处 M 是决定对偶算符维数的标量质量 M(0)。我们把标量质量固定于若干值（称为钉扎质量），每次重新训练其余部分，发现重建结果在穹顶视界所达之处一致，包括 M 的极小值，仅在该区间不同。一条保留最简闭式重建的规则可恢复测试穹顶的标量质量与质量函数。然而在高斯与双高斯穹顶以及 YBa2Cu3Oy 和 2M-WS2 的测量相图上，它保留的钉扎质量依赖于平局或狭窄边缘，因此对这些目标标量质量仍未确定。因此穹顶在其视界所达之处约束 M，而确定对偶算符维数需要第二个观测量。
classification.one_liner: 提出快速训练方法反演全息超导穹顶，并指出穹顶只能在其视界所达处约束 M，确定对偶算符维数还需第二个观测量。

2610.10045v1.title: The Komar charges of type~II supergravity and supersymmetric localization
2610.10045v1.abstract: We compute the on-shell closed, generalized Komar charges associated to an arbitrary Killing vector of the two 10-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity theories which are the low-energy effective field theories of the type~IIA and IIB superstrings. We study different rewritings of this charge in terms of Page charges and forms with special properties that are used in the derivation of thermodynamical relations in black $p$-brane spacetimes. 2610.10348v1.title: Maximally symmetric black holes with torsion in Lovelock gravity
2610.10348v1.abstract: We analyze the existence of static black hole solutions with maximally symmetric horizons and nontrivial torsion in five-dimensional Lovelock gravity. For each symmetry class, we obtain a black hole solution characterized by two independent constants. We also determine the conserved charges associated with these solutions.

classification.title_zh: Lovelock引力中含挠率的极大对称黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了五维Lovelock引力中具有极大对称视界和非平凡挠率的静态黑洞解的存在性。对于每个对称类，我们得到了由两个独立常数刻画的黑洞解。我们还确定了与这些解对应的守恒荷。
classification.one_liner: 在五维Lovelock引力中构造带挠率、极大对称视界的静态黑洞解并计算守恒荷。

2610.10504v1.title: Black hole radial geometry from a quantum spin chain
2610.10504v1.abstract: We show that the radial differential equation for a scalar field in an anti-de Sitter black brane background can be encoded in an exactly solvable semi-infinite spin chain independent of dimensionality. The radial coordinate emerges as lattice quasimomentum. Spin coherence encodes the geometry, while the spectrum and response recover gravitational observables and yield exact screening-mass sum rules. We implement the finite chain on a superconducting processor. At finite filling and low energies, the model yields a conformal field theory in a coordinate proportional to proper radial distance.

classification.title_zh: 来自量子自旋链的黑洞径向几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，反德西特黑膜背景下标量场的径向微分方程可以编码在一个与维度无关、精确可解的半无限自旋链中。径向坐标表现为格点准动量。自旋相干性编码几何，而谱和响应可恢复引力观测量并给出精确的屏蔽质量求和规则。我们在超导处理器上实现了有限链。在有限填充和低能下，该模型在与固有径向距离成正比的坐标中给出共形场论。
classification.one_liner: 将 AdS 黑膜中标量场径向方程映射为可解量子自旋链，并在超导量子处理器上实现。

2610.10540v1.title: Null string holography in AdS from local BRST descent
2610.10540v1.abstract: We show that the radial sector of a Carroll-Weyl gauged null string in Poincar\'e $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ is locally trivial in BRST cohomology. In a quotient-adapted BFV basis, the radial coordinate, its conjugate momentum, and the associated ghosts form a contractible quartet. An explicit contracting homotopy extends this reduction to the full algebra of local spatial jets, leaving precisely the $(D-1)$-dimensional ILST BRST complex. The same quartet carries zero net Virasoro central charge, so that the anomaly condition of the parent theory, $D=27$, descends to the ILST condition $d=26$.

classification.title_zh: AdS 中零弦全息：来自局部 BRST 下降
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，庞加莱 AdS_D 中 Carroll-Weyl 规范零弦的径向扇区在 BRST 上同调中是局部平凡的。在商适配的 BFV 基中，径向坐标、其共轭动量以及相应的鬼场构成一个可缩四重态。显式的收缩同伦将该约化推广到整个局部空间射流代数，恰好留下 (D−1) 维的 ILST BRST 复形。同一个四重态携带零净 Virasoro 中心荷，因此母理论的反常条件 D=27 下降为 ILST 条件 d=26。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS 中，Carroll-Weyl 规范零弦的径向 BRST 扇区可被同伦约化，留下 (D−1) 维 ILST 复形，并将 D=27 反常条件降为 d=26。

2610.08909v1.title: The price of regularity: core gradient instability in nonsingular dyonic black holes
2610.08909v1.abstract: Spacetime singularities displayed by classical black hole solutions are expected to be cured by high-energy effects, beyond the regime of validity of General Relativity. On the other hand, there are well-known examples of classical theories allowing for nonsingular black hole solutions. The most prominent is obtained by complementing the gravitational sector of General Relativity with a minimally coupled nonlinear-electrodynamics sector. It has recently been shown that purely electric/purely magnetic nonsingular black holes in an Einstein-nonlinear-electrodynamics setup are always plagued by a gradient instability. In this work, we derive the quadratic action for linear perturbations of static, spherically symmetric dyonic solutions of Einstein-nonlinear-electrodynamics theories with a general dependence on both invariants. We show that regularity of the center, absence of ghosts and angular gradient stability cannot hold simultaneously: arbitrarily close to a regular center, at least one photon polarization has a negative squared angular propagation speed. We further show that regularity drives one electromagnetic kinetic eigenvalue to zero at the center, which may limit perturbative control near the core. Evading the obstruction requires extending the theory, for example by introducing additional degrees of freedom.

classification.title_zh: 正则性的代价：非奇异双荷黑洞中的核心梯度不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 经典黑洞解所显示的时空奇点预计会被超出广义相对论适用范围的高能效应消除。另一方面，已有一些经典理论允许非奇异黑洞解；最著名的例子是在广义相对论引力部分中加入最小耦合非线性电动力学。最近的研究表明，在 Einstein-非线性电动力学框架中，纯电或纯磁的非奇异黑洞总是存在梯度不稳定性。本文推导了具有对两个不变量一般依赖的 Einstein-非线性电动力学理论中静态球对称双荷解线性扰动的二次作用量。我们证明，中心正则性、无鬼场以及角向梯度稳定性不能同时成立：在任意靠近正则中心处，至少一种光子偏振具有负的角向传播速度平方。我们进一步表明，正则性会驱使一个电磁动能本征值在中心趋于零，这可能限制核心附近的微扰控制。要规避这一阻碍，需要扩展理论，例如引入额外自由度。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-非线性电动力学中，非奇异双荷黑洞的核心正则性、无鬼场与角向梯度稳定性不可兼得。
