2610.09049v1.title: Anisotropic Cosmology with Inhomogeneous $SU(2) $ and $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ Nonlinear $\sigma$-Models
2610.09049v1.abstract: We investigate the cosmological dynamics of the nonlinear $\sigma$-model in a locally rotational symmetric Bianchi V background geometry. We employ the $SU(2)$ and the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ internal symmetries, for which the kinetic metric of the multi-scalar fields is a space of constant curvature. We assume an inhomogeneous ansatz for the scalar fields, such that the $\sigma$-model, which allows the existence of nontrivial solutions in the Bianchi V geometry. For an exponential potential, we perform a detailed analysis of the phase space, we determine the stationary points, and we study their stability properties. The scalar field inhomogeneities prevent both the slow-roll and hyperbolic inflationary epochs. The existence of a cosmological constant is required to describe cosmic acceleration.

classification.title_zh: 具有非均匀 SU(2) 和 SL(2,R) 非线性 sigma 模型的各向异性宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在局部旋转对称的 Bianchi V 背景几何中非线性 σ 模型的宇宙学动力学。我们采用 SU(2) 与 SL(2,R) 内部对称性，其中多标量场的动能度规为常曲率空间。我们对标量场采用非均匀拟设，使该 σ 模型允许在 Bianchi V 几何中存在非平凡解。对于指数势，我们详细分析了相空间，确定了定点，并研究了其稳定性。标量场的非均匀性阻止了慢滚和双曲暴胀阶段。要描述宇宙加速，需要存在宇宙学常数。
classification.one_liner: 在 Bianchi V 各向异性背景中，带指数势的 SU(2)/SL(2,R) 非线性 sigma 模型采用非均匀标量场拟设；相空间分析表明非均匀性禁止慢滚与双曲暴胀，宇宙加速需宇宙学常数。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/宇宙学范畴，涉及 Bianchi V 各向异性背景中的标量场动力学与相空间稳定性分析；不属于全息或量子引力，但与用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论重点标签相关。

2610.09143v1.title: Intrinsic spatial-strain shortcuts in general relativity
2610.09143v1.abstract: We analyze spacetime shortcuts generated by longitudinal contraction and transverse expansion of the intrinsic spatial metric at fixed reference volume. Smooth bounded ultrastatic corridors are globally hyperbolic and geodesically complete and produce an exact travel-time advance between exterior clocks. An axial maximum makes the axial light ray globally minimizing; a strict maximum on an interior interval establishes Olum's endpoint-surface criterion for exactly matched corridors. Exact Einstein-source identities distinguish integrated Eulerian matter energy from asymptotic mass: infinite tubes have negative integrated energy, whereas finite corridors admit competing gradient contributions. A transverse Ricci identity proves local null-energy violation in every nontrivial localized finite corridor. The axial averaged null energy is strictly negative for localized axial-maximum profiles, and quantitative bounds relate its magnitude to the reference time advance and peak strain. We also obtain the complete finite-profile Ricci spectrum and the axial passenger tidal tensor. These results provide explicit causal and source constraints on a prepared geometry without specifying its physical formation or matter dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中的内禀空间应变捷径
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了在固定参考体积下，由内禀空间度规的纵向收缩和横向膨胀产生的时空捷径。光滑有界的超静态走廊是整体双曲且测地完备的，并在外部时钟之间产生精确的旅行时间提前。轴向极大值使得轴向光线全局极小化；内部区间上的严格极大值建立了Olum端点曲面判据，用于精确匹配的走廊。精确的Einstein源恒等式将积分欧拉物质能量与渐近质量区分开来：无限管具有负的积分能量，而有限走廊允许竞争性梯度贡献。横向Ricci恒等式证明，在每个非平庸局域有限走廊中局域零能量条件被违反。对于局域轴向极大剖面，轴向平均零能量严格为负，定量界将其大小与参考时间提前和峰值应变联系起来。我们还得到了完整的有限剖面Ricci谱和轴向乘客潮汐张量。这些结果为一种制备好的几何提供了显式的因果和源约束，而没有指定其物理形成或物质动力学。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论框架下，内禀空间应变可构造光滑测地完备的时空捷径，但其有限局域走廊必然违反局域零能量条件并具有负的轴向平均零能量。

2610.09216v1.title: Logarithmic corrections to massive particle trajectories for the classical soft log theorems at leading order in $G$
2610.09216v1.abstract: We study the logarithmic corrections to the asymptotic trajectories of massive particles. These corrections enter the calculation of the soft-log sector of the radiative field at null infinity in four-dimensional gravitational scattering. We first isolate the part of the metric which enters the particle equations of motion. We show that the nonlinear source can only affect this sector through homogeneous modes on the hyperboloid, and that matching to the proposed soft tower implies that these modes vanish, except for the first mode. We show that this mode cannot affect the trajectory coefficients at leading order in G. We then invert the matter energy-momentum tensor on the particle worldlines to obtain the trajectory coefficients at leading order in $G$ and at every logarithmic order using Legendre polynomials. The first two coefficients reproduce the known results at orders $G$ and $G^2$. .

classification.title_zh: 大质量粒子轨迹的对数修正——经典软对数定理在 G 领头阶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究大质量粒子渐近轨迹的对数修正。这些修正进入四维引力散射中类光无穷远辐射场软对数扇区的计算。我们首先分离出进入粒子运动方程的度规部分。我们表明，非线性源只能通过双曲面上的齐次模影响该扇区，并且与所提出的软塔匹配意味着这些模除第一个模外都消失。我们表明该模在 G 领头阶不能影响轨迹系数。然后我们在粒子世界线上反演物质能量-动量张量，利用 Legendre 多项式获得 G 领头阶且每一对数阶的轨迹系数。前两个系数重现了 G 阶和 G^2 阶的已知结果。
classification.one_liner: 在 G 领头阶计算大质量粒子轨迹的对数修正，为四维引力散射的经典软对数定理提供所需输入。

2610.09847v1.title: Axial-metric/polar-gauge perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole
2610.09847v1.abstract: We study linear perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) wormhole in the parity sector that pairs axial metric perturbations with polar gauge perturbations. It contains the axial gravitational mode and the electric field along the magnetic field lines. The lowest Landau level (LLL) of the charged fermions responds through its charge. The gauge components $a_\tau$, $a_\rho$ form a two-dimensional gauge field on the worldsheet of each field line, and the fermions respond with the exact Schwinger current. Lifted over the sphere, it gives the electric field the MMP screening mass $m_S^2=\alpha q^2$, which is not small and survives in the mouth. In the throat the perturbation tilts the worldsheets, and the Casimir stress tensor acquires mixed components. Force balance then requires a current across the field lines, and charge conservation fixes an accompanying polarisation current, the counterpart of the Hall current of the polar sector. These currents close the Bianchi identities at first order in the fermionic backreaction $\alpha$. The system reduces to three coupled master equations, given in closed form and matched to the fermion-free mouth. Consistency alone does not select the fermionic constitutive relation, but locality, covariance and the index theorem do. At $\alpha=0$ the throat reduces to Poschl-Teller problems with masses $l(l-1)$ and $(l+1)(l+2)$ at $m_S^2=0$. At finite $m_S^2$ one mode is screened, one tends to the mass $l^2+l+2$, and one neutral charge-density wave stays exactly massless. The $O(\alpha)$ shifts of the massive normal frequencies are real and negative. The two parity sectors are isospectral only without fermions. The neutral channel sees an attractive region in each mouth, and a numerical solution coupled to the gravitational channel in the exact mouth potential finds no bound state. The sector has no growing mode for $l\ge2$ at this order.

classification.title_zh: Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 虫洞的轴向度规/极向规范扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) 虫洞的线性扰动，所考虑的宇称扇区将轴向度规扰动与极向规范扰动配对。该扇区包含轴向引力模和沿磁场线的电场。带电费米子的最低朗道能级（LLL）通过其电荷响应。规范分量 a_τ、a_ρ 在每条场线的世界面上构成一个二维规范场，费米子以精确的 Schwinger 电流响应。提升到球面上，它给电场带来 MMP 屏蔽质量 m_S^2=α q^2，该质量不小且在虫洞口处依然存在。在喉部，扰动使世界面倾斜，Casimir 应力张量获得混合分量。力平衡则要求有跨越磁场线的电流，电荷守恒确定一个伴随的极化电流，即极向扇区霍尔电流的对应物。这些电流在费米子反作用 α 的一阶闭合 Bianchi 恒等式。系统约化为三个耦合的主方程，以闭合形式给出，并与无费米子虫洞口匹配。仅靠一致性无法选定费米子本构关系，但局域性、协变性和指标定理可以。在 α=0 时，喉部约化为 Pöschl-Teller 问题，质量分别为 l(l-1) 和 (l+1)(l+2)，此时 m_S^2=0。在有限 m_S^2 下，一个模式被屏蔽，一个趋于质量 l^2+l+2，而一个中性电荷密度波保持严格无质量。有质量简正频率的 O(α) 移动为实且负。两个宇称扇区仅在没有费米子时才同谱。中性通道在每个虫洞口看到一个吸引区域，而在精确虫洞口势中耦合到引力通道的数值解未发现束缚态。在该阶，该扇区对于 l≥2 没有增长模式。
classification.one_liner: 研究 MMP 虫洞轴向度规-极向规范宇称扇区的线性扰动，导出三个耦合主方程并分析费米子反作用对模式与稳定性的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究 MMP 虫洞的线性扰动、主方程与简正频率稳定性，属于经典引力/广义相对论，并与 QNM/扰动稳定性相关；但摘要未明确使用全息方法。

2610.10280v1.title: Analytic parity-violating greybody factors of a dynamical Chern-Simons black hole
2610.10280v1.abstract: We study the low-frequency scattering of gravitational and pseudoscalar waves off a non-rotating black hole in dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity, where the axial (odd-parity) gravitational sector is irreducibly coupled to the dynamical pseudoscalar while the polar sector remains general relativistic. Working to first order in the dimensionless coupling zeta = (ell_CS/M)^4 and using matched asymptotic expansions, we obtain an exact closed form for the graviton-to-pseudoscalar conversion probability, d_2 = 3(pi^2-9)^2/8, and a high-precision reconstruction, in a proven transcendental basis, of the graviton greybody (absorption) asymmetry, kappa_2 = (21/80) pi^4 + (27/8) pi^2 - 89833/1536, for the quadrupole (ell=2) channel. Both reduce to combinations of pi^4, pi^2, and rational numbers, with no ln2 or odd-zeta terms in the reconstructed basis; the transmission-phase sector, by contrast, contains an analytically derived zeta(3)-9/8 static integral, while its overall matching prefactor is identified numerically. The leading reflection-phase asymmetry vanishes, so that no polarization rotation is imprinted on the reflected wave at leading low-frequency order, while a subleading O(omegazeta) asymmetry remains in the transmitted phase. The normalized flux asymmetries are numerically consistent with a 1/(Momega)^2 falloff in the geometric-optics limit, where the leading remaining flux effect is conversion loss. The matched-asymptotic results are checked against direct two-channel integration, while the one-dimensional integral determining kappa_2 is evaluated to high precision within an analytically controlled transcendental basis. The results provide analytic targets linking dCS parity violation in absorption and mode conversion to the axial/polar quasinormal-mode splitting.

classification.title_zh: 动态 Chern-Simons 黑洞的解析宇称破坏灰体因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了动态 Chern-Simons (dCS) 引力中非旋转黑洞对引力波和赝标量波的低频散射，其中轴向（奇宇称）引力扇区与动态赝标量不可约耦合，而极向扇区仍为广义相对论。我们在无量纲耦合 zeta = (ell_CS/M)^4 的一阶展开下，使用匹配渐近展开，得到引力子到赝标量转换概率的精确闭式 d_2 = 3(pi^2-9)^2/8，并在一个已被证明的超越基下高精度重构了四极（ell=2）通道的引力子灰体（吸收）不对称性 kappa_2 = (21/80) pi^4 + (27/8) pi^2 - 89833/1536。二者均约化为 pi^4、pi^2 和有理数的组合，在重构基中没有 ln2 或奇 zeta 项；相较之下，透射相位扇区包含一个解析导出的 zeta(3)-9/8 静态积分，而其整体匹配前因子由数值确定。领头反射相位不对称性为零，因此在领头低频阶没有偏振旋转印刻到反射波上，而透射相位中仍有次领头的 O(omega zeta) 不对称性。归一化通量不对称性在几何光学极限下与 1/(M omega)^2 衰减数值一致，其中剩余领头通量效应是转换损失。匹配渐近结果与直接双通道积分进行了核对，同时确定 kappa_2 的一维积分在解析控制的超越基内被高精度求值。这些结果为将 dCS 宇称破坏在吸收和模式转换中的效应与轴向/极向准正规模分裂联系起来提供了解析目标。
classification.one_liner: 在动态 Chern-Simons 引力中解析计算非旋转黑洞的低频灰体因子与宇称破坏模式转换，并联系到准正规模分裂。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究动态 Chern-Simons 引力中黑洞的低频散射、灰体因子与准正规模分裂，直接属于经典引力/修改引力及 QNM 相关重点支线；但并非 AdS/CFT 全息研究。

2610.10529v1.title: Charge-regular formulation and radiative amplitudes of Kerr-Newman perturbations
2610.10529v1.abstract: We establish a charge-regular formulation of separated Kerr--Newman perturbations and an explicit map from master solutions to physical radiative fields. We derive regular angular and radial first-order systems and their second-order reductions, with finite-charge deformations of the spin $\pm1$ and $\pm2$ Teukolsky equations. The field and boundary normalizations recover the standard Kerr conventions while accounting for the nonuniform zero-charge limit at infinity. For physical Einstein--Maxwell perturbations with the usual peeling behavior, we obtain explicit outgoing gravitational and electromagnetic amplitudes and energy fluxes at nonzero real frequency. The resulting finite-charge radiation-composition ratios depend only on the regular angular functions, independently of the radial excitation.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman 扰动的电荷正则形式与辐射振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了分离的 Kerr–Newman 扰动的电荷正则表述，并给出从主方程解到物理辐射场的显式映射。我们推导了正则的角向和径向一阶系统及其二阶约化，其中包含自旋 ±1 与 ±2 Teukolsky 方程的有限电荷形变。场与边界归一化在复现标准 Kerr 约定的同时，也处理了无穷远处非均匀的零电荷极限。对于具有通常 peeling 行为的物理 Einstein–Maxwell 扰动，我们得到了非零实频率下显式的出射引力与电磁振幅以及能流。所得的有限电荷辐射组成比仅依赖于正则角向函数，与径向激发无关。
classification.one_liner: 建立 Kerr-Newman 扰动的电荷正则表述并给出引力/电磁辐射振幅与能流。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 Kerr-Newman 黑洞的经典 Einstein-Maxwell 扰动、Teukolsky 方程与辐射振幅，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

2507.09171v3.title: Connecting boundary entropy and effective central charge at holographic interfaces
2507.09171v3.abstract: The entanglement entropy of intervals in $1+1$ interface CFTs is modified in two ways compared to a CFT without interface: there is a finite boundary entropy contribution, and, for an interval with an endpoint at the interface, the coefficient of the logarithmically divergent contribution -- which is usually proportional to the central charge of the CFT -- is modified to an effective central charge. We show that the latter modification can be understood as a limit of the former using holographic duals of interface CFTs. Furthermore, we show that a finite contribution also appears in intervals that do not cross the interface and it is needed to ensure strong subbaditivity of the entanglement entropy.

classification.title_zh: 全息界面中连接边界熵与有效中心荷
classification.abstract_zh: 与没有界面的CFT相比，1+1维界面CFT中区间的纠缠熵有两处修正：存在有限的边界熵贡献；并且对于一端位于界面的区间，通常正比于CFT中心荷的对数发散项的系数被修改为有效中心荷。我们证明，利用界面CFT的全息对偶，后一修改可理解为前一修改的极限。此外，我们表明，在不穿过界面的区间中也会出现有限贡献，并且为了确保纠缠熵的强次可加性，这一贡献是必要的。
classification.one_liner: 在全息界面CFT中，区间纠缠熵的有效中心荷修正可由边界熵取极限得到，非穿越界面的有限项则保证强次可加性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息纠缠熵/界面CFT的形式研究，与AdS/CFT基础相关；但不直接匹配列出的重点支线（全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力等）。

2607.13725v3.title: An exact algorithm for U(N) matrix models in the gauge-invariant singlet sector
2607.13725v3.abstract: Matrix models appear as fundamental descriptions of M-theory and D-brane dynamics, and via the gauge/gravity duality their gauge-invariant, or singlet, sector describes the purely gravitational degrees of freedom in the holographic dual. We present a new exact algorithm for computing observables of bosonic U(N) matrix models in the gauge-invariant singlet sector. This sector is spanned by an orthogonal basis of Schur polynomials (for a single matrix) and restricted Schur polynomials (for multiple matrices), which diagonalizes the free Hamiltonian and provides a natural truncation of the Hilbert space by excitation number. Matrix elements of the interaction Hamiltonian, or any gauge-invariant observable, are evaluated through a group-theoretic reduction to cosets and double cosets of suitable subgroups of the symmetric group, together with character sums on the symmetric group. The resulting entries are closed-form polynomials in the gauge-group rank N, assembled from group-theoretic data that are precomputed once and can be reused for any N and any coupling constants. We validate the one-matrix implementation against the exact mapping to N non-interacting fermions, demonstrating rapid convergence of the low-lying spectrum with the cutoff. The multi-matrix extension is outlined; its main bottleneck is the computation of restricted characters of the symmetric group, for which no algorithm comparable to the Murnaghan--Nakayama rule is currently known. The framework gives direct access to finite-N, finite-coupling dynamics of gauge-invariant states and opens a new computational window on the non-planar regime of holographic matrix models.

classification.title_zh: U(N) 矩阵模型在规范不变单态扇区中的精确算法
classification.abstract_zh: 矩阵模型作为 M 理论和 D-brane 动力学的基本描述出现；通过规范/引力对偶，其规范不变（或单态）扇区描述了全息对偶中纯引力的自由度。我们提出一种新的精确算法，用于计算规范不变单态扇区中玻色型 U(N) 矩阵模型的可观测量。该扇区由 Schur 多项式（单矩阵情形）和限制 Schur 多项式（多矩阵情形）的正交基张成；这组基使自由哈密顿量对角化，并给出按激发数对希尔伯特空间的自然截断。相互作用哈密顿量或任何规范不变可观测量的矩阵元，通过群论约化到对称群适当子群的陪集与双陪集，并结合对称群上的特征标求和来计算。所得矩阵元是规范群秩 N 的闭式多项式，由只需预计算一次、并可对任意 N 和任意耦合常数重复使用的群论数据组装而成。我们通过单矩阵实现与 N 个非相互作用费米子的精确映射进行验证，表明低能谱随截断快速收敛。多矩阵推广已作概述；其主要瓶颈是对称群限制特征标的计算，目前尚不知道有可与 Murnaghan--Nakayama 规则相比的算法。该框架可直接获得规范不变态的有限 N、有限耦合动力学，并为全息矩阵模型的非平面区域打开新的计算窗口。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种在规范不变单态扇区精确计算 U(N) 矩阵模型可观测量的群论算法，可访问有限 N、非平面全息动力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息矩阵模型/非平面计算方向，但与用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、D3-D7/Floquet 等具体支线无直接重合。

2609.05336v3.title: The Junction That Remembers: Infrared Response of Two Coupled SYK Majorana Systems
2609.05336v3.abstract: Two strongly interacting Majorana systems of the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev type, each with its own independent disorder, are joined by a link that is switched on in time. We ask how the infrared structure of the link is imprinted on the response and whether the system remembers how it was opened. At large $N$ the leading cross-correlation between the two systems is an exact product of two equilibrium propagators and the switching profile; because the disorder is independent, no ladder dresses it. The link operator has scaling dimension one half, which gives its susceptibility a universal logarithm whose coefficient and phase we fix and verify numerically, while the gap of the coupled equilibrium problem grows more slowly than the naive crossover estimate. Exact dynamics for up to twelve Majoranas per side show strong parity transfer and entanglement several times the free-fermion ceiling. The work done by the switch has a first-order part that does not depend on the switching time and a second-order part that grows in magnitude with it. Once the work is held fixed, the protocol dependence of the entanglement, the link expectation value and a scrambling diagnostic nearly vanishes, and the small residuals do not depend on whether the protocols differ at low or at high frequency. These small systems have no infrared window, so they neither confirm nor exclude memory at large $N$.

classification.title_zh: 会记忆的结：两个耦合 SYK Majorana 系统的红外响应
classification.abstract_zh: 两个 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 型强相互作用 Majorana 系统，各自具有独立无序，通过一个随时间开启的连接耦合。我们询问连接的红外结构如何印记在响应上，以及系统是否记得它是如何被打开的。在大 N 下，两个系统之间的主导互关联精确地是两个平衡传播子与开关剖面的乘积；由于无序独立，没有梯形图修正它。连接算符的标度维数为 1/2，这使其感受率具有普适对数，我们确定其系数和相位并数值验证；耦合平衡问题的能隙增长比朴素交叉估计更慢。每侧最多十二个 Majorana 的精确动力学显示出强宇称转移和数倍于自由费米子上限的纠缠。开关所做的功有一阶部分不依赖于开关时间，二阶部分随开关时间增长而增大。一旦功固定，纠缠、连接期望值和一个 scrambling 诊断对协议的依赖性几乎消失，且小的残差不依赖于协议差异是在低频还是高频。这些小型系统没有红外窗口，因此它们既不能确认也不能排除大 N 下的记忆。
classification.one_liner: 在大 N 下分析两个耦合 SYK Majorana 系统通过时变连接开启后的红外响应、纠缠与功，发现小系统无法判定大 N 记忆。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 JT/SYK/AdS2 理论全息方向，研究耦合 SYK、时变连接与 scrambling；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7探针膜或经典引力等支线，故相关性偏低。

2609.14497v2.title: M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction to $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson loop vs localization in ABJM theory
2609.14497v2.abstract: We study the quantization of an M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$, dual to the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory. The classical action and the one-loop contribution were previously shown to reproduce the gauge-theory localization result. Here we extend the analysis to the two-loop order. In an adapted static and $\kappa$-symmetry gauge the world-volume action contains no cubic interaction vertices, so that the two-loop correction is determined entirely by quartic interactions and is manifestly free of logarithmic UV divergences. We find that the bosonic and fermionic contributions combine into a perfect square $ {\mathscr X}^2$ where ${\mathscr X}$ is a linear combination of the bosonic and fermionic 3d Green's functions and their derivatives. The evaluation of $\mathscr X$ requires fixing the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ boundary quantization of the massless fermionic modes. With the boundary conditions selected by the preserved supersymmetry, $\mathscr X$ vanishes and hence the complete two-loop correction is found to be zero. This result would not be consistent with identifying the M2-brane loop expansion directly with the large-$N$ expansion of the canonical, fixed-$(N,k)$ localization prediction. Instead, it agrees precisely with the recent proposal that the semiclassical M2-brane partition function should be matched to the gauge-theory grand-canonical ensemble, in which the Wilson loop expectation value is perturbatively one-loop exact. The vanishing of the two-loop correction thus provides a non-trivial test of this grand-canonical identification.

classification.title_zh: AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中的 M2 膜：对 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈的双圈修正与 ABJM 局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 内包裹 AdS_2×S^1 的 M2 膜的量子化，其与 ABJM 理论中的 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈对偶。经典作用量和单圈贡献此前已被证明可重现规范理论局域化结果。这里我们将分析推广到双圈阶。在适配静态规范与 κ-对称规范下，世界体积作用量不含三次相互作用顶点，因此双圈修正完全由四次相互作用决定，并且显式地无对数紫外发散。我们发现玻色与费米贡献组合成完全平方 X^2，其中 X 是三维玻色与费米 Green 函数及其导数的线性组合。计算 X 需要固定无质量费米模式的 AdS_2 边界量子化。在由保持超对称所选定的边界条件下，X 为零，因此完整双圈修正为零。这一结果将不能与把 M2 膜圈展开直接等同于固定 (N,k) 局域化预言的大 N 展开相一致。相反，它精确符合最近提出的建议：半经典 M2 膜配分函数应与规范理论巨正则系综匹配，在该系综中 Wilson 圈期望值微扰地单圈精确。因此双圈修正的消失为这一巨正则识别提供了非平凡检验。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中计算 M2 膜对 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈的双圈修正并发现其为零，支持半经典 M2 膜配分函数对应巨正则系综而非固定 (N,k) 局域化展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 精确检验与 M2 膜量子化，与用户重点标签（全息超流、p 波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、探针膜/Floquet、经典引力）均不直接相关。

2609.31576v2.title: Bootstrapping Holographic Theories in the Planar Limit
2609.31576v2.abstract: We combine the numerical conformal bootstrap with supersymmetric localization to constrain the spectrum of holographic superconformal field theories in the planar large $N$ limit for finite 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$. We consider the stress tensor multiplet four-point function in $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM), which is holographically dual to closed string scattering, as well as the flavor multiplet correlator in a certain $ 4d $ $\mathcal{N}=2$ $U\!Sp(2N)$ gauge theory with $SO(8)$ flavor symmetry, which is dual to open string scattering. In both cases, we combine dispersive sum rules with integrated constraints from supersymmetric localization to compute an upper bound on the scaling dimension of the lowest scalar single-trace operator for all $\lambda$. For $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, we find that our bounds are close to the known integrability result for all $\lambda$. For the $\mathcal{N}=2$ theory, where integrability is not yet available, we find that our bounds are close to weak and strong coupling predictions in the relevant regimes.

classification.title_zh: 平面极限下全息理论的 Bootstrap
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将数值共形 bootstrap 与超对称局域化结合起来，以在平面大 N 极限、有限 't Hooft 耦合 λ 下约束全息超共形场论的谱。我们考虑 N=4 SU(N) 超杨-米尔斯（SYM）中的应力张量多重态四点函数，其全息对偶为闭弦散射；以及某个具有 SO(8) 味对称性的 4d N=2 USp(2N) 规范理论中的味多重态关联函数，其对偶为开弦散射。在这两种情况下，我们结合色散求和规则与来自超对称局域化的积分约束，计算对所有 λ 的最低标量单迹算符标度维数的上界。对于 N=4 SYM，我们发现我们的界在所有 λ 下都接近已知可积性结果。对于 N=2 理论，目前尚无可用可积性，我们发现我们的界在相关区域接近弱耦合和强耦合预测。
classification.one_liner: 结合共形 bootstrap 与超对称局域化，在平面大 N 极限下约束全息超共形场论谱，并覆盖有限 't Hooft 耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与全息谱 bootstrap，但未涉及用户重点标签列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

2609.31829v2.title: Localizing the M-Theory Path Integral
2609.31829v2.abstract: We propose a supersymmetric localization formula for the local perturbative contribution to the M-theory path integral, reducing it to an integral over equivariant flux data. Relative equivariant extensions of the eleven-dimensional Chern--Simons couplings determine the localized action, while for M2-brane backgrounds a tangent-cotangent character computes the one-loop determinant. This gives the first closed form expression for the complete perturbative ABJM partition function at general squashing and chemical potentials, and new analytic results for the ABJM topologically twisted index describing black holes. Applied to the non-toric $V^{5,2}$ theory, the same prescription yields a closed analytic Airy constant previously known only numerically. Our formulas reproduce all available independent field theory results, and provide analytic predictions at general parameters where no field theory answer is currently known. We derive an all-genus result for the Type IIA expansion which is an equivariant form of the usual topological string constant map result, and also extract integrated correlators.

classification.title_zh: 局域化 M 理论路径积分
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个超对称局域化公式，用于 M 理论路径积分的局部微扰贡献，将其约化为对等变通量数据的积分。十一维 Chern--Simons 耦合的相对等变扩张决定局域化作用量，而对于 M2 膜背景，一个切丛-余切丛特征标计算单圈行列式。这给出了一般 squashing 和化学势下完整微扰 ABJM 配分函数的首个闭式表达式，以及描述黑洞的 ABJM 拓扑扭曲指标的新解析结果。应用于非环面 V^{5,2} 理论，同一方案给出了此前仅以数值已知的闭式解析 Airy 常数。我们的公式重现了所有可获得的独立场论结果，并在当前尚不知场论答案的一般参数下给出解析预言。我们推导出 Type IIA 展开的全亏格结果，它是通常拓扑弦常数映射结果的等变形式，并提取了积分关联函数。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出 M 理论路径积分的超对称局域化公式，并应用于 ABJM 配分函数、黑洞拓扑扭曲指标、非环面 V^{5,2} 理论和 Type IIA 展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT、M 理论与 ABJM 超对称局域化方向，并涉及黑洞拓扑扭曲指标；但不直接对应所列全息超流超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7 或经典引力等重点标签。

2609.34777v3.title: M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction
2609.34777v3.abstract: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop $ {\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes. This is in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory interpreted in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction for the M2 brane instanton wrapping $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to the leading non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to the ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton M2 brane partition function was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which requires to integrate over the collective coordinates. The collective-coordinate Jacobian provides a non-trivial ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ contribution in addition to the one of the quartic interaction vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the the quartic vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian contribution for the choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields under which these form separate supermultiplets. Assuming the supersymmetric prescription for the paired zero modes we show that the cancellation persists after integration over the collective coordinates. Thus the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction vanishes, in agreement with the grand-canonical ensemble prediction. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 which is related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

classification.title_zh: AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：2-loop 修正
classification.abstract_zh: 如 arXiv:2609.14497 所示，对包裹 AdS_2×S^1 并位于 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 内的 M2 膜配分函数的 2-loop T^{-1}_2 修正为零。这与 ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson loop 的 localization 预言一致；按照 arXiv:2505.21633 的猜想，该预言在 grand-canonical ensemble 中解释。这里我们研究包裹 S^3/Z_k ⊂ S^7/Z_k、对偶于 ABJM 在 3-sphere 上自由能的大 N 领头非微扰贡献的 M2 膜瞬子的 T^{-1}_2 修正。arXiv:2307.14112 表明 1-loop 瞬子 M2 膜配分函数与 localization 预言匹配。2-loop 计算因存在玻色子和费米子零模而复杂，需要对集体坐标积分。集体坐标 Jacobian 在 M2 膜作用量的四次相互作用顶点贡献之外，提供非平凡的 T^{-1}_2 贡献。我们发现对于 k>2，在将费米子零模与量子场分离、使其形成独立超多重态的选取下，四次顶点贡献被 Jacobian 贡献抵消。假设配对零模采用超对称规定，我们证明在集体坐标积分后抵消仍然存在。因此 T^{-1}_2 修正为零，与 grand-canonical ensemble 预言一致。对于 k=1，四次顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，如同 arXiv:2511.22306 中 AdS_3 ⊂ AdS_7×S^4 的情形；后者通过形式解析延拓与 S^3 ⊂ AdS_4×S^7 情形相关。
classification.one_liner: 计算 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数的 2-loop T^{-1}_2 修正，发现 k>2 时抵消为零，支持 grand-canonical ensemble 预言；k=1 约化为运动方程项。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于纯理论全息/AdS/CFT 计算，涉及 ABJM、M2 膜瞬子和 localization，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等重点支线。

2610.05821v2.title: Global Consistency of Cosmological Braneworlds in Palatini and Metric-Affine f(R) Gravity
2610.05821v2.abstract: We investigate global consistency conditions for five-dimensional warped braneworlds in Palatini and metric-affine gravity. Starting from the generalized Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde framework, we derive integrated sum rules for cosmological warped geometries and examine how independent connection degrees of freedom modify the standard Einstein-gravity obstruction to smooth compact braneworlds. The analysis separates geometric, matter, and non-Riemannian contributions and clarifies the conditions under which the usual no-go result can be modified. We show that the generalized consistency relations provide necessary global constraints on admissible configurations and identify the terms responsible for possible departures from the Riemannian case. The results establish a systematic framework for testing the global consistency of smooth five-dimensional braneworlds in gravitational theories with independent affine structure.
authors: Paulo Michel L. T da Silva

classification.title_zh: Palatini 与度量-仿射 f(R) 引力中宇宙学膜世界的全局一致性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Palatini 和度量-仿射引力中五维翘曲膜世界的全局一致性条件。从广义 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde 框架出发，我们为宇宙学翘曲几何推导积分求和规则，并考察独立联络自由度如何修改标准 Einstein 引力中对光滑紧致膜世界的阻碍。该分析将几何、物质和非黎曼贡献分开，并澄清通常 no-go 结果可被修改的条件。我们表明，广义一致性关系给出了可容许构型的必要全局约束，并识别出可能导致偏离黎曼情形的项。结果为在具有独立仿射结构的引力理论中检验光滑五维膜世界的全局一致性建立了系统框架。
classification.one_liner: 在 Palatini/度量-仿射 f(R) 引力中推导宇宙学翘曲膜世界的积分求和规则，澄清独立仿射结构如何修改光滑紧致膜世界的 no-go 约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/膜世界与修改引力方向，涉及 no-go 定理和全局一致性；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力，因此与用户重点标签中的经典引力支线相关，但非全息核心主题。

2603.12311v2.title: Looking for non-gaussianity in Pulsar Timing Arrays through the four point correlator
2603.12311v2.abstract: Pulsar Timing Arrays have recently reported strong evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background. In standard analyses, it is modeled through pulsar-dependent Fourier coefficients assumed to follow gaussian statistics, so that the signal is fully characterized by its two-point function. However, if the background arises from a finite population of inspiralling supermassive black hole binaries, non-gaussian features may emerge, making the determination of higher-order correlators essential. In this work, we compute the complete four-point correlator of the stochastic gravitational wave background Fourier coefficients for four arbitrary pulsar positions, identifying it as the leading probe of non-gaussianity. The result separates into a gaussian contribution, proportional to the square of the two-point function, and a genuinely non-gaussian connected component, whose non-trivial angular dependence generalizes the Hellings and Downs correlation to four pulsars. This angular structure depends only on averages of products of antenna pattern functions, and is therefore expected to be independent of the specific physical origin of the background. We further propose to incorporate the four-point correlator into the parameter-estimation pipeline by deriving a marginalized likelihood that perturbatively accounts for non-gaussian effects. Our results provide the theoretical framework to search for non-gaussian features in pulsar timing array data, opening the way to a more complete characterization of gravitational-wave backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 通过四点关联器在脉冲星计时阵列中寻找非高斯性
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列最近报告了随机引力波背景的强证据。在标准分析中，它通过脉冲星依赖的傅里叶系数建模，并假定服从高斯统计，因此信号完全由两点函数表征。然而，如果背景来自有限数量的旋进超大质量黑洞双星，可能出现非高斯特征，使得确定高阶关联器变得必要。在这项工作中，我们计算了四个任意脉冲星位置的随机引力波背景傅里叶系数的完整四点关联器，并将其确定为非高斯性的主要探针。结果分为高斯贡献，正比于两点函数的平方，以及真正非高斯的连通分量，其非平凡角依赖将 Hellings 和 Downs 关联推广到四颗脉冲星。这种角结构仅依赖于天线方向图函数乘积的平均值，因此预期独立于背景的具体物理起源。我们进一步提出通过推导一个微扰地考虑非高斯效应的边缘化似然，将四点关联器纳入参数估计流程。我们的结果为在脉冲星计时阵列数据中寻找非高斯特征提供了理论框架，为更完整地表征引力波背景开辟了道路。
classification.one_liner: 计算随机引力波背景的四点关联器，为脉冲星计时阵列中搜索非高斯性提供理论框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波背景统计与脉冲星计时阵列数据分析，涉及非高斯高阶关联器；不涉及全息、量子引力或用户标注的全息支线，但与经典引力重点标签相关。

2604.24115v4.title: Photon Surfaces in Higher-Curvature Gravity: Implications for Quasinormal Modes and Gravitational Lensing
2604.24115v4.abstract: Effective field theory (EFT) provides a systematic framework to describe deviations from general relativity through higher-curvature corrections to the gravitational action. In this work, we investigate test-field quasinormal modes (QNMs) and weak and strong gravitational lensing in static, spherically symmetric spacetimes with higher-curvature corrections, focusing on null geodesics near the photon sphere. Using the strong deflection limit formalism developed by Bozza, we derive the logarithmic divergence of the deflection angle and separate the divergent and regular contributions. We normalize the dimensionful EFT couplings by appropriate powers of the horizon radius $r_s=2M$ and work perturbatively in the resulting dimensionless parameters. We analyze how higher-curvature corrections modify the photon sphere radius, the critical impact parameter, and the coefficients governing the strong deflection expansion. We further examine the corresponding effects on test-field QNMs in the eikonal regime. Our results provide a systematic characterization of how higher-curvature EFT corrections modify null geodesics, strong gravitational lensing, and test-field QNMs, and clarify the relation between EFT couplings and characteristic properties of the surrounding spacetime geometry.

classification.title_zh: 高阶曲率引力中的光子面：对准正规模与引力透镜的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 有效场论（EFT）提供了一个系统框架，通过引力作用量的高阶曲率修正来描述对广义相对论的偏离。在本工作中，我们研究具有高阶曲率修正的静态球对称时空中的测试场准正规模（QNMs）以及弱、强引力透镜，重点关注光子球附近的类光测地线。利用 Bozza 发展的强偏折极限形式，我们推导出偏折角的对数发散，并分离发散与正则贡献。我们通过视界半径 r_s=2M 的适当幂次对量纲性 EFT 耦合进行归一化，并在所得的无量纲参数中作微扰处理。我们分析高阶曲率修正如何改变光子球半径、临界碰撞参数以及控制强偏折展开的系数。我们进一步考察 eikonal 区域中对测试场 QNMs 的相应效应。我们的结果系统刻画了高阶曲率 EFT 修正如何修改类光测地线、强引力透镜与测试场 QNMs，并阐明了 EFT 耦合与周围时空几何特征性质之间的关系。
classification.one_liner: 在高阶曲率 EFT 修正的静态球对称时空中，研究光子球附近的强/弱引力透镜与测试场准正规模。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论中的高阶曲率修正、光子球、强引力透镜与测试场准正规模，匹配用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论和 QNM；不涉及全息对偶。

2606.27429v2.title: Massive scalar fields in eccentric regime: Detectability and constraints from LISA observations of extreme mass-ratio inspirals
2606.27429v2.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are among the most promising sources for future space-based gravitational wave (GW) observatories and provide sensitive probes of additional fundamental fields in the strong-gravity regime. In the present work, we investigate eccentric equatorial EMRIs around Kerr black holes in the presence of a massive scalar field. We assume that the inspiralling object carries a scalar charge, therefore, emits scalar radiation in addition to GWs. By solving the massive scalar perturbation equation in the frequency domain, we compute the relativistic scalar energy fluxes at the event horizon and at infinity and incorporate them into an adiabatic inspiral model. We investigate the impact of the scalar charge and scalar field mass on the orbital evolution and gravitational waveforms by analysing the accumulated phase differences and waveform mismatches relative to both general relativity (GR) and the massless scalar limit. Our results show that the massive scalar radiation can produce significant GW dephasing, with the effect becoming increasingly pronounced for more eccentric orbits. In addition, the scalar flux is suppressed for larger scalar field masses as fewer scalar harmonics satisfy the propagation condition at infinity. Finally, using both Fisher-information-matrix forecasts and Bayesian parameter estimation, we assess the capability of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna to constrain the scalar charge and scalar field mass. The two inference approaches gives consistent constraints, demonstrating that eccentric EMRIs provide a promising avenue for probing massive scalar fields and scalar-tensor extensions of gravity in the strong-field regime.

classification.title_zh: 偏心区域中的大质量标量场：来自极端质量比旋近 LISA 观测的可探测性与限制
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）是未来空间引力波天文台最有希望的源之一，并为强引力区中额外基本场提供了灵敏探针。本工作研究在存在大质量标量场时，围绕 Kerr 黑洞的偏心赤道 EMRI。我们假设旋近天体携带标量荷，因此除引力波外还发出标量辐射。通过在频率域求解大质量标量微扰方程，我们计算事件视界处和无穷远处的相对论标量能流，并将其纳入绝热旋近模型。通过分析相对于广义相对论（GR）和无质量标量极限的累积相位差与波形失配，我们研究标量荷和标量场质量对轨道演化和引力波形的影响。结果表明，大质量标量辐射可产生显著的引力波退相位，且效应在轨道越偏心时越明显。此外，标量场质量越大，标量通量被抑制，因为满足无穷远处传播条件的标量谐波更少。最后，利用 Fisher 信息矩阵预测和贝叶斯参数估计，我们评估 LISA 约束标量荷和标量场质量的能力。两种推断方法给出自洽的约束，表明偏心 EMRI 为在强场区探测大质量标量场和标量-张量引力扩展提供了有希望的途径。
classification.one_liner: 在偏心 Kerr EMRI 中纳入带标量荷天体的大质量标量辐射，分析波形退相位并用 LISA 约束标量荷与标量场质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Kerr 黑洞周围偏心 EMRI 中的大质量标量辐射与 LISA 参数约束，属于经典引力/广义相对论和引力波方向，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息。

2606.29576v2.title: Quark and hybrid stars with renormalization group improvement of NNLO perturbative QCD
2606.29576v2.abstract: Recently, the NNLO perturbative QCD pressure of cold and dense symmetric matter, with arbitrary quark masses, has been resummed within the renormalization-group-optimized perturbation theory (RGOPT) framework. By being imbued with renormalization group properties, the resulting pressure is less sensitive to renormalization scale ($\Lambda\equiv X \mu_B/3$) variations than the NNLO perturbative QCD pressure. Here, we extend this by considering $\beta$-equilibrium and charge neutrality to evaluate the corresponding equation of state (EoS). We provide a compact ``pocket" fitting formula for the EoS for $N_f=2+1$ massive quarks at different renormalization scale parameter ($X$) values. We describe pure quark stars as well as hybrid stars with quark-cores. Pure quark stars compatible with astrophysical observations were obtained with $X=2.71-3.30$, whereas a larger value (3.84) is needed if the secondary component of the observation GW190814 represents a neutron star. Hybrid stars were built considering three representative hadron models based on a relativistic mean-field description, and chosen to produce soft and stiff EoSs. Stable hybrid stars with masses compatible with the massive pulsar PSR J0740+6620 were obtained considering $X$ of the order of 2 to $2.71$, the largest scale giving rise to hybrid stars with a large quark core with a radius of 2 to 8 km , and the smallest to a small quark core at the center of the star.

classification.title_zh: 具有 NNLO 微扰 QCD 重整化群改进的夸克星与混合星
classification.abstract_zh: 最近，冷且致密对称物质的 NNLO 微扰 QCD 压强（任意夸克质量）已在重整化群优化微扰论（RGOPT）框架下被重求和。由于获得了重整化群性质，所得压强对重整化标度（Λ≡X μ_B/3）变化的敏感度低于 NNLO 微扰 QCD 压强。这里我们通过考虑 β 平衡和电荷中性来扩展这一点，以计算相应的状态方程（EoS）。我们为 N_f=2+1 有质量夸克在不同重整化标度参数 X 下的 EoS 提供了一个紧凑的“口袋”拟合公式。我们描述了纯夸克星以及带有夸克核的混合星。与天体物理观测兼容的纯夸克星在 X=2.71-3.30 时获得，而如果 GW190814 的次分量代表中子星，则需要更大的值（3.84）。混合星是在基于相对论平均场描述的三种代表性强子模型下构建的，并选择产生软和硬的 EoS。我们得到了质量与巨大脉冲星 PSR J0740+6620 兼容的稳定混合星，所考虑的 X 约为 2 到 2.71；最大标度导致具有半径 2 到 8 km 的大夸克核的混合星，而最小标度则导致星中心处的小夸克核。
classification.one_liner: 利用 RGOPT 改进的 NNLO 微扰 QCD 状态方程研究纯夸克星和混合星，并给出与脉冲星及 GW190814 约束相容的质量/半径参数范围。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文非全息研究，主要讨论 NNLO 微扰 QCD/RGOPT 状态方程及夸克星/混合星性质；涉及致密星与观测约束，可归入经典引力/致密星支线，但与 AdS/CFT、纠缠、全息相变等核心全息主题关联有限。

2607.17124v3.title: de Sitter Scalar Discrete Series: Gupta-Bleuler Structure and Holography
2607.17124v3.abstract: We show that scalar discrete-series unitary irreducible representations (UIRs) $\Pi_{p,0}$ ($p=1,2,\cdots$) of the de Sitter (dS) group $\mathrm{SO}_0(1,4)$ admit a dS-covariant Krein realization on the dS hyperboloid, endowed with a dS-invariant non-degenerate Klein-Gordon (KG) sesquilinear form, in which the group action is indecomposable and organizes naturally into a Gupta-Bleuler triplet. The positive- and negative-norm sectors are already present in the underlying Krein space, whereas a null sector emerges only at an intermediate stage, where the induced KG form becomes degenerate and its radical leads canonically to the physical quotient carrying the UIR $\Pi_{p,0}$. We further show that suitable limits of the bulk theory at the ``future'' and ``past'' conformal boundaries ${\mathcal{I}}^\pm$ give rise to dS-invariant boundary realizations endowed with induced kernel inner products. While the bulk negative-norm sector admits no independent boundary counterpart, the boundary realization retains the physical and gauge structures inherited from the bulk. The resulting boundary module nevertheless remains indecomposable, with its physical quotient carrying the discrete-series representation $\Pi_{p,0}$. The antipodal symmetry provides a natural relation between the realizations on ${\mathcal{I}}^+$ and ${\mathcal{I}}^-$, ensuring the consistency of the boundary construction and its geometric interpretation. At the heart of the analysis lies a Fourier-type bulk-boundary transform that provides a dS-covariant identification of the bulk and boundary physical sectors, establishing a one-to-one intertwining correspondence between the bulk and boundary realizations of $\Pi_{p,0}$ while preserving reflection positivity.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 标量离散系列：Gupta-Bleuler 结构与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，de Sitter（dS）群 SO_0(1,4) 的标量离散系列酉不可约表示（UIRs）Π_{p,0}（p=1,2,⋯）在 dS 双曲面上承认一个 dS 协变的 Krein 实现，并带有 dS 不变的非退化 Klein-Gordon（KG）半双线性形式；其中群作用不可分解，并自然组织成 Gupta-Bleuler 三重态。正范数和负范数扇区已存在于底层 Krein 空间中，而零扇区仅在中间阶段出现；在中间阶段，诱导的 KG 形式退化，其根空间典范地导向携带 UIR Π_{p,0} 的物理商。我们进一步证明，体理论在“未来”和“过去”共形边界 I^± 的适当极限给出 dS 不变的边界实现，并带有诱导的核内积。虽然体负范数扇区没有独立的边界对应物，但边界实现保留了从体继承的物理与规范结构。所得边界模仍不可分解，其物理商携带离散系列表示 Π_{p,0}。对跖对称性在 I^+ 与 I^- 上的实现之间提供自然关系，确保边界构造及其几何解释的一致性。分析的核心是一个 Fourier 型体-边界变换，它给出体与边界物理扇区的 dS 协变识别，在保持反射正性的同时，在 Π_{p,0} 的体实现与边界实现之间建立一一对应的 intertwining 对应。
classification.one_liner: 在 dS 双曲面上构造标量离散系列 UIR 的 Gupta-Bleuler/Krein 实现，并导出保持反射正性的体-边界全息对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于理论全息中的 dS/共形边界表示论工作，但不直接落在所列重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）上。

2608.15280v2.title: Study of gravitational radiation at $\mathscr{J}$ for the general type-D Einstein-Maxwell solution with cosmological constant
2608.15280v2.abstract: We characterize the gravitational radiation present in the general Pleba\'nski-Demia\'nski type~D solution with cosmological constant $\Lambda$ of any sign. We show that radiation escapes towards infinity if and only if the acceleration parameter is non-zero. We calculate the Cotton-York tensor and the boundary stress-energy tensor at infinity for negative $\Lambda$, and for positive $\Lambda$ the $D$ tensor that complements initial or final data at $\mathscr{J}$. In addition, we recast a recent parametrization of this family of metrics into a new form by a simple homothety, correctly identifying $\Lambda$, and study the existence and regularity of the possible axes of symmetry, searching for a relation between deficit angles and radiation. We also identify the branch of general non-radiating solutions with non-vanishing Cotton-York tensor at $ \mathscr{J} $.

classification.title_zh: 含宇宙学常数的广义 type-D Einstein-Maxwell 解在零无穷处的引力辐射研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们刻画了含任意符号宇宙学常数 Λ 的一般 Plebański-Demiański type D 解中的引力辐射。我们证明，辐射逃逸到无穷远当且仅当加速度参数非零。我们计算了负 Λ 情形下的 Cotton-York 张量和无穷远处的边界应力-能量张量，以及正 Λ 情形下在零无穷处补充初始或最终数据的 D 张量。此外，我们通过一个简单的相似变换，将该度规族最近的一种参数化改写为新形式，正确识别出 Λ，并研究可能的对称轴的存在性与正则性，寻找亏损角与辐射之间的关系。我们还识别出在零无穷处具有非零 Cotton-York 张量的一般非辐射解分支。
classification.one_liner: 研究含任意符号 Λ 的一般 Plebański-Demiański type-D Einstein-Maxwell 解在零无穷处的引力辐射，发现仅当加速度参数非零时辐射逃逸，并分析边界张量、对称轴与亏损角。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究含宇宙学常数的 type-D 精确解的引力辐射、零无穷边界量与对称轴性质，属于用户列出的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力信息问题。

2609.39694v2.title: Gravitational Memory: an approximate description
2609.39694v2.abstract: The large-distance behaviour of a sandwich gravitational wave can be approximated by a continuous but not necessarily smooth profile, providing us with a simplified description of particle motion. Our approximate model is consistent with the Carroll symmetry. Our strategy is illustrated by the Poschl-Teller profile. The limits of the sandwich approximation are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 引力记忆：一种近似描述
classification.abstract_zh: 三明治引力波的远距离行为可以用一个连续但不一定光滑的剖面来近似，从而为我们提供对粒子运动的简化描述。我们的近似模型与 Carroll 对称性一致。我们通过 Pöschl-Teller 剖面来说明该策略。文中讨论了三明治近似的局限。
classification.one_liner: 用连续（可不光滑）剖面近似三明治引力波的远距离行为，得到与 Carroll 对称性一致的简化粒子运动描述，并以 Pöschl-Teller 剖面为例讨论近似的局限。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究引力波记忆/三明治引力波的经典时空近似，并与 Carroll 对称性相关，属于用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论重点，同时涉及平直时空渐近对称性。

2610.09199v1.title: Toward a complete understanding of the properties of GW190521
2610.09199v1.abstract: Interpreting GW190521 remains challenging due to its exceptionally high total mass and correspondingly small number of observable gravitational-wave cycles, which gives rise to degeneracies between different physical interpretations. Motivated by the outstanding questions surrounding the event, we present a comprehensive reanalysis of GW190521 using waveform models drawn from multiple families, including a model that includes both eccentricity and spin-precession. We find evidence that the source was highly eccentric, with an inferred eccentricity of $0.81^{+0.05}_{-0.01}$ at 5 Hz, and show that non-eccentric interpretations arise from failing to probe the high-likelihood region at large eccentricities. We further demonstrate that when eccentricity is included in the analysis, there is no indication of spin precession, suggesting that the apparent precession in quasicircular analyses is at least partially driven by an eccentricity--spin-precession degeneracy. While all waveform models favor a comparable-mass binary, one model admits a secondary mode at more asymmetric masses. We find a robust probability $(\geq97\%)$ that the primary black hole lies within the pair-instability supernova mass gap ($\sim60-130\,M_\odot$), whereas the probability that the secondary lies in the gap depends on the waveform model. Through inference of GW190521-like injections, we show that the waveform systematics observed in the analysis of GW190521 could arise from the response of models to unmodeled eccentricity, rather than from intrinsic differences between waveform models. When analyzing a quasicircular spin-precessing injection similar to GW190521, we find no significant model dependence in the inferred parameters. Finally, because the inferred eccentricity lies beyond the calibration regime of current models, we test its robustness by recovering highly eccentric numerical-relativity waveforms.

classification.title_zh: 走向对GW190521性质的完整理解
classification.abstract_zh: 解释GW190521仍然具有挑战性，因为其总质量异常高且可观测引力波周期相应很少，导致不同物理解释之间存在简并。受该事件未决问题启发，我们使用来自多个波形族的模型对GW190521进行综合再分析，其中包括一个同时包含偏心率和自旋进动的模型。我们发现证据表明源高度偏心，在5 Hz处推断偏心率为0.81^{+0.05}_{-0.01}，并表明非偏心解释源于未能探测大偏心率处的高似然区域。我们进一步证明，当分析中包含偏心率时，没有自旋进动的迹象，这表明准圆轨道分析中表观进动至少部分由偏心率-自旋进动简并驱动。尽管所有波形模型都支持质量相近的双星，但一个模型允许在质量更不对称时存在次级模式。我们发现主黑洞位于对不稳定性超新星质量间隙（约60-130 M⊙）内的概率稳健（≥97%），而次黑洞位于该间隙的概率取决于波形模型。通过对类GW190521注入的推断，我们表明在GW190521分析中观测到的波形系统误差可能源于模型对未建模偏心率的响应，而不是波形模型之间的内在差异。当分析一个类似GW190521的准圆自旋进动注入时，我们发现推断参数没有显著模型依赖性。最后，由于推断的偏心率超出当前模型的校准范围，我们通过恢复高度偏心的数值相对论波形来检验其稳健性。
classification.one_liner: 对GW190521的多波形再分析表明其高度偏心，偏心率-自旋进动简并可解释表观进动，主黑洞很可能位于对不稳定性质量间隙。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究广义相对论框架下的引力波波形、黑洞并合与数值相对论，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2610.09336v1.title: Collisions of Multiple Black Holes: A Numerical Relativity Study
2610.09336v1.abstract: Numerical relativity has a profound impact on gravitational theory and gravitational wave astronomy. In this work, we present a systematic study of the head-on collisions of multipule black hole systems within the framework of numerical relativity using the Baumgarte-Shapiro-Shibata-Nakamura (BSSN) formulation. The numerical simulations of the dynamical evolution of gravitational fields are computed using the AMSS-NCKU code. We report numerical results for black hole collisions in several symmetric and non-symmetric configurations, in which the black holes are initially at rest and are described by Bowen-York type initial data. Our results suggest that black hole systems with perfectly symmetric configurations (e.g., black holes located at the vertices of a regular polygon or a regular polyhedron) impose strong constraints on the emitted gravitational waves, and no gravitational kick arises in these symmetric systems. For regular polygonal configurations, the radiation is dominated by the plus polarization of the $l=2$, $m=0$ mode. For regular polyhedral configurations, all the quadrupole modes with $l=2$ nearly vanish, and gravitational wave amplitudes are strongly suppressed to the order of $10^{-4}$ or below, which is in accordance with an analysis based on the quadrupole approximation. Gravitational radiations from $m \ne 0$ modes become non-negligible only when non-symmetric configurations are encountered. Keywords: Numerical Relativity, Black Holes, Gravitational Waves, N-Body Systems

classification.title_zh: 多黑洞碰撞：一项数值相对论研究
classification.abstract_zh: 数值相对论对引力理论和引力波天文学有深远影响。本文在数值相对论框架下，使用 Baumgarte-Shapiro-Shibata-Nakamura（BSSN）形式，系统研究多个黑洞系统的头对头碰撞。引力场动力学演化的数值模拟由 AMSS-NCKU 代码完成。我们报告了几种对称和非对称构型下黑洞碰撞的数值结果，其中黑洞初始静止，并由 Bowen-York 型初始数据描述。结果表明，具有完全对称构型（例如黑洞位于正多边形或正多面体顶点）的黑洞系统会对发出的引力波施加很强的限制，这些对称系统中不会出现引力反冲。对于正多边形构型，辐射主要由 l=2、m=0 模式的加号偏振主导。对于正多面体构型，所有 l=2 四极模式几乎消失，引力波振幅被强烈压制到 10^{-4} 或更低量级，这与基于四极近似分析的结果一致。只有当遇到非对称构型时，来自 m ≠ 0 模式的引力辐射才变得不可忽略。
classification.one_liner: 用 BSSN 数值相对论研究多黑洞头对头碰撞，发现对称构型强烈限制引力波且无引力反冲。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，主题为数值相对论黑洞碰撞与引力波，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”高度相关。

2610.09432v1.title: Anisotropic Fluid Model for Massive Boson Stars: Spherically Symmetric Configurations
2610.09432v1.abstract: Boson stars are among the best-studied exotic compact objects and constitute one of the few black-hole mimickers for which both the formation mechanism and dynamical behavior can be investigated from first principles. Constructing boson star solutions is generally more challenging than constructing neutron star solutions, often requiring either extremely accurate initial guesses for the oscillation frequency or the use of computationally intensive relaxation methods to solve the field equations. In the strong-coupling limit, massive boson stars can be described effectively as perfect- fluid configurations, enabling their construction using methods analogous to those developed for neutron stars. In this paper, we relax the strong-coupling assumption and derive a phenomenological anisotropic-fluid model for spherically symmetric massive boson stars that remains applicable over a broad range of model parameters. We provide ready-to-use fits for both the anisotropy profile and the effective equation of state in terms of the central scalar-field amplitude and the ratio of the self-interaction coupling constant to the squared scalar-field mass. To validate the model, we compute the masses and radii of boson stars using a standard neutron-star construction approach and compare the results against full boson-star calculations. We find excellent agreement between the two methods, while the new approach reduces the computational cost by a factor of about 10. Our phenomenological fluid framework offers an efficient and accurate method for constructing spherically symmetric massive boson stars and computing their observable properties. We provide a ready-to-use Python implementation of the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff solver, allowing users to construct boson star configurations within the proposed framework.

classification.title_zh: 大质量玻色星的各向异性流体模型：球对称构型
classification.abstract_zh: 玻色星是研究最充分的奇异致密天体之一，也是少数能够从第一性原理研究形成机制和动力学行为的黑洞模仿者之一。构造玻色星解通常比构造中子星解更困难，往往需要对振荡频率给出极其精确的初始猜测，或使用计算量很大的松弛方法求解场方程。在强耦合极限下，大质量玻色星可以有效地描述为完美流体构型，从而能够使用类似中子星的方法来构造。本文放松强耦合假设，推导了一个适用于球对称大质量玻色星的唯象各向异性流体模型，该模型在广泛模型参数范围内仍然适用。我们提供了可直接使用的拟合公式，用于给出各向异性剖面和有效状态方程，自变量为中心标量场振幅以及自相互作用耦合常数与标量场质量平方之比。为验证该模型，我们使用标准中子星构造方法计算玻色星的质量和半径，并将结果与完整的玻色星计算进行比较。我们发现两种方法之间吻合极好，同时新方法将计算成本降低了约10倍。我们的唯象流体框架为构造球对称大质量玻色星并计算其可观测性质提供了一种高效而准确的方法。我们提供了可直接使用的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff求解器Python实现，使用户能够在该框架内构造玻色星构型。
classification.one_liner: 提出大质量玻色星的各向异性流体唯象模型，用TOV方法高效构造球对称构型，精度高且计算成本降低约10倍。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究球对称大质量玻色星的经典引力构型与TOV求解，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

2610.09503v1.title: Ringdown analysis of GW250114 with RingCWB
2610.09503v1.abstract: The binary black hole merger GW250114, the loudest gravitational-wave signal detected to date, offers an opportunity to perform a precise test of Einstein's general relativity (GR). Its exceptionally high signal-to-noise ratio enables accurate measurements of the quasi-normal modes (QNMs) and properties of the remnant black hole. In this work, we present a ringdown analysis of GW250114 using the RingCWB algorithm. We measure the dominant $(2,2,0)$ QNM along with its first overtone and constrain the fractional deviations in frequency and damping time from their GR-predicted values, finding $\delta f_{220} = 0.004_{-0.023}^{+0.022}$ and $\delta\tau_{220} = 0.010_{-0.087}^{+0.096}$ , both consistent with zero within the quoted uncertainties. These results represent stringent constraints on deviations from GR. The analysis also places tight constraints on the remnant spin, consistent with a binary black hole formed through stellar evolution.

classification.title_zh: 用 RingCWB 对 GW250114 的铃宕分析
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合事件 GW250114 是迄今探测到的最强引力波信号，为精确检验爱因斯坦广义相对论（GR）提供了机会。其异常高的信噪比使得能够准确测量准正模（QNM）以及终态黑洞的性质。本工作使用 RingCWB 算法对 GW250114 进行铃宕分析。我们测量了主导的 (2,2,0) QNM 及其第一泛音，并约束频率和阻尼时间相对于 GR 预言值的分数偏离，得到 δf220 = 0.004_{-0.023}^{+0.022} 和 δτ220 = 0.010_{-0.087}^{+0.096}，二者在给定不确定度内均与零一致。这些结果给出了对偏离 GR 的严格约束。该分析还对终态黑洞自旋给出了紧约束，结果与通过恒星演化形成的双黑洞一致。
classification.one_liner: 利用 RingCWB 对迄今最响的 GW250114 做铃宕分析，测量 (2,2,0) QNM 及其第一泛音，并给出与 GR 一致的高精度频率和阻尼时间约束。
